bios: ["Ka Yee (Carrie) Wong Perrodo, a native of SIngapore, inherited international oil company Perenco when her husband Hubert Perrodo died in 2006.","Perenco is one of the world's largest family-owned oil companies, with operations in Gabon, Peru, Vietnam and elsewhere.","Carrie's eldest son, Francois, chairs Perenco while her daughter, Nathalie, oversees the family's winery investments in Bordeaux."]
abouts: ["Carrie Perrodo was a top model in the 1970s, when she met Hubert, who was traveling the world in search of oil and gas.","Carrie Perrodo launched her own agency, Carrie's Models. Though she sold it years ago, the agency remains active.\t"]
title: Philanthropist

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Carson Brice is one of four sisters of Frank Holding Jr., who has been chairman and CEO of First Citizens Bank, a publicly-traded commercial bank, since 2008.","Brice's grandfather, Robert Powell Holding, became an employee of the bank in 1918, and became president by 1935, before passing it down to Frank's father, Lewis Holding.","Today, Brice, her three sisters, and her brother Frank collectively own about 20% of the bank."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Carsten Koerl founded and runs sports data firm Sportradar, which he took public on the Nasdaq in 2021.","Sportradar, based in Switzerland, helps sports leagues compile data like in-game statistics and distribute it to media companies and betting operators.","He made his first entry into the sports data space in 1997 by founding Bwin (then called betandwin), later taking it public on Austria's Vienna Stock Exchange.","He earned a master's degree in electronic and microprocessor engineering from the University for Applied Sciences in Konstanz, Germany."]
abouts: ["Koerl developed a love for sports and competition during his youth and was an avid fan of German soccer club Bayern Munich.","Michael Jordan, Mark Cuban, Washington Capitals owner Ted Leonsis and Los Angeles Dodgers part-owner Todd Boehly all own minority stakes in Sportradar."]
title: Entrepreneur, Investor

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Carsten Maschmeyer founded German financial services provider AWD Holding AG in 1988 and took it public in 2000.","After Swiss Life acquired his AWD stake in 2008, Maschmeyer cofounded a consulting boutique focused on pension and health care plans.","Today, he invests in renewable energy and startups and runs his own asset management company, Paladin."]
abouts: ["He is married to German actress Veronica Ferres and has two sons from his first marriage."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Caryn Seidman-Becker is cofounder and CEO of Clear Secure, which uses identification technology for security checkpoints at airports and stadiums.","A former hedge fund manager, she and a colleague bought Clear's predecessor out of bankruptcy in 2010.","In 2023 she expanded the company's identity-confirming services into digital healthcare records. This plus strong travel demand helped revenue grow to $990 million in 2025.","After raising capital from investors including airlines Delta and United, she took the company public in June 2021 at a $4 billion valuation.","She joined Home Depot's board of directors in 2022 and, previously, sat on the board of fintech Lemonade."]
title: Cofounder & CEO

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Foyt is the granddaughter of Robert Irsay, who acquired the Indianapolis Colts in 1972, and the middle daughter of Jim Irsay, who ran the team from 1997 until his death in May 2025.","She and her sisters, Carlie Irsay-Gordon and Kalen Jackson, inherited what Forbes estimates are equal 33.3% stakes in the franchise. They now rank among the richest female owners in sports.","Long before the three sisters were publicly named Colts co-owners in 2012, their lives revolved around the NFL schedule. At an introductory press conference in June 2025, Foyt recalled answering the phones at the front desk while she was in high school.","Early in her career, Foyt worked for the NFL, where she helped plan the league's first regular-season game played outside North America, in London in 2007.","She returned to the Colts that year with a focus on marketing and community relationships."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Caspar Callerström joined Swedish investment company EQT AB in 1996.","Callerström is chief operating officer and partner at now publicly traded EQT, which has roughly $81 billion in assets under management.","EQT primarily invests in private equity, but has also put funds into venture capital, real estate and infrastructure.","EQT has minted seven billionaires, nearly as many as Google or Facebook.","Privately, Callerstrom is one of the founding members of a group of financial elites that backs the Swedish football club Djurgårdens IF."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cathrina Claas-Mühlhäuser is the chairwoman and largest shareholder of family-owned CLAAS, a German manufacturer of combines and agricultural machinery.","CLAAS was founded in 1913 by August Claas and his brothers Bernhard, Franz and Theo, after they built a pioneering innovation for a straw binder aimed at boosting profits on their family farm.","CLAAS is based in Harsewinkel, Germany and has annual revenue of almost 5 billion euros.","Along with Cathrina Claas-Mühlhäuser, the company's shareholders include the families of Helmut Claas, Gunther Claas and Reinhold Claas."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Catharina Mühleis is a fourth generation heir to the Stihl family fortune, founded in 1926 by Andreas Stihl.","Primarily known for its chainsaws, the company also manufactures power tools for forestry, agriculture and construction.","Stihl, which employs 19,805 people, has manufacturing facilities in Germany, USA, Brazil, Switzerland, Austria, China and the Philippines."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Catheline Perier D'Ieteren and her late brother, Roland, are the great great grandchildren of Jean-Joseph D'Ieteren, who founded the D'Ieteren company in 1805.","The Group's portfolio includes five businesses ranging from automobile distribution to real estate and glass repair.","The Group owns D'Ieteren Auto, which exclusively distributes Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Bugatti and Porsche in Belgium.","The business has been in the family for six generations. Catheline's son, Olivier Perier, is currently deputy chairman."]
abouts: ["The D'Ieteren Gallery in Belgium showcases 200 years of vehicles with D'Ieteren parts, ranging from horse carriages to modern luxury cars.","In 2016 the group acquired the lifestyle brand, Moleskin, in a deal that valued the planner-focused brand at around $572 million."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Catherine Commisso is the owner of Mediacom, a New York-based cable company founded by her husband Rocco Commisso. He died in January 2026 at age 76.","Rocco Commisso founded Mediacom to focus on smaller, underserved communities, and grew it into America's fifth-largest cable TV provider. \r\n","Catherine is also the owner of  Italian Serie A soccer team Fiorentina."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Catherine Dorrance Malone is a great-granddaughter of John T. Dorrance, who invented Campbell's Soup in 1897.","Catherine and her sister, Mary Alice Dorrance Malone Jr., inherited an 18% combined stake in The Campbell's Company when their mother, Mary Alice Dorrance Malone Sr., died in June 2025.","While Catherine doesn't have a role at the company, Mary Alice Jr. replaced their mother on the company's board in July 2025.","Their cousin, Bennett Dorrance Jr., and their mother's cousin, Archbold van Beuren, are also billionaire directors of the company.","Catherine and her sister grew up on their mother's horse breeding farm in Coatesville, Pa. Catherine, who inherited the farm, also owns a dressage equestrian facility in Wellington, Florida."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Catherine Phillips and her husband John Phillips were early investors in Canadian e-commerce firm Shopify.","The couple owns an estimated 2% of Shopify combined.","Now retired, Catherine worked as a psychologist specializing in helping cancer patients deal with stress.","She leads support groups and in 2013 published a book titled, Calm Your Mind, Warm Your Heart.","Her husband served on Shopify's board of directors from 2010 to 2023.","The Phillips' Northpine Foundation has donated hundreds of millions to organizations focused on climate, refugees and formerly incarcerated individuals."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["C.C. Leung is the vice chairman and president of Quanta Computer, the world's largest contract manufacturer of laptops by sales volume.","He cofounded Quanta with Barry Lam, also a billionaire, in 1988.","The company also makes other electronic devices and is one of the world's top server suppliers to cloud service providers by revenue, counting Meta and Google among its clients.","Leung's daughters, Amy, Annie and Anita, run Taipei's shopping mall Bellavita."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["C.C.Paarthipan founded and chairs Chennai pharma company Caplin Point Laboratories.","The company sells generics across Latin America, Africa, the U.S. and the Caribbean.","His older son Ashok heads the Latin American business while younger son Vivek is the chief operating officer.","He listed the company in 1994. It was oversubscribed 117 times.","He started as a medical rep in the 1980s and then founded Caplin in 1990 for making ointments and creams"]
abouts: ["He hails from a small village outside Chennai.","The company's product portfolio covers more than 65% of WHO's essential drugs list."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cen Junda's fortune stems from his stakes in Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals and Hansoh Pharmaceutical Group.","China-based Hansoh operates a research center in the U.S. state of Maryland.","He holds degrees from Zhejiang University and the China State Institute of Pharmaceutical Industry."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Ceyda Lale Tara is one of more than a dozen family members who hold shares in ENKA, one of Turkey's largest construction and energy companies.","ENKA, which was cofounded in 1957 by Sarik Tara and his brother-in-law, Sadi Gulcelik, is Turkey's leading private electricity producer and also operates in real estate, tourism, transport and trade (construction equipment and machinery).","In Moscow, ENKA owns a hotel, shopping malls and approximately 370,000 square meters of net rentable Class A office space.","Sadi Gulcelik died in a plane accident in Saudi Arabia in 1980, and Mehmet Sinan Tara took over in 1984 at age 26. His son Agah Mehmet Tara became CEO in 2012, at age 29."]
abouts: ["Over the last 20 years or so, ENKA has been the biggest builder of U.S. consular and embassy buildings.","The Lale Tara Arts Scholarship, run by ENKA Sanat, helps young artists?especially in classical music?pursue undergraduate and graduate studies outside of Turkey."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chad Richison is founder and CEO of Paycom, one of the first companies to process payroll completely online.","Richison, a former senior manager at payroll firm ADP, created Paycom in 1998.","He took Paycom public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2014 and owns about 12% of its shares.","The company provides payroll and human resource services and joined the S&P 500 in 2020.","Richison founded a nonprofit, the Green Shoe Foundation, which aims to improve people's mental health through counseling and therapy sessions."]
abouts: ["Richison was a wrestler in high school and college, placing at the state championships as a high school senior in his hometown of Tuttle, Oklahoma."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chairul Tanjung's CT Corp. is best known for issuing credit cards, operating hypermarkets and running TV stations.","CT Corp's retail arm has grocery stores across Indonesia under the Transmart brand.","His group also controls the Wendy's franchise in Indonesia and owns the Versace, Mango and Jimmy Choo franchises.","He has a stake in Indonesian national carrier Garuda, which completed the restructuring of its $10 billion debt in late 2022.","The billionaire also owns a stake in Allo Bank Indonesia, one of the largest digital banks in the country."]
abouts: ["Chairul is the son of a journalist.","He sold study guides while attending school to become a dentist."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chaitanya Desai is the managing director of Mumbai-based Apar Industries.","The 68-year-old company manufactures conductors, electric cables, speciality oils, polymers and lubricants.","His older brother Kushal is chairman and managing director of Apar Industries.","Apar was originally called Power Cables when it was set up in 1958 by his late father Dharamsinh Desai."]
abouts: ["His mother Maithili Desai hails from the Mafatlal family, an old textile clan in Mumbai."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chan Laiwa was the founder of Fuwah International Group, one of the largest real estate developers headquartered in Beijing. She died in April 2026 at age 85.","Fuwah is best known for its Jinbao Street development with Jinbao Tower, the Regent Building and the Beijing Hong Kong Jockey Club.","Fuwah has also been expanding outside of China in recent years, investing in hotels in Australia and New Zealand.","Chan was the curator of the China Red Sandalwood Museum."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chan Tan Ching-fen is the wife of the late Hong Kong property tycoon Chan Tseng-hsi. She controls the largest shareholding in Hang Lung Group.","Hang Lung was run by her eldest son, Ronnie, until his retirement in 2024. His son Adriel took over as chairman.","Ronnie's brother Gerald leads the family's Morningside Group, a private equity and venture capital investor."]
abouts: ["Her father Tan Hui-kuk was a second cousin of Sun Yat-sen, the founding father of the Republic of China, and provided Sun with financial support."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["One of four brothers of a property family, Chandru Raheja ventured out on his own in 1996.","Today his privately held K. Raheja Corp. is one of Mumbai's leading developers and is run by his sons Neel and Ravi.","Raheja is known for its IT parks, hotels, malls and department store chain, Shoppers Stop.","His Chalet Hotels, which owns a string of hotels such as the J.W. Marriott in Mumbai and the Westin in Hyderabad, was listed in 2019.","In 2020, Raheja listed part of his commercial properties, co-owned with private equity firm Blackstone, under the Mindspace Business Parks REIT."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chandubhai Virani is the cofounder of Indian snacks maker Balaji Wafers, which sells a range of items including packaged snacks, noodles and confectionery.","Virani and his two brothers Bhikhabhai and Kanjibhai, who help him run the company, entered the three comma club after selling a minority stake to private equity giant General Atlantic in January 2026.","Before starting Balaji Wafers, the brothers were doing odd jobs at Astron Cinemas in the town of Rajkot in the western Indian state of Gujarat.","The name \"Balaji\" was inspired by a temple in their hometown."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chang Chung-Hsing is the chairman of Taichung-based Apex Dynamics.","He founded the company in 1987 as a maker of robotic arms, and has built it into one of the world's largest suppliers of high-precision gearboxes.","Apex listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange in 2022.","It also owns Millennium Vee Hotel Taichung, operated in partnership with Singapore's Millennium Hotels & Resorts, one of the oldest international-brand hotels in central Taiwan."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chang Hyung-jin is an advisor at books-to-metallurgy-to-semiconductor conglomerate Young Poong, which was founded in 1949 by his grandfather Byung-hee and Choi Ki-ho.","Young Poong is a large minority shareholder of Korea Zinc, one of the world's largest processors of zinc and other metals. Chang's biggest source of wealth is his stake in Korea Zinc.","The other large minority shareholder is Choi Ki-ho's family, including his grandson Yun-beom, who is chairman and CEO of Korea Zinc.","In 2024, Young Poong teamed up with billionaire Michael Kim's private equity firm, MBK Partners, and launched an unsolicited takeover bid for Korea Zinc.","Since then, Young Poong has been locked in an intense ownership battle with the Choi family."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chang Jianming chairs Shanghai Moons, a maker of industrial equipment for the automotive industry.","Moons went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2017.","The company was founded in Shanghai in 1994 and employs more than 3,000 people."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chang Jing chairs Beijing Roborock Technology, which makes robotic sweeping and mopping devices and handheld cordless stick vacuums.","Chang founded Roborock, which is based in Beijing, in 2014.","Roborock's shareholders include China smartphone heavyweight Xiaomi.","Chang worked for Microsoft, Tencent and Baidu before setting up Roborock."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chang Kuo-Cheng is the third son of shipping tycoon Chang Yung Fa, who died in 2016 at the age of 88.","In 1968 Yung Fa founded Evergreen Marine, now one of the world's largest transportation companies.","Brothers Kuo-Hua, Kuo-Ming and Kuo-Cheng also inherited stakes in EVA Airways and hotels in Taiwan, mainland China, Paris and Bangkok."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chang Kuo-Hua is the oldest son of shipping tycoon Chang Yung Fa, who died in 2016 at the age of 88.","In 1968 Yung Fa founded Evergreen Marine, now one of the world's largest transportation companies.","Brothers Kuo-Hua, Kuo-Ming and Kuo-Cheng also inherited stakes in EVA Airways and hotels in Taiwan, mainland China, Paris and Bangkok.","Kuo-Hua sits on the board of Evergreen Marine."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chang Kuo-Ming is the second son of shipping tycoon Chang Yung Fa, who died in 2016 at the age of 88.","In 1968 Yung Fa founded Evergreen Marine, now one of the world's largest transportation companies.","Brothers Kuo-Hua, Kuo-Ming and Kuo-Cheng also inherited stakes in EVA Airways and hotels in Taiwan, mainland China, Paris and Bangkok."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Changpeng Zhao, who goes by CZ, is the founder and former CEO of Binance, the largest cryptocurrency exchange in the world.","The Chinese-Canadian coder cut his teeth building high-frequency trading systems for Wall Street's flash boys.","Zhao founded Binance in 2017 and still owns an estimated 90% of the exchange plus a stash of its BNB tokens.","In November 2023, Zhao stepped down as Binance's CEO as part of a sweeping settlement with U.S. authorities.","Zhao pleaded guilty to failing to maintain an effective anti-money laundering program, paid a $50 million fine and served four months in prison.","He was pardoned in October 2025 by Donald Trump, whose crypto businesses have had extensive dealings with Binance."]
abouts: ["Zhao was born in Jiangsu, China. His father, a professor, was labeled a pro-bourgeois intellect and temporarily exiled shortly after CZ was born.","As a teenager in Vancouver, CZ pitched in to cover the household expenses, flipping burgers at McDonald's and working overnight shifts at a gas station."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chao Chung-Hsin is the chairman of Jentech Precision Industrial, a supplier of cooling devices and other components for semiconductors.","Its products are used in areas such as computers, AI servers and electric vehicles.","A high school dropout, Chung-Hsin acquired industrial molding techniques by working in factories and started his own module business in 1978.","He brought in his younger brother Yung-Tsang, now vice chairman, to cofound Jentech in 1987.","In the early stages Chung-Hsin oversaw R&D as well as business operation; Yung-Tsang took charge of finance."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chao Teng-hsiung started Farglory Land, one of Taiwan's largest real estate developers, in 1978 and is still its largest shareholder.","Farglory Land is the flagship unit of Farglory Group, whose interests include financial and retail services, air-cargo logistics and hospitality.","Chao also controls Farglory FTZ Investment Holding, Farglory Life Insurance and Farglory Hotel.","Eldest son Wen-Chia, also known as Frank, took over as Farglory Land chairman in 2014 amid a corruption scandal involving Chao.","In 2022 a Taipei court sentenced Chao to seven years in prison on bribery and corruption charges on the first trial. The second trial is still ongoing."]
abouts: ["Born into poverty in western Taiwan, Chao moved to Taipei in 1966 and did odd jobs. He saved money to supply cement to construction firms.","Over time he bought property and developed his own projects, starting out with buildings that combined factories and offices."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chao Yung-Tsang is vice chairman of Jentech Precision Industrial, a supplier of cooling devices and components.","Its products are used in areas such as computers, AI servers, electric vehicles and semiconductors.","He cofounded Jentech in 1987 with older brother Chung-Hsin, now chairman of the company.","In the early stages Chung-Hsin oversaw R&D as well as business operation; Yung-Tsang took charge of finance."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charlene de Carvalho-Heineken is one of the richest women in the world, thanks to her nearly 24% stake in beer giant Heineken.","She inherited the Heineken stake in 2002 from her late father, longtime CEO Freddy Heineken.","Charlene, husband Michel de Carvalho, sons Charles and Alexander de Carvalho and daughter Louisa Brassey all sit on Heineken boards.","Charlene's mother, Martha Lucille Heineken-Cummins, died on Christmas Eve of 2020."]
abouts: ["Charlene's great-grandfather Gerard Adriaan Heineken opened a brewery in Amsterdam more than 150 years ago.","Heineken sells over 300 brands of beer and cider across the globe including Red Stripe and Lagunitas."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charles Johnson is the second largest shareholder in Franklin Resources, a global investment management firm also known as Franklin Templeton Investments.","Johnson became CEO at age 24 in 1957, a decade after his father, Rupert Johnson Sr., founded the company.","Johnson spent 56 years at the company before handing over the chairman's post to his son, Gregory, in 2013.","His daughter Jennifer, a champion of the company's data science capabilities and fintech initiatives, became CEO in 2020.","Under his leadership, the firm's assets under management rose from $2.5 million in 1957 to more than $800 billion when he retired.","In 2012, Johnson and his wife donated their historic, 67,000-square-foot Carolands Chateau in Hillsborough, California to the Carolands Foundation."]
abouts: ["Charles' father Rupert named the company after Benjamin Franklin, who he believed epitomized the ideas of frugality and prudence in regard to saving and investing.","Charles also owns an estimated 26% stake in the San Francisco Giants baseball team."]
title: Former Chairman and CEO

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charles Beauduin controls the textile machinery company Vandewiele and 25% of listed company Barco, which specializes in high-end digital projection, imaging, and networking solutions.","The Beauduin family has its roots in the sugar industry and sold sugar factory Tiense Suiker to Germany's Südzucker in 1989.","In 1993 Beauduin took over Vandewiele group, which was founded in 1880 as a machinery servicing company and converted into a weaving machine manufacturer by Michel Van de Wiele in 1921.","The company produces textile machinery for flooring, home linen and fashion under brands that include Titan, Aros, Loepfe and Eutron."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["In 2000, Charles Bronfman and his nephew Edgar Bronfman Jr. sold their family's spirits and alcohol giant Seagram to Vivendi for $30 billion.","His father Samuel Bronfman, a Russian immigrant to Canada, started a small distillery in 1924 and eventually bought out competitor Seagram.","Since the sale, Charles, who once co-chaired Seagram, has turned toward philanthropy, authoring two books on the matter and signing The Giving Pledge.","Bronfman has given away or pledged at least $350 million, mostly toward promotion of Canadian culture and the Jewish community's connection to Israel.","Bronfman's son, Stephen, runs Claridge, the Montreal-based private investment firm that Charles founded in 1987."]
abouts: ["Bronfman is one of the main benefactors of Taglit-Birthright Israel, which sends Jewish youth from North America on free educational tours of Israel.","Bronfman's daughter Ellen and her husband Andrew Hauptman own the major league soccer team the Chicago Fire. \r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charles Butt is chairman of H-E-B, a Texas-based grocery chain with $50 billion in revenues.","He started working for the family-owned business bagging groceries at age 8.","Florence Butt, his grandmother, founded the company in 1905 after her husband was diagnosed with tuberculosis and was unable to work.","Charles became chairman and CEO in 1971. He handed the CEO job to nephew Howard Butt III in 2021. Howard is also on the board of directors","Sister Eleanor Butt Crook is on the board of directors, and nephew Stephen Butt is H-E-B's president of Shareholder Relations and its Central Market Division and a member of the board."]
abouts: ["H-E-B gives 5% of pretax profits to charity.","H-E-B is one of the largest private employers in Texas, with 160,000 employees.","In 2015, Charles implemented an employee stock ownership program that provides company stock ownership to over 100,000 employees of H-E-B."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charles Edelstenne cofounded Dassault Systemes, aviation giant Dassault's software and consulting arm, in 1981.","Today he and his family own around 6% of French-listed Dassault Systemes; he retired as chairman of the board in 2023.","A qualified accountant, Edelstenne started working at Dassault Aviation in 1960 as the aircraft manufacturer's chief financial officer.","He has served in a variety of leadership positions at Dassault, including CEO stints at both Dassault Systemes and Dassault Aviation.","He stepped down from his position as head of the Dassault family holding company on his 87th birthday in 2025."]
abouts: ["Following patriarch Serge Dassault's death in 2018, Edelstenne was named head of the Dassault Group."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charlie Ergen is the cofounder and chairman of satellite and internet service company EchoStar.","Ergen first began selling satellite dishes out of the back of a truck in Colorado in 1980.","In 1995, EchoStar went public and also launched its first satellite, birthing pay TV subsidiary Dish Network.","Ergen spun off Dish into a separate company in 2008 and remerged the businesses in December 2023, again under the EchoStar name.","Today, the company has more than 7 million pay TV subscribers."]
abouts: ["Ergen is the son of an Austrian-born nuclear physicist who worked at the Oak Ridge National Laboratory in Tennessee.","Ergen is an avid mountain climber who has reached the Mount Everest base camp."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charles Koch has been chairman of Koch, Inc., America's second largest private company by revenue, since 1967. He brought on his first ever co-CEO in 2023.","The diversified company has some $125 billion in revenues from businesses including pipelines, chemicals, software, automotive components and Dixie cups. ","His father, Fred Koch, improved a method of refining heavy oil into gasoline in 1927 and started the family business in 1940.","In 1983, Charles and his brother David (d. 2019) bought out their siblings Bill and Frederick (d. 2020) for a reported $800 million. David's widow Julia Koch inherited his 42% stake.","From 2020 to 2022, Charles transferred $5.3 billion of Koch, Inc.'s nonvoting stock to a pair of nonprofits with fewer restrictions on lobbying and politics than traditional charities.","Forbes estimates those shares accounted for nearly a tenth of the 42% stake previously held by Charles (though he still has 42% voting power)."]
abouts: ["Three Koch brothers (Charles, David and Bill) went to MIT; the trio were in the Beta Theta Pi fraternity and David and Charles played on the same club rugby team.  \r\n","Koch founded Stand Together, a network of nonprofits and donors focused on philanthropic and political advocacy causes, in 2003.","Charles' son, Chase Koch, founded venture capital subsidiary Koch Disruptive Technologies, which has invested more than $4 billion in 70-plus companies."]
bio: Billionaire Charles Koch isn't high on consuming cannabis himself, but the devout libertarian believes it should be legal and he's putting his name, and nearly $25 million of his $45 billion fortune, toward influencing criminal-justice reform and legalization.

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charles Liang and his wife Sara Liu founded AI server and storage maker Super Micro Computer Inc. (commonly known as Supermicro) in 1993. ","Liang has served as CEO, president and chairman of the board at Supermicro since the company's founding; Liu is senior vice president.","Headquartered in San Jose, California, Supermicro is a major supplier of Nvidia for AI server design outsourcing.","Liang was born in the southern city of Chiayi, Taiwan."]
abouts: ["Liang holds several patents for his server technologies.","Liang is the founder and CEO of the Green Earth Foundation, which aims to combat deforestation."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charles Schwab is co-chairman and founder of the brokerage firm that bears his name.","The company averages more than 11 million trades per day across 40 million client accounts worth $13 trillion.","Schwab was CEO of the business until 2008 and still owns more than 5% of its stock.","He founded the firm as a traditional brick-and-mortar brokerage in 1971, with $100,000 borrowed from his uncle.","The business really took off when Schwab started charging half of what full-service brokers did, after an SEC deregulation of brokerage commissions."]
abouts: ["An avid collector of modern and contemporary art, Schwab once chaired the board of the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art.","Schwab, who found out that he's dyslexic when his son was diagnosed, donates to support research in learning differences.","Schwab's initial venture into the investing world was through a subscriber-based newsletter, the Investment Indicator, that Schwab founded with friends in 1963."]
title: Chairman and Founder

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Early Microsoft employee Charles Simonyi is the man behind some of the company's most successful software, including Word and Excel.","The developer has a Ph.D. in computer science from Stanford and worked on one of the first personal computers at Xerox.","He joined Microsoft, then a fledgling firm, as employee No. 40 in 1981 and spent two decades in application development.","A native of Hungary, he left Microsoft in 2002 and founded Intentional Software, which develops platforms for productivity apps.","Microsoft acquired Intentional Software in 2017 for an undisclosed price, bringing Simonyi back to the Redmond, Washington giant."]
abouts: ["Simonyi paid $60 million to jet to the International Space Station on a Russian rocket in 2007 and 2009, making him the first tourist to have visited space twice.","Simonyi worked as a night watchman in a computer lab as a teenager, which allowed him to use the machines after everyone had left."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charles Zegar is one of four billionaire cofounders of financial information and media giant Bloomberg LP.","Zegar, who got a computer science degree at NYU, built the first software for Bloomberg LP's terminals.","The son of a subway conductor, he was widowed as a young man and remarried in 2001.","He and his current wife, Merryl Snow Zegar, donate to Jewish causes and inner-city education via their Zegar Family Foundation."]
abouts: ["Zegar is a signatory of the Giving Pledge, a promise to donate at least half of his wealth to charitable causes."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charlie Mills is chairman of Illinois-based medical supplies giant Medline, which his father and uncle founded in 1966.  ","Mills and his extended family, which includes four other billionaires, own roughly 18% of the company, which IPO'd on the Nasdaq in December 2025 and ended its first trading day with a market cap of more than $55 billion. ","The Mills family previously sold 79% of Medline to a group of private equity firms in a leveraged buyout that valued the company at more than $30 billion in 2021.","Charlie Mills served as Medline's CEO for 26 years until 2023, while his cousin Andy Mills served as president during that same period. Andy Mills also still sits on the company's board. ","Andy Mills' brother-in-law Jim Abrams served as chief operating officer of Medline from 1997 to 2023. The company is now run by non-family executives. "]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Campbell Soup Co. heir Charlotte Colket Weber served on the company's board from 1990 until 2014.","Her billionaire cousin, Mary Alice Dorrance Malone, is still a director. Her other billionaire cousin, Bennett Dorrance, stepped down from the board in 2022.","Their grandfather, John T. Dorrance, invented the condensed soup formula that turned the company into a global soup giant.","Weber is a devoted equestrian and owns the Live Oak Stud Farm, a 4,500-acre horse farm and commercial cattle operation near Ocala, Florida.","She is also an avid collector of Chinese art, a passion that reportedly began when her uncle gave her a rare porcelain K'ang-hsi frog in the 1970s."]
abouts: ["Weber is a trustee at New York's Metropolitan Museum of Art and provided funding for the Charlotte C. Weber Galleries for the Arts of Ancient China.","Weber races horses through her organization Live Oak Plantation.\r\n"]
title: Director

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charlotte Goh is a granddaughter of the late Singaporean paints tycoon Goh Cheng Liang, who died in August 2025 at age 98.","The Goh family draws the bulk of its wealth from a majority stake in Japan's Nippon Paint Holdings, one of the world's largest paint manufacturers.","Charlotte, together with her two sisters and three cousins, inherited the bulk of their grandfather's fortune.","Her father is Hup Jin, the eldest child of the late patriarch who started making paints in a small factory in Singapore before partnering with Nippon Paint in 1962.","Hup Jin is the chairman of Nippon Paint."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charlotte S'derstr?m is the daughter of Sweden's richest person, Stefan Persson, chairman of global cheap chic retailer H&M, where she holds a stake.","Her grandfather Erling Persson founded the chain in 1947.","Brother Karl-Johan is set to be appointed chairman at the annual shareholders meeting in 2020.","Brother Tom Persson and aunt Lottie Tham are also billionaires.","S'derstr?m works on H&M sponsorships and runs a stud farm."]
abouts: ["S'derstr?m is reportedly the owner of the horse H&M All In, which won a silver medal at the 2016 Olympics."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Charlwin Mao is the CEO of  Shanghai-headquartered social and e-commerce platform Xiaohongshu.","Mao co-founded the company with Miranda Qu in 2013.","Earlier in his career, he worked at Bain Consulting and Bain Capital."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Son of a Bangkok street vendor, Charoen Sirivadhanabhakdi controls Thai Beverage, Thailand's largest beverage producer and distributor by revenue, known for its Chang beer.","Other big assets include Singapore beverage and property giant Fraser & Neave.","Charoen's retail empire includes hypermarket chain Big C Supercenter, acquired in 2016 for more than $6 billion.","Charoen listed his privately held property unit, Asset World, in October 2019 and continues to hold a majority stake. It has hotels in tourist hotspots such as Bangkok, Phuket, Krabi and Pattaya.","In 2025, Charoen transferred shares in key companies to his five children."]
abouts: ["Charoen's son Panote, who looks after the property interests, is overseeing One Bangkok, a $4 billion mixed-use development in the heart of Bangkok.","Charoen took ThaiBev public in Singapore in 2006 after attempts to list in Thailand were derailed by protests against the promotion of alcohol."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chase Coleman III started out as a hedge fund investor, but his Tiger Global Management has evolved into a broader investment firm.","Tiger Global Management oversees $50 billion in assets. Its venture capital arm is now its biggest unit.","Prior to starting Tiger Global in 2001, Coleman worked for hedge fund legend Julian Robertson.","His longtime partner Scott Shleifer joined Tiger Global in 2002 and cofounded its venture business, which he led until the start of 2024.","Tiger Global's hedge fund fell more than 50% in 2022 after an impressive first two decades. It rebounded 20% in 2023 and 2024."]
abouts: ["Coleman is a descendant of Peter Stuyvesant, the last Dutch governor of New York."]
title: Founder

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Fund manager Cheah Cheng Hye is co-chairman of Hong Kong-listed Value Partners Group.","He cofounded the asset-management company in 1993, and listed it in 2007.","After graduating from Penang Free School, he worked as a subeditor and writer at The Star newspaper in Malaysia.","In 1974, he traveled to Hong Kong, where he had stints in financial journalism at the Far Eastern Economic Review and the Asian Wall Street Journal.","He worked at Morgan Grenfell Group in Hong Kong before starting Value Partners."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Ailian chairs Zhejiang Wanfeng Auto Wheel, a supplier of aluminum alloy wheels for automobiles.","Chen is the wife of former billionaire Wu Liangding, who founded Wanfeng Auto Holdings Group.","Its customers include BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Land Rover, GM, Ford, Volkswagen, Toyota, Honda, Nissan and Hyundai, among others.","In 1994, Chen founded an aluminum wheel factory in Shaoxing, in Zhejiang province, the predecessor of Wanfeng Auto Holding Group.","She led Wanfeng's acquisitions of Meridian in Canada, Paslin in the U.S. and a Canadian aircraft manufacturing project."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Bang is the chairman of Aier Eye Hospital Group, China's largest ophthalmology chain by the number of outlets."," The Changsha-based company operates more than 800 eye hospitals and centers in China, Europe, Southeast Asia and the U.S.","Already traded on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, Aier in May 2026 filed for a dual listing in Hong Kong. ","Chen dabbled in property and beverage distribution until meeting a retired ophthalmologist, who inspired him to open his own hospitals."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Bangdong is vice chairman of Sieyuan Electric, a provider of electrical solutions and services.","Chen has worked at the company since 1993.","The company went public in 2004.","The company has 9,456 employees."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Baozhen derives her wealth from Shenzhen-listed Internet service platform provider Wangsu Science.","Chen started working for an electrical instrument factory in Fujian Province in 1960 and stayed there for 30 years. In 2000 she cofounded the predecessor to Wangsu Science.","Chen sold a substantial part of her stake in Wangsu Science & Technology between 2018 and 2020."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Dongsheng is the founder and chairman of Taikang Insurance Group, one of China's largest insurers.","Taikang also has interests in asset management as well as health and elderly care.","Chen's wife is the granddaughter of Mao Zedong, the communist revolutionary who became the founding father of the People's Republic of China.","Early in his career, Chen worked as deputy editor of Management World, a publication of the Development Research Center of China's State Council.","His son Chen Yilun became the chairman of group asset management unit Taikang Fund Management in 2024."]
abouts: ["Chen holds an undergraduate degree and a Ph.D. in political economics from Wuhan University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Fashu chairs New Huadu Group, a holding company which he founded in 1998 after several business ventures including timber trading and retail.\t","Through New Huadu Group, Chen holds stakes in Yunnan Baiyao (a pharmaceutical company) and Longi Green Energy.","Chen became an avid investor after reaping a large return with stakes in Zijin Minging Group, a gold miner.","Chen is also on the board of Shanghai Pharmaceuticals Holding.","He is a native of China's Fujian Province, northeast of Hong Kong."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Guodong draws his wealth from a stake in Chinese jewelry maker Laopu Gold.","Dubbed by consumers as \"Hermes of gold jewelry,\" the luxury brand features traditional Chinese design and craftsmanship.","It went public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2024.","An individual investor, Chen also made investments in real estate, IT and biotech. He worked for over two decades at China's IT conglomerate Legend Holdings until 2016.","He held a teaching post for four years at Renmin University of China after graduating there with a master's degree in economics and management."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Hua chairs Kingkey Group, a Shenzhen-based conglomerate with interests in industries such as agriculture, finance and real estate.","One of Kingkey's best-known projects is KK100, a 100-storey skyscraper in Shenzhen towering 442 meters high.","Before founding Kingkey in 1994, Chen Hua worked as a construction worker in the southern province of Hainan together with brother Chen Hui.","His son Jiarong is a director of Kingkey's agriculture arm; younger son Jiajun is an executive director of the group's Hong Kong-listed arm Kingkey Financial International.","The family also owns stakes in smartphone maker Coolpad and photo editing app developer Meitu, both listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Huwen is the chairman and a co-founder of Shanghai M&G Stationary Inc.","M&G Stationary was founded in 1996.","Chen holds an EMBA degree and has been involved in stationery manufacturing since 1997."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Huxiong is the vice chairman and president of Shanghai M&G Stationary Inc.","M&G Stationary was founded in 1996.","Chen's brother Chen Huwen is M&G's chairman and a fellow billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Jiancheng is group chairman of Wolong Group, a manufacturer of motors, generators and drive controls; the multinational company also has interests in renewable energy and related resources.\r\n","The group's subsidiaries include three public companies, Wolong Electric Drive Group, Wolong New Energy Group and Brook Crompton Holdings.","Chen's daughter Yanni is chairman and CEO of Wolong Holding Group; his son-in-law, Pang Xinyuan, chairs Wolong Electric Drive Group and Brook Crompton."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Jianhua is the chairman of Hengli Group, one of China's largest petrochemical businesses that also has interests in tourism and property development.","Chen's wife Fan Hongwei, also a billionaire, is the chairman of the group's listed arm Hengli Petrochemical. ","Born into an impoverished family, Chen quit school at the age of 13.He later made his fortune trading textiles and acquired a state-owned chemical fiber factory before expanding into petrochemicals.","Hengli also has one of the world's largest shipbuilding businesses. In 2025, it merged the unit with Shanghai-listed Guangdong Songfa Ceramics through a backdoor listing. ","The couple's son, Chen Hanlun, is the CEO of Guangdong Songfa, which has exited the ceramics business altogether. Their daughter, Chen Yiting, once led its tourism arm."]
abouts: ["One of Hengli Petrochemical's subsidiaries was sanctioned by the U.S. in 2026 for acquiring illicit Iranian crude -- an allegation the company denies."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Jinghong chairs Huada Automotive Technology, a Shanghai-listed auto parts company based in Jiangsu province.","Chen was the head of a furniture factory, which became the predecessor of Huada, before the company entered into the auto parts business in the 1990s.","His son-in-law Ge Jianghong is CEO of the company."]

name: Billionaires
bios:
["Chen Jinxia is the widow of entrepreneur Wei Dong, who committed suicide in 2008. 
","Chen inherited a controlling interest in Hunan Yongjin Group, which was founded by her late husband and owns shares in drug makers.","Chen graduated from Shanghai University of Finance & Economics

"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Kaixuan is vice chairman of Guangzhou-headquartered Liby Group, a supplier of washing detergents and soap.","Chen co-founded Liby in 1994 with his brother Chen Kaixuan, who is also a billionaire.","His daughter Danxia chairs Cheerwin Group, a Hong Kong-listed consumer and pet products company invested by Chen Kaixuan."]

name: Billionaires
bios:
["Chen Kaixuan chairs Guangzhou-headquartered Liby Group.

","Liby Group manufactures washing powder, washing detergent, washing soap, and washing liquid products.

","Chen set up Liby with his brother, Chen Kaichen, in 1994.

"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Qingzhou chairs Hytera Communications, a manufacturer of radio communications equipment.\r\n","Early in his career, Chen worked at a mobile radio communications factory as a sales manager in Fujian Province. \r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Qiongxiang's fortune arises from her stake in Contemporary Amperex Technology, a supplier of batteries for electric vehicles founded in 2011.","Contemporary Amperex, also known as CATL, listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in June 2018.","CATL is headquartered in the southeast Chinese city of Ningbo."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Qixing is the chairman of Shenzhen Everwin Precision Technology, a Shenzhen-listed electronics component manufacturer. \r\n","Chen was a government official in Anhui Province before becoming an entrepreneur.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Shibin chairs Jiangsu Pacific Quartz, a supplier of quartz material for the lighting and solar industries.","Pacific Quartz went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2014.","Pacific Quartz is headquartered in the eastern Chinese city of Lianyungang."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Shiliang is the chairman of Tongkun Group, a supplier of textile products under the \"Golden Cock\" brand.","Tongkun Group's predecessor business was a county-owned chemical fiber plant.","Chen took charge of the small collective chemical fiber business in 1991 when it went into bankruptcy.","Chen and other managers were granted shares of Tongkun in 1999 when the company reorganized."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Tao is the chairman of Victory Giant Technology, which specializes in printed circuit boards.","The company's products are widely used in artificial intelligence, data centers, automobiles, aerospace, medical devices and industrial industries.","Prior to his entrepreneurial journey, Chen served as an officer in the People's Armed Police.","His brother Chen Yong is a director and vice president at the company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Tei-Fu and his wife, Oi-Lin Chen, cofounded herbal-products maker Sunrider, which is now led by their five children.","Sunrider products are distributed in nearly 50 countries through a mix of franchises and company-owned stores.","He owns Sunworld-branded hotels in Beijing; the SLS Hotel in Beverly Hills, California; and St. Ermin's Hotel in London.","Chen's vast collection of Chinese art is on display at Sunrider headquarters in Torrance, California, near Los Angeles."]
abouts: ["In 1975 he was a starving college student in Utah, buying 20-cent hamburgers by the bunch at a weekly promotion so he could freeze them to eat later on.","His given name, Tei-Fu, means \"receiving a fortune.\" He says his 19 grandchildren are his biggest fortune."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Tianshi is the chairman and CEO of chipmaker Cambricon Technologies, sometimes dubbed China's Nvidia.","Before cofounding Cambricon in 2016, he worked for the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Institute of Computing Technology as a researcher.","The institute still owns a minority stake in Cambricon.","Chen holds a Ph.D. from the University of Science and Technology of China."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Weiliang is the chairman and CEO of Chinese semiconductor company MetaX Integrated Circuits Shanghai.","The company went public in Shanghai in December 2025, raising $593 million. It applied in June 2026 for a listing in Hong Kong. ","MetaX's products are used in sectors including digital twins, smart city and self driving.","Chen worked as a senior executive for chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) in China for 13 years before founding MetaX in 2020."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Wenyuan chairs HYC Technology, a supplier of testing equipment for LCD, semiconductor and new energy electronics businesses.","HYC listed on China's new STAR market for innovative companies on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on July 22, 2019","His wife Zhang Qian cofounded the predecessor business of HYC in 2005."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Xuahua is founder and chairman of Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt, one of China's largest mining-related businesses.","Huayou is a supplier of cobalt and nickel products to the world's EV industry.","Huayou agreed in 2022 to join with Ford and Vale Indonesia in a nickel chemicals extraction project in Indonesia."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Xueli is the chairman of Weigao Holding Company, a supplier to the healthcare industry. \r\n","Chen co-founded his first disposable infusion business in an old warehouse in China in 1988.","His main publicly listed business is Shangdong Weigao Group Medical Polymer, which trades at the Hong Kong Stock Exchange."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Yuantai is secretary of the party committee at Contemporary Amperex Technology.","Contemporary Amperex Technology, also known as CATL, is a battery supplier to the EV industry.","CATL is headquartered in the southeastern China city of Ningde."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Yung-tai got his start selling office clocks in 1965. He later expanded into office equipment, furniture and electronics.","Today his listed Aurora Corp., chaired by wife Yuan Hui-Hua since 2018, sells electronics in over 1,500 locations in Taiwan and mainland China.","Aurora also owns real estate, including a 38-story tower, in Shanghai's Lujiazui financial district.","Chen studied economics in college. That department is now part of National Taipei University."]
abouts: ["Chen was born into a well-off family but worked as a small trader and street merchant after his father died in his youth.","Chen founded the Aurora Museum in Shanghai, known for its Buddhist sculptures and jade."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Zhiping is the chairman and CEO of Smoore International Holdings, a supplier of vaping devices, and China's first vaping billionaire.","Smoore supplies components for vaping devices to Japan Tobacco, British American Tobacco and NJOY.","It went public in 2020, raising more than $900 million on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.","Expanding its technology into more scenarios, the company diversified into inhalation therapy and beauty treatment in 2024."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chen Zhisong is co-founder and chairman of Yealink Network Technology, a supplier of video conferencing solutions and Internet phones.","Yealink vice chairman Wu Zhongyi has also been a billionaire in recent years.","Yealink is headquartered in the eastern Chinese city of Xiamen."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cheng Lili chairs Jiangsu Lihua Animal Husbandry, a chicken breeder and supplier of poultry feed.","Lihua debuted at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on Feb. 28, 2019, after raising $171 million in an IPO.","Lihua is headquarterd in the eastern Chinese city of Changzhou."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cheng Xianfeng chairs Yifan Pharmaceutical, which supplies ingredients for skin and healthcare products, as well as feed additives.","Yifan has approvals for the sale of more than 300 drugs across therapeutic areas such as gynecology, pediatrics and dermatology.","Yifan has research centers in San Francisco, Shanghai, Beijing, Hangzhou and Hefei."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cheng Xue is the vice chairwoman and CEO of Foshan Haitian Flavoring & Food Company, one of the largest makers of condiments in China.","She joined the company in 1990 and previously served as its director of corporate planning and vice president.","Cheng owns more than 12% of the company, which is chaired by fellow billionaire Pang Kang."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cheng is the cofounder of Kuaishou, a short video platform headquartered in Beijing.","The company went public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in February 2021.","Pre-IPO strategic investors included funds managed by Fidelity and BlackRock.","Kuaishou cofounder Su Hua is also a billionaire.","Cheng, the CEO, succeeded Su and added the role of chairman in October 2023."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cheng Zhangwen is a director of Neway Valve (Suzhou).","Cheng co-founded the company in 1997 with Wang Baoqing, Lu Bin and Xi Chao.","The company went public in 2014.","The company has subsidiaries in the United States, Dubai, the Netherlands, Italy, Singapore and Nigeria."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cheng Zhenghui is the founder of APT Medical, a supplier of medical devices.","APT is headquartered in the southern Chinese business hub Shenzhen.","APT went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2021.","Cheng stepped down as chairman in April 2025."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chey Ki-won is the younger sister of SK Group chairman Chey Tae-Won.","Her stake in SK Holdings accounts for most of her wealth.","She chairs SK's Happiness Sharing Foundation, which conducts educational programs for poor children and sets up and runs social enterprises."]
abouts: ["Since 2006, her Happiness Sharing Foundation has provided more than 40 million lunch boxes to starving children.","The foundation also invests in social entrepreneurship."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chey Tae-won is the chairman of SK Group, one of Korea's largest conglomerates with interests in telecom, semiconductors, chemicals and energy, among others.","The group's SK Telecom is South Korea's No. 1 mobile carrier with nearly 50% market share; its SK Hynix is the world's second-largest memory chipmaker by sales.","In 2013 he was convicted of misappropriating company funds but was later pardoned by then-president Park Geun-hye and returned to his post in 2016.","Chey is a nephew of SK Group founder Chey Jong-gun, who started the conglomerate with a textile company called Sunkyong."]
abouts: ["While in jail, he authored a book on social enterprises.","Chey filed for divorce from his wife, a daughter of former South Korean President Roh Tae-woo in 2017. In 2024, Chey was ordered to pay $1 billion to his ex-wife."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chi Yufeng chairs Shenzhen-listed online games firm Perfect World.","Chi holds an undergraduate degree in chemistry from prestigious Tsinghua University and a MBA from CEIBS. \r\n","He is also known as Michael Chi."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chin Jong Hwa is the largest shareholder of Hong Kong-listed auto-parts supplier Minth Group, which he started in 1997.","In 2016, Minth became the first auto-parts maker to receive a permit from China to make electric cars.","Chin stepped down from Minth in 2019. His wife Wei Ching Lien has taken over as chairman and CEO.","Their daughter, Chin Chien Ya, is a non-executive director at Minth. Son William is chief strategy officer and executive director.","Minth owns more than 70 factories globally, and is building new facilities in India and Serbia."]
abouts: ["Chin once worked as a counselor at China Youth Corps, a youth organization in Taiwan."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Dennis \"Chip\" Wilson is the founder and former CEO of Lululemon, which he started with a single store in Vancouver in 2000.","He took the athleisure company public in 2007 but resigned as chairman in 2013 and removed himself from the business completely in 2015.","Although Wilson has no management role at Lululemon, he remains its biggest individual shareholder with a 7% stake.","Wilson, his wife and five sons now operate a holding company called Hold It All, which invests in apparel, real estate and private equity.","He has stakes in Chinese activewear company Anta Sports and Amer Sports, which owns brands like Salomon, Arc'teryx and Wilson."]
abouts: ["The son of a seamstress, Wilson's first retail venture was Westbeach Snowboard, which he started in 1979 to sell apparel for surfers, skaters and snowboarders.","While studying at the University of Calgary, Wilson took a break and worked on the Alaskan oil pipelines for 18 months."]
title: Chairman

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Pharma tycoon Chirayu Amin's Alembic Pharmaceuticals is one of India's oldest pharma companies.","Alembic was founded by Amin's grandfather in 1907 to make tincture and alcohol. \r\n","Today, Alembic gets more than a third of its annual revenue from the domestic market selling generic drugs, including popular cough syrup Glycodin.","While Amin is chairman and chief executive, his three sons work in different parts of the business."]
abouts: ["Amin is the brother-in-law of consumer goods billionaire Harsh Mariwala.","Amin was head of the Indian Premier League for 17 months after its founder Lalit Modi was sacked in 2010."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cho Hyun-beom is chairman of Hankook & Company, the holding company of tire maker Hankook Tire & Technology.","Cho's grandfather, Hong-Je, founded Hankook & Company in 1941.","Cho is the youngest son of Cho Yang-rai, the former chairman of Hankook & Company.","In December 2025, Cho was sentenced by the Seoul High Court to two years in prison for embezzling corporate funds."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cho Hyun-joon is the chairman of Hyosung Group, whose interests include textiles, chemicals and construction.","He is the eldest son of the late former chairman Cho Seok-rae, who stepped down in 2016 and passed away in 2024.","Cho worked at Mitsubishi International and Morgan Stanley before joining Hyosung.","He was sentenced to two years in prison in 2019 for embezzlement; he appealed the conviction. Cho's sentencing was suspended for three years, allowing him to continue running Hyosung."]
abouts: ["Cho's uncle is Hankook Tire honorary chairman Cho Yang-Rai."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cho Jung-ho is the chairman of Meritz Financial Group.","He is the youngest of the four sons of Cho Choong-hoon, the late founder of Hanjin Group, the parent company of Korean Air.","He worked for Korean Airlines in Europe and returned home in 1989 as a director with Hanjin Investment & Securities, as Meritz was then named."]
abouts: ["Cho's father started out with a single truck and went on to build an empire based mostly on transportation.","He has outstripped his brothers in wealth and success; Meritz's value has multiplied since it broke away from the Hanjin Group in 2005."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cho Jyh-jer retired as vice chairman at smartphone chipmaker MediaTek in 2015.","He joined the firm as its president in 1997, when it was spun off from his then employer, United Microelectronics.","The bulk of his wealth comes from his stake in MediaTek."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cho Tak Wong is the founder of Fuyao Glass Industry Group, one of Asia's largest manufacturers of auto glass that counts Audi, Fiat and Ford among its customers.","He stepped down as chairman in October 2025, citing reasons including the need to sustainably develop the company's governance structure. ","His son, Tso Fai, is the new chairman.","Cho is also known for his philanthropic causes. His Heren Charitable Foundation pledged in 2021 $1.6 billion to build the Fuyao University of Science and Technology in China.","The university welcomed its first batch of students in late 2025."]
abouts: ["Cho's hobbies include golfing and collecting art."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Hotel tycoon Choo Chong Ngen made his fortune in textiles before launching his Hotel 81 budget chain in Geylang, Singapore's red-light district.","He has expanded into the mid-tier market, introducing five more hotel brands since 2009.","His privately held hotel empire, now called Worldwide Hotels, which daughter Carolyn has been helping him run since 2002, has 41 hotels across the island.","Since 2017, he has expanded into Australia, Japan, Malaysia, South Korea and Thailand,  with eleven hotels managed by  brands like Travelodge and Holiday Inn.","In 2024, Worldwide Hotels opened the world's largest Mercure hotel with 989 rooms at Singapore's trendy Club Street in the central business district."]
abouts: ["Choo dropped out of school to become a fishmonger to help make ends meet at home.","In 1995, he opened his first Hotel 81 using the unit number of his home at the time."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chow Shing Yuk is cofounder, chairman and CEO of logistics and delivery giant Lalatech Holdings.","It has a presence in 400 cities across Asia, Latin America and EMEA, operating under the brand Huolala in mainland China and as Lalamove outside the region.","Chow was a professional poker player and a consultant at Bain & Co. before he started Lalatech in 2013, betting his poker winnings of $3.8 million.","Lalatech disrupted the logistics industry by digitizing the booking of freight and trucking services, which were traditionally done through call centers.","Lalatech last filed for a Hong Kong IPO in October 2025 after failed attempts since 2023."]
abouts: ["Lalatech's star-studded roster of investors includes HongShan, Hillhouse and Tencent.","Chow was born in mainland China but grew up in Hong Kong, where he lived in a dilapidated wooden house.","Chow scored straight A's in his high school exams and earned a scholarship to study in the U.S."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chris Ellison is a veteran of the Australian mining sector, who draws his wealth from a minority stake in listed Mineral Resources.","The company mines both iron ore and a mineral called spodumene, which contains lithium.","In 2021, Mineral Resources together with U.S. lithium giant Albemarle re-opened the Wodinga mine in the Pilbara, in north-west Australia. It holds 29% of the world's spodumene.","Ellison was appointed non-executive chairman of lithium explorer Delta Lithium in September 2023, after Mineral Resources increased its stake to 23%.","Ellison grew up in a poor family in rural New Zealand where his father was a pig farmer and later worked in a quarry."]
abouts: ["Ellison is New Zealand's honorary consul in the state of western Australia.","Ellison bought fellow mining billionaire Angela Bennett's riverside home in 2009 for A$ 57.5 million."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chris Larsen cofounded Ripple in 2012 to facilitate international payments for banks using blockchain technology.","Ripple counts American Express and Santander among its 100-plus customers.","Larsen stepped down as Ripple CEO in December 2016 but remains executive chairman.","Prior to Ripple, he cofounded online mortgage lender e-Loan in 1996 and Prosper, a peer-to-peer lender, in 2005.","In April 2019, Larsen and his foundation gave $25 million, largely in XRP, to San Francisco State University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chris Lin is the chairman and president of Aspeed Technology, a fabless integrated circuit (IC) designer.","He worked with Taiwan's IC designer Silicon Integrated Systems before founding Aspeed in 2004.","The company listed on the Taipei Exchange in 2013."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Armed with a geology degree, Chris Wallin was the Queensland government's chief coal geologist before starting his company, QCoal, in 1989.","He was a billionaire in 2011 and 2012, before plunging coal prices hammered his fortune. He reappeared on the list of Australia's 50 richest in 2019 after a five-year absence.","He rejoined the billionaire ranks after  QCoal posted a five-fold increase in net profit in 2022 and paid him A$300 million in dividends.","In 2025, QGold launched a takeover bid for shares it did not own in Venus Metals Corp for A$0.21 per share, ending up with a nearly 32% stake after the bid closed in January 2026."]
abouts: ["He's lived in the same house in the suburban Brisbane neighborhood of The Gap for reportedly 30 years.","Wallin also owns a clutch of smaller mining stakes.","In 2024, QCoal's philanthropic arm QCoal Foundation established the Christopher Wallin Prize for Excellence in Geology to support educational opportunities in Queens"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Chris Wanstrath cofounded software development platform GitHub in 2008.","Microsoft acquired the company for $7.5 billion in an all-stock deal in 2018. Wanstrath was the firm's largest individual shareholder.","In 2023, he cofounded a \"developer-friendly\" indie video game publisher called Null.","He serves on the board of the Computer History Museum in Mountain View, CA."]
title: Cofounder

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christian Angermayer invests in life sciences, fintech, AI, psychedelics and cryptocurrencies through his family office Apeiron Investment Group.","He made his first millions cofounding biotech firm Ribopharma with his college professors; he sold his stake when it merged with Alnylam in 2003.","His Malta-based Apeiron owns shares in several publicly traded firms and private companies in the U.S., Germany, Canada and Australia.","His holdings include psychedelics biopharma firm Atai Life Sciences and blockchain holding company Samara, alongside co-investor Mike Novogratz.","He owns an extensive art collection that includes ancient artifacts highlighting the role that psychedelics have played in human history."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christian Birkenstock is an heir to German footwear company Birkenstock, which traces its roots back to 1774.","The company began making its trademark sandals in the 1960s, under the leadership of Christian's father, Karl Birkenstock.","In 2002, Christian and his two brothers, Alex and Stephan, were given control of the company.","Stephan Birkenstock sold his stake to his two brothers in 2013 for an undisclosed amount.","In 2021, the brothers sold Birkenstock to L Catterton and Bernard Arnault's holding company for more than $4.5 billion. Christian rolled forward a stake then worth $300 million."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christian Boehringer owes his fortune to Germany's Boehringer Ingelheim, the world's largest privately-owned pharmaceutical company.","Founded in 1885 by Albert Boehringer, the company supplied ingredients to pharmacies, textile merchants and the food industry, and grew to a workforce of 1,500 by the time of his death.","Today, Boehringer Ingelheim, whose most well-known drugs treat COPD, anti-coagulation and type 2 diabetes, employs 53,000 people and has a presence in 130 markets.","Christian along with 14 members of the family own equal parts of the company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christian Chabot cofounded Tableau, a data analytics and visualization company, in 2003.","He and his cofounders raised $15 million in venture capital before taking Tableau public on the New York Stock Exchange in May 2013.","Chabot was CEO of Tableau until 2016 and chairman of the board until 2019.","Salesforce acquired Tableau in 2019 in a $15.7 billion, all-stock deal.\t","Chabot now focuses most of his time on his two nonprofits: The Holocene Foundation and Washington Neurodiversity Project."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christian Dreyer is one of three family shareholders of Amazonen Werke, a German maker of Agricultural Machinery.","Dreyer owns about half of the Hasbergen, Germany based company, which has annual revenue of about $1 billion.","Amazonen was established in 1883 by his great-grandfather, Heinrich Dreyer, who sold his first plow in 1894 and first cultivator in 1904.","The company has paid shareholder dividends totaling of about 500 million euros since 2005."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christian Haub runs his family's Tengelmann Group, a retail conglomerate that began with a shop opened in Muelheim an der Ruhr in 1867 and today employs more than 70,000.","Its operations include home-improvement chain OBI; clothing and non-food discounter KiK; online retailer babymarkt.de; and food production company No Meat Factory.","The group also invests in startups and is active in services (energy, plus audits and consulting), property management and real estate development.","Older brother Karl-Erivan and Christian had taken over as co-CEOs in 2000. In 2018, Karl-Erivan went missing while on a ski tour. In 2021, he was declared dead.","In 2021 Christian bought an additional stake in Tengelmann 21 from Karl-Erivan's two children, reportedly paying as much as $1.6 billion. He is now its largest shareholder with a 68.67% stake."]
abouts: ["Erivan Haub had strong ties to Tacoma, WA, where his sons were born. He was a major contributor to UW-Tacoma, the Museum of Glass and the LeMay Automobile Museum."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christian Herz owns 45% of the private equity firm Mayfair SE, whose investments have included the sports apparel company Puma.","He is the grandson of Tchibo co-founder Max Herz, who built a fortune based on the importation and sale of coffee.","His father, Guenter, ran Tchibo for almost 35 years. The family also built a stake in skin-care company Beiersdorf, whose brands include Nivea.","Guenter and his sister, Daniela Herz-Schnoeckel, founded Mayfair after they were bought out of the family business in 2003.","As one of Mayfair's managing directors, Christian Herz is active in the shaping investment decisions."]
abouts: ["Italian restaurant operator Vapiano, in which Mayfair had a stake, filed for bankruptcy after all locations in several countries closed in response to the pandemic.","Daniela Herz-Schnoeckel and her children have exited Mayfair, reportedly founding Bilton Holding AG to invest primarily in real estate."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christian Hymer is the son of Erwin Hymer, founder of the Erwin Hymer Group, a German maker of motor homes.\t","Hymer owned about half of the company when it was acquired by Thor in 2018 for $1.7 billion.","Erwin Hymer entered the motorhome business in 1956 and sold his first travel trailer, the Weltbummler, a year later.","The company became publicly traded in 1990 and was take private again in 2013."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christian Latouche is the founder, owner and CEO of Fiducial SA, a global accounting firm with revenue of over $1.8 billion.","A trained auditor and CPA, in 1970 Latouche bought a small accounting business in southern France.","Through acquisitions, he eventually grew it into Fiducial, an accounting and business services giant.","The company has 1,245 offices globally and employs almost 19,000 people.","Fiducial also offers IT and security services."]
abouts: ["Latouche is a recipient of the Legion of Honour, the highest French order of merit for military and civil merits, established in 1802 by Napoleon Bonaparte"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christian Louboutin is a French fashion designer who cofounded his self-named fashion brand, known for its signature red-soled heels.","He started the firm in Paris in 1991 with his friends Bruno Chambelland and Henri Seydoux. In 2021, they sold a 24% stake to Exor, the investment holding company of Italy's Agnelli family, for about $650 million.","His shoes became famous in the U.S. when they were featured by Sarah Jessica Parker's Carrie Bradshaw in Sex and the City and have been name-dropped by Cardi B and Drake.","Today, Louboutin has more than 160 boutiques in 32 countries across 4 continents and also makes men's shoes, bags and beauty products.","In 2023, both Taylor Swift and Beyoncé wore Louboutins in their record-breaking Eras and Renaissance tours."]
abouts: ["Louboutin owns the Vermelho Hotel, a five-star luxury resort in southern Portugal that he opened in 2023.","His homes include the13th-century Château de Champgillon in France, which he co-owns with Bruno Chambelland and where he reportedly keeps 8,000 pairs of shoes."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christian Sinding is a private equity executive and former CEO of EQT, one of the world's largest PE firms.","He joined EQT in 1998 after working as a consultant at McKinsey & Company.","Sinding spent more than two decades helping build EQT into a global buyout powerhouse with investments across Europe, North America and Asia.","He became CEO in 2019, the same year EQT went public on the Stockholm Stock Exchange.","He stepped down as CEO in 2025, and was succeeded by fellow billionaire Per Franzén."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christine Brigitte Knauf is an heir to one of the world's leading producers of building materials and systems, Knauf Gips KG.","Based in Iphofen, Germany, the company employs more than 35,000 people around the world and has annual revenue of over $11 billion.","Its product line includes plasterboards, cement boards and insulating materials.","Knauf Gips dates to 1932, when brothers and mining engineers Alfons and Karl Knauf obtained rights to gypsum deposits in Schengen, Germany.","Their original gypsum factory, on the Moselle River in the border region of Luxembourg, Germany and France, is still the company's production nucleus."]
abouts: ["The family's Knauf Museum, on the premises of a historical inn built in 1688 on Iphofen's market square, houses a renowned collection or ancient relief art."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christiane Schoeller is the only child of Holtzbrinck Publishing Group heir Monika Schoeller, who passed away in 2019. She holds a 50% stake.","Monika and her brothers, Stefan and Dieter von Holtzbrinck, inherited the business, which includes Macmillan Publishers, from their father, Georg.","In 2006, Dieter sold his shares to his siblings, leaving them each with 50% of the company, originally founded as a book club in 1948.","Holtzbrinck's venture investments have included many internet and e-commerce startups, such as Zalando, Groupon, HelloFresh and Rocket Internet.","Christiane and her partner, a former publisher and designer from Stuttgart, keep a low profile."]
abouts: ["Christiane sits on the supervisory board of Holtzbrinck Publishing Group."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christina Flügel is a fifth-generation member of the Mast-Jägermeister family fortune, best known for its green-bottled herbal liquor.","Her brother, Florian Rehm, a fellow German billionaire, chairs the company and serves as its spokesperson.","Mast-Jägermeister was founded in 1878 as a maker of vinegar; it shifted to producing wine and spirits in 1922 before creating the now-famous recipe for Jägermeister."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christina Rohde is the largest shareholder of German technology company, Rohde & Schwarz.","The business, which has annual revenue of more than 3 billion euros, was founded in 1933 by Lothar Rohde and Hermann Schwarz, and is still controlled by heirs from both families.","The company's first product was a portable crystal clock. It now makes equipment for a range of industries, including air travel, broadcasting and security.","The family-owned company has paid dividends totaling more than 2.3 billion euros to its shareholders since 2006."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christine Franken is one of the three daughters of Horst Sartorius, who passed on a 50% stake in biopharmaceutical firm Sartorius AG after his death in 1998.","er great-grandfather Florenz Sartorius founded the firm in 1870 to make analytical balances to measure small mass in laboratories.","Sartorius AG, which went public in 1990, makes pharmaceutical and laboratory equipment.","Today, the company has around 10,600 employees and annual revenue exceeding $2.5 billion."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christine Brigitte Knauf is an heir to one of the world's leading producers of building materials and systems, Knauf Gips KG.","Based in Iphofen, Germany, the company employs more than 35,000 people around the world and has annual revenue of over $11 billion.","Its product line includes plasterboards, cement boards and insulating materials.","Knauf Gips dates to 1932, when brothers and mining engineers Alfons and Karl Knauf obtained rights to gypsum deposits in Schengen, Germany.","Their original gypsum factory, on the Moselle River in the border region of Luxembourg, Germany and France, is still the company's production nucleus."]
abouts: ["The family's Knauf Museum, on the premises of a historical inn built in 1688 on Iphofen's market square, houses a renowned collection or ancient relief art."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christoffel Wiese built his Pepkor retail empire by offering bargain prices in South Africa, later expanding into other African countries.","In 2015, South Africa-based furniture retailer Steinhoff International spent $5.7 billion in cash and stock to acquire Pepkor.","He stepped down as Steinhoff chairman in December 2017 after the company disclosed accounting irregularities. Its share price plummeted and Wiese lost his billionaire status.","Wiese regained his 9-figure fortune 2022 when he settled his dispute with Steinhoff for cash and stock, including a 5% stake in Pepkor.","His most valuable asset is Shoprite, but he also holds stakes in real estate firm Collins Property Group, investment holding company Brait and industrial products distributor Invicta Holdings.","In March 2023, Brait spun off food manufacturer Premier Group in an IPO on the Johannesburg stock exchange; Wiese owns about 47% of the shares."]
abouts: ["Wiese's father owned a sheep and cattle farm and a car dealership.","Wiese studied law at Stellenbosch University but switched gears to go into business."]
title: Chairman

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christoph Boehringer's fortune stems from Boehringer Ingelheim, the world's largest private pharmaceutical company.","Boehringer Ingelheim traces its roots to 1885, when Albert Boehringer started a small factory with 28 employees, making ingredients for pharmacies, textile merchants and the food industry.","By the time of the founder's death the company had a workforce of 1,500.","Today Boehringer Ingelheim employs 53,000 people and has a presence in 130 markets.","Some of its best-selling drugs include those that treat COPD, anti-coagulation and type 2 diabetes.","Christian along with 14 members of the family own equal parts of the company; all of them are part of the third, fourth or fifth generation."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Christoph Henkel is the founding partner of investment firm Canyon Equity.","With brands like Persil, Schwarzkopf and Fa, and over $20 billion in annual revenue, Henkel is among the world's biggest cleaning product companies.","After the death of his father Konrad in 1999, Christoph Henkel inherited his interest in Henkel AG and became the largest single stockholder in the company.","He also invests in tech, biotech and movie-production companies, and has real estate holdings in Europe and the U.S.","Canyon Equity has acquired or developed luxury resorts in Fiji, Utah, Wyoming and New Mexico, with more planned in Costa Rica, Mexico and Malibu, CA."]
abouts: ["Henkel co-founded Los Angeles-based production company Cineville; actors in its films have included Kevin Spacey, Sean Penn and Selma Hayek.","An outdoorsman and active in acquiring land for conservation, he is married to the German art dealer and collector Katrin Bellinger."]
bio:
