bios: ["Lev Kvetnoi has invested in airports, airport services, banking and cement.","Kvetnoi was the largest shareholder in Moscow's Vnukovo Airport, owning 30% of the project, until he sold out in 2013 and quit its board.","In 2011 he expanded his cement holdings by acquiring one of billionaire Elena Baturina's factories in southern Russia."]
abouts: ["For a time Kvetnoi served as chief executive of a company in billionaire Alisher Usmanov's metals group, but he sold out his interests to Usmanov in 2006.","In the early 1990s, Kvetnoi traded computers with an army friend Andrei Skoch, who is now also billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Leyla Tara Suyabatmaz is one of more than a dozen family members who hold shares in ENKA, one of Turkey's largest construction and energy companies.","ENKA, which was cofounded in 1957 by Sarik Tara and his brother-in-law, Sadi Gulcelik, is Turkey's leading private electricity producer and also operates in real estate, tourism, transport and trade (construction equipment and machinery).","In Moscow, ENKA owns a hotel, shopping malls and approximately 370,000 square meters of net rentable Class A office space.","Sadi Gulcelik died in a plane accident in Saudi Arabia in 1980, and Mehmet Sinan Tara took over in 1984 at age 26. His son Agah Mehmet Tara became CEO in 2012, at age 29."]
abouts: ["Over the last 20 years or so, ENKA has been the biggest builder of U.S. consular and embassy buildings.","These government projects can be found in locations ranging from Turkey, Algeria and Nepal to Equatorial Guinea, the Dominican Republic and the Netherlands."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Chunan is a cofounder of Longi Green Energy Technology, one of China's largest manufacturers of solar wafers and modules.","The company's two other cofounders, Li Zhenguo and Zhong Baoshen, are college friends with Chunan from undergraduate days at Lanzhou University.","Li is also the chairman of Linton Technologies, a maker of semiconductor and solar equipment based in the northeastern city of Dalian."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Gaiteng is the founder and chairman of Shanghai Flyco Electrical Appliance, a maker of personal care appliances such as electric razors and hair dryers.","His wife Lin Yu'e is an executive director at Flyco, which is majority owned by Li.","Li started the business after working as a motorcycle repairman."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Ge is the chairman and CEO of Wuxi Apptec, a provider of research and clinical trial services to biotech and pharmaceutical industries worldwide.","Li is also the chairman of biopharma contract research and manufacturing firm WuXi Biologics.","A subsidiary of WuXi Apptec broke ground on a 190-acre pharmaceutical campus in Delaware in 2022.","Li holds a Ph.D. in organic chemistry from Columbia University.","His wife and Wuxi Apptec cofounder Zhao Ning passed away in 2023, at age 56, after battling cancer for 20 years."]
abouts: ["The Ge Li & Ning Zhao Family Foundation donated $20 million to Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center in New York in 2020 to help fight lung cancer."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Guoqiang is a founder and the CEO of Zhongsheng Group, one of China's largest car dealers.","Zhongsheng focuses on luxury and mid-to-high-end brands such as Mercedes-Benz, Lexus, Porsche and Land Rover.","Li and Huang Yi, chairman of Zhongsheng, established Zhongsheng Group in 1998."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Haiyan is a co-founder of  hot-pot chain Haidilao International Holdings; she has been a company supervisor since 2009.","Li is the wife of billionaire Shi Yonghong, a director at Haidilao and chairman of  hotpot seasonings supplier Yihai International.","Haidilao co-founders Li, Zhang Yong, Shu Ping and Shi Yonghong funded their first restaurant with personal savings in 1994.","Haidilao today is one of the most popular restaurant chains in China and has about 1,300 locations worldwide."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Haizhou is chairman of Shenzhen Zhaowei Machinery & Electronics, which he founded in 2001.","The company specializes in designing, developing and manufacturing precision transmission systems.","Its main products include components that are used in automotive, smart home devices, medical technology, robotics and telecommunications.","His wife Xie Yanling is vice chairman of the listed company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Hongjing is chairman and general manager of Shanghai-listed automotive electronic components manufacturer Autel Intelligent Technology.","Li is also the founder and majority shareholder of drone supplier Autel Robotics.","Li holds a MBA from Carnegie Mellon University.","Li once worked at Pittsburgh National Corp. as an strategic analyst."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li chairs Sun Paper, a paper and pulp producer based in Yanzhou, located in the Shandong Province in Eastern China.","Born into a poor peasant family, Li worked at a train station as a porter at the age of 18.","In 1983, he borrowed 30,000 yuan to set up paper producer Sun Paper in his hometown Yanzhou."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Hua, who also goes by Leaf, is the chairman and CEO of Futu Holdings, an online financial services business in China.","The company initially operated a platform for mainland Chinese investors to trade offshore securities such as Hong Kong and U.S.-listed stocks. Its immense popularity later led to government crackdowns amid worries of capital outflow and data security.","Following a 2022 ban that forbade it from signing up new users in mainland China, the company was fined in 2026 $271 million for offering cross-border investments without proper licenses. Li received a personal penalty of $180,000.","The company has been seeking growth in international markets including Malaysia, Singapore and the U.S. It was also ordered to wind down its mainland China business, where investors will only be allowed to sell their holdings for the next two years starting from 2026.","Li founded Futu in 2007, after a seven-year stint at Chinese internet giant Tencent, where he held senior management positions.\r\n\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Jianguo is chairman of China's Runjian Communication, an IT company serving the telecommunications industry with $1.2 billion in sales (2023).","Founded by Li in 2003, today Runjian employs 1,700 engineers  and covers 29 provinces, more than 200 cities and 1,200 counties across China.","Runjian, which has subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Myanmar, Indonesia and the Philippines, also provides its services to the renewable energy market.","Li served in the military before starting the company; he shares his fortune with his wife, Jiang Libei."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Jianli chairs Shenzhen Kedali Industry, a supplier of lithium battery components.","Kedali went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2017.","The company's customers include CATL, BYD, CALB, EVE Energy, Panasonic and LG."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Jianquan chairs Winner Medical, a supplier of disposable wound care and surgical products.","Winner, which began manufacturing cotton-based medical dressings in 1991, went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in September 2020.","The company also makes protective face masks and surgical gowns, as well as bandages and gauze products.","Winner products are sold at more than 40,000 pharmacies across China and in more than 70 countries."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Jiaquan chairs Lomon Group, a chemical supplier.","Li founded the predecessor company of Lomon in Sichuan Province in 1985.","Li sold Lomon's titanium dioxide business to Shenzhen-listed Henan Billions Chemicals  for $1.3 billion in 2016."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Jinyang inherited her fortune after her husband, Zhao Meiguang, died in 2021.","Li has become the main shareholder of Chifeng Jilong Gold Mining, a company with interests in precious metals.","Jilong is based in Inner Mongolia."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Nicknamed Superman, Li Ka-shing is revered as one of the most influential businessmen in Asia.","Li retired as chairman of CK Hutchison Holdings and CK Asset Holdings in 2018 but remains senior advisor.","His son Victor now heads the conglomerate, which has more than 300,000 employees and operates in more than 50 nations.","Li started Cheung Kong Plastics, named after the Yangtze River, in 1950 at age 21 with $6,500 in savings and loans from relatives.","His Li Ka Shing Foundation has donated more than $3.8 billion; over 80% has gone to Greater China."]
abouts: ["Li says it took him five minutes in 2007 to decide to invest in Facebook, even though it barely had any revenues. He also invested in Siri and Spotify.","At age 12, Li fled China with his family. Two years later his father, who had been a primary school principal in China but then worked at a watch factory, died.","At the announcement of his retirement, Li joked that he'd been \"working for a long time, too long.\""]
title: Senior Advisor

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Li is the vice chairman of Shenzhen-listed Aier Eye Hospital Group.","Aier Eye Hospital Group was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in the central Chinese city of Changsha.","The company's chairman, Chen Bang, is also a billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Liangbin chairs Jiangxi Ganfeng Lithium, a manufacturer of lithium battery products that are used in electric vehicles, energy storage, chemicals and pharmaceuticals.","Ganfeng is headquartered in China's Jiangxi Province.","He worked for state-owned Jiangxi Lithium Scientific Research Institute after college and later bought a small Lithium factory, which became the predecessor of Ganfeng Lithium.","Li received a Bauhinia Cup Technology Innovation Award from Hong Kong Polytechnic University in 2013."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Min is the chairman of Rockchip Electronics, a supplier of integrated circuits specializing in the intelligent internet of things (IoT) segment.","Rockchip's clients include Intel, Samsung and Google.","Li cofounded Rockchip in the southern China city of Fuzhou in 2001. Huang Xu, another cofounder, is also a billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Ming is the largest investor in Jinhui Mining, a mining business that went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2022.","Li Ming is also an investor in Jinhui Liquor, a spirits supplier.","Li Ming's family runs firms in real estate, automotive, entertainment, agriculture, retail, and services."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Ping is the vice chairman of Contemporary Amperex Technology (CATL), a supplier of batteries for electric vehicles founded in 2011.","CATL, dual-listed in Hong Kong and Shenzhen, supplies batteries to automakers including BMW, Geely and Tesla.","Despite repeated pushbacks amid geopolitical concerns, a Ford battery factory in Michigan that licenses technologies from CATL has been completed in June 2026."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Qiong is the former wife of online gaming tycoon Zhou Yahui.","Zhou is chairman of Beijing Kunlun Tech, one of China's most successful online game companies.","Li became a billionaire through her divorce settlement.","She holds a degree from Tianjin University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Rucheng chairs China's Youngor Group, which has branched out from garments into real estate and finance.","Li was assigned to work in a collective factory in Ningbo, the precursor to Youngor, in 1980; and became its factory chief in 1982.","Younger employs more than 50,000 people."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li San Yim chairs Longkin Holdings, a construction equipment manufacturer in China.","Li holds an executive MBA from Fudan University in Shanghai.","Li's wife, Ngai Ngan Ying, is non-executive director of the company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Shui-po is the chairman of Kinglai Hygienic Materials, a maker of  food aseptic packaging materials and stainless steel products such as vacuum chambers, pumps and pipe fittings.","Li founded Kinglai in Taiwan in 1991 and moved its headquarters to Kunshan, Jiangsu province in 2000.","The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2011."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Shuirong is the chairman of Zhejiang Rongsheng Holding Group, which has interests in petrochemicals, logistics and real estate.","Li, who previously tried to make a living as a carpenter, started his first business in 1989 after spotting an opportunity in the polyester fiber cloth market.","Li is also the chairman of the group's Shenzhen-listed arm Rongsheng Petrochemical, where his son-in-law, Xiang Jiongjiong, serves as general manager.","In 2023 Rongsheng Petrochemical inked a strategic partnership with Saudi Aramco, with the energy and chemicals giant acquiring a 10% stake in the former for $3.4 billion. ","In April 2024, the two companies further agreed to each acquiring a 50% stake in the other's subsidiary, ZhongJin Petrochemical and SASREF, to jointly develop projects in China and the Middle East. "]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Wanqiang is a cofounder of Chinese smartphone giant Xiaomi.","Li was once the company's senior vice president in charge of marketing and sales. He left in 2019, citing personal reasons.","Li previously worked at software firm Kingsoft with Xiaomi chairman Lei Jun."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Weiguo is a cofounder and chairman of Beijing Oriental Yuhong Waterproof Technology, a supplier of waterproof systems for construction projects.","Li worked for a provincial statistics bureau in China before he founded the predecessor of Yuhong in 1995.","Li Weiguo holds a bachelor's degree from Hunan Agricultural University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Weiwei is chairman and general manager of Sanqi Interactive Entertainment Network Technology Group.","Li holds an executive MBA from Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business in Beijing.","Li worked for several IT companies including Sina before he founded Sanqi in 2011."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Xiang is the founder, chairman and CEO of Beijing-based electric vehicle maker Li Auto, which is dual-listed on the Nasdaq and in Hong Kong.","The company is known for extended-range EVs, which have gas-powered engines installed as well so that batteries can be charged on the go.","Li Auto seeks to stand out in China's fiercely competitive EV market with family-oriented, more spacious cars such as its flagship six-seat SUV Li L9.","The mogul is also the founder of New York-listed Autohome, an auto news and services portal."]

name: Billionaires
bios:
["Li Xiaohua is the vice chairman of Shenzhen-listed Yunnan Energy New Material, a supplier of paper packaging materials and polypropylene film.
","Clients include Panasonic, LG Chemical and Comtemporary Amperex Technology.
","Li graduated from the University of Massachusetts with a major in polymer materials in 1993.","He worked for World-Pak Corp. in the U.S. after graduation until 1996.
","His brother Paul Xiaoming Lee, a U.S. citizen, is the chairman of Yunnan Energy New Material and is also a billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Xiting is cofounder and chairman of Shenzhen Mindray Bio-Medical Electronics, a supplier of medical devices.","Mindray, founded in 1991, is headquartered in Shenzhen. Li, a Singapore citizen, divides his time between Shenzhen and Singapore.","The company acquired a 21% stake in APT Medical, a Shenzhen-based cardiology equipment maker, for more than $900 million in 2024.","Mindray's cofounder and director Xu Hang is also a billionaire."]
abouts: ["Li holds an undergraduate degree from the University of Science and Technology of China.","During the Covid-19 pandemic, Mindray donated $4.6 million worth of medical devices to hospitals in hard-hit areas like Wuhan and northern Italy."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Xuechun is chairman and executive director of Fufeng Group, primarily a supplier of bio-fermentation products, with other interests including mining, real estate and finance.","His son, Li Guangyu, serves as executive director of the company. \r\n","Li took the company public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2007."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Xuhui was a director and vice president of Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food before she left in 2016.","Li managed Haitian's oyster sauce factory from 1999 to 2010.","Pang Kang and Cheng Xue, chairman and vice chairman of Haitian, are also billionaires."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Zhen chairs Gotion High-Tech, a lithium battery supplier.","Gotion operates eight global R&D centers across Asia and North America.","The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2006.","The company raised $685 million in a secondary listing on the SIX Swiss Exchange in 2022.","Founded in 1996, Gotion went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2015 and became the first publicly-traded power battery company in China."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Zhenguo is the chief executive of Longi Green Energy Technology, one of China's largest manufacturers of solar wafers and modules.","Li worked at a state-owned semiconductor factory before striking out on his own during the 1990s.","He cofounded Longi with two of his college friends in 2000, and named the company after Jiang Longji, the former headmaster of his alma mater Lanzhou University.","Today Longi has over 60,000 employees with production bases in China, Malaysia and Vietnam.","In 2023, the Shanghai-listed company announced a plan to raise $2.8 billion through an offering in Switzerland."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Zhigang chairs Wuhan DR Laser Technology, a supplier of laser equipment.","Wuhan DR Laser listed at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2019.","Customers include LONGi, Canadian Solar, Tongwei Co. and Trina Solar -- leading Chinese solar cell and panel makers."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Zhiyuan chairs Hainan Jinpan Smart Technology, a supplier of energy equipment.","Jinpan went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2021.","Li worked for most of the 1980s as an engineer at a electric power design institute."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Li Zhongchu chairs Shenzhen-listed software firm Beijing Shiji Information Technology.","He quit his first job as a government employee and started the business out of his apartment in 1998.  \r\n","A Shiji service focus is hotel information management systems.."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lia Maria Aguiar inherited a banking fortune from her late father, Amador Aguiar, the founder of Bradesco, one of Brazil's largest banks.\r\n","Lia Aguiar and her twin sister Lina were adopted by Bradesco founder Amador Aguiar after being abandoned in front of a Bradesco branch in Sao Paulo. \r\n","Aguiar fought a long court battle over her father's will with his second wife, whom he married less than five months before his death.","Aguiar also owns shares of Bradespar, the bank's non-financial arm, which is publicly traded and specializes in industrial investments."]
abouts: ["In 2008, Aguiar started her own foundation, Lia Maria Aguiar Foundation, to support the city of Campos do Jordao, where she has been living since the early 1990s."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liang Feng is a cofounder and the chairman of Shanghai Putailai New Energy Technology, a supplier of components and machinery to the lithium-ion battery industry.","Putailai's clients include Samsung and LG. \r\n","Liang holds an undergraduate degree in automation from South China University of Technology.","He also holds a master's degree in economics from Zhejiang University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liang Guangwei chairs conglomerate Shenzhen Huaqiang Holdings.","He served in the People's Liberation Army before he received a degree from Shenzhen University.","Huaqiang's businesses range from energy to theme park operation."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liang Qin chairs Yangzhou Yangjie Electronic Technology, a microchip supplier.","The company went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2014.","Yangjie is headquartered in the eastern Chinese city of Yangzhou."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liang Rubo is the chairman of the board of ByteDance, the China internet giant that owns TikTok.","Liang was a cofounder along with Zhang Yiming, who stepped down as CEO in 2021.","The two reportedly were college roommates at Nankai University in China.","ByteDance is best known for its hugely popular social video app TikTok, which is now in danger of being banned in the U.S. It also operates news app Toutiao."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liang Wenfeng is the founder of Hangzhou, China-based AI firm DeepSeek and quantitative trading firm High-Flyer Capital Management.","DeepSeek took the world by storm when it released its R1 model in 2025, claiming to rival the performance of OpenAI's ChatGPT at a lower cost.","Liang launched DeepSeek in 2023 and funded it in part with proceeds from High-Flyer, the hedge fund he founded in 2015 with two college classmates.","The mogul used math and AI techniques to build High-Flyer, turning it into one of the country's largest and best-performing quantitative trading firms.","DeepSeek raised $7.4 billion in a funding round in June 2026, valuing it at $52 billion."]
abouts: ["Liang met with Chinese president Xi Jinping at a meeting with Chinese tech entrepreneurs in Beijing in 2025."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liang Wengen is the founder and former chairman of Shanghai-listed construction equipment maker Sany Heavy Industry. He stepped down in 2022 but remained as a director.","Sany's holding company was founded in Hunan Province in 1989 as a small welding materials factory.","Liang's U.K.-educated son Liang Zaizhong served as chairman of the group's Hong Kong-listed Sany Heavy Equipment International until 2025. "]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liang Xinjun is a former vice chairman and CEO of conglomerate Fosun International.","Fosun's investments range from steelmaking to mining, tourism and pharmaceuticals.\r\n","Liang resigned from Fosun in 2017 citing health reasons and cashed out his stakes.","He now lives in Singapore from where he runs his family office, XIN Family.","Fellow Fosun cofounder Guo Guangchang is also a billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liang Yunchao chairs Guandong By-health, one of China's largest producers of vitamins and health supplements.","Every few years he invites young leaders to join a \"wildlife training\" boot camp to test their stamina, he told Forbes Asia in an interview.","His favorite boot camp spots include Teklimakan Qumluqi in Xinjiang, the world's second largest desert, and Antarctica."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liang Zhaoxian is president of Galanz Group, one of China's largest suppliers of microwave ovens, air conditioners and household appliances.\r\n","The company traces its roots to 1978 when it was founded as a feather product plant.","Privately held Galanz is headquartered in the southern Chinese city of Foshan."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liesel Pritzker Simmons and her brother Matthew Pritzker sued their family for a chunk of its Hyatt Hotels fortune and received around $500 million apiece in 2005.","Their uncle Jay Pritzker (d. 1999) founded the hotel chain and their uncle Donald Pritzker (d. 1972) managed and developed it.","Their father Robert Pritzker (d. 2011) ran the family's industrial conglomerate Marmon Group, which was acquired by Berkshire Hathaway in a series of transactions beginning in 2008.","Three of Matthew and Liesel's step-siblings, seven cousins and their father's cousin Nick Pritzker are also billionaires.","Liesel cofounded and runs impact investing firm Blue Haven Initiative with her husband Ian Simmons."]
abouts: ["Pritzker, a child actor, starred in the 1995 film ?A Little Princess? as well as ?Air Force One? with Harrison Ford. \t"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lilian Teh Li Ming is the daughter of late banker Teh Hong Piow, who chaired Malaysian banking behemoth Public Bank for several decades","Teh Hong Piow founded the bank in 1966. He died in December 2022 at age 92.","In addition to Malaysia, the bank serves millions of customers across Cambodia, China, Hong Kong, Sri Lanka and Vietnam.","Teh had a substantial minority stake in the bank as well as in the listed insurance business, LPI Capital."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lillian Teh Li Hua is the daughter of late banker Teh Hong Piow, who chaired the Malaysian banking behemoth Public Bank for several decades.","Teh Hong Piow founded the bank in 1966. He died in December 2022 at age 92.","In addition to Malaysia, the bank serves millions of customers across Cambodia, China, Hong Kong, Sri Lanka and Vietnam.","Teh had a significant minority stake in the bank as well as in the listed insurance business, LPI Capital."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lim Chai Hock is chief operating officer and director of Bayan Resources, one of Indonesia's largest coal producers, founded by billionaire Low Tuck Kwong.","He is a cofounder of the Bayan Group and also sits on the board of several of its subsidiaries.","Lim holds a certificate of land surveying.","Prior to joining Bayan Group, he worked as a site manager with Jaya Sumpiles Indonesia, Low's coal mining infrastructure company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Son of a rickshaw driver, Lim Chap Huat set up a small construction outfit with two partners in 1976 at age 22.","He expanded Soilbuild Group into property development and set up an REIT, eventually buying out his partners. His wife Leo Jee Lin and sons, Lim Han Feng and Lim Han Qin, work with him.","Soilbuild expanded into Myanmar in 2012 where it has multiple contracts, and into Vietnam in 2017.","In 2021, Lim, together with Blackstone Real Estate, privatized Soilbuild Business Space REIT, delisting it from the Singapore stock exchange.","In 2024, Lim and Blackstone sold their office and industrial properties in Singapore to New York-based private equity firm Warburg Pincus and Australian developer Lendlease for $1.2 billion."]
abouts: ["Lim taught part-time to pay fees for engineering school.","He is a firm believer in his school motto \"Nothing Without Labour.\""]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lim and his family own a majority stake in Singapore-listed palm oil producer Bumitama Agri; its plantations are located in Indonesia.","His son Lim Gunawan Hariyanto is CEO of the family's Harita Group.","Harita Group also owns the majority of listed bauxite mining firm Cita Mineral Investindo. Lim's integrated nickel processing company Trimegah Bangun Persada raised $650 million in a 2023 IPO.","Lim's father emigrated from China to East Kalimantan and reportedly opened a grocery store in 1915.","His daughter Christina is executive director of Bumitama Agri."]
abouts: ["The family group's name Harita comes from Lim Hariyanto and wife Rita.","Lim started pursuing higher education in his late 60s, and obtained a doctoral degree in business administration from Shanghai Jiao Tong University in 2005 at age 77."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lim Kaling is an early investor and non-executive director of Razer, a gaming hardware maker that was set up in 2005.","The company has acquired a huge global following and sold millions of gaming laptops, mice, fitness bands and tablets. It went public in Hong Kong in 2017, raising $529 million.","Lim and Razer cofounder Min-Liang Tan took the company private in 2022 in a deal that valued it at $3.2 billion.","Lim also runs the Lim Teck Lee group, a family business with interests in real estate, manufacturing and trading."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lim Kok Thay is the executive chairman of Genting, a casino and resorts conglomerate with a global footprint. In February 2025, he stepped down as CEO, a role he had held for almost two decades.","In 2022, Lim's troubled cruise operator Genting Hong Kong, which was hit hard by the pandemic, filed a winding up petition. Lim stepped down as chairman.","Lim's assets include Empire Resorts, the parent company of loss-making Resorts World Catskills.","A long-drawn family feud over the empire's wealth and businesses, which include a palm-oil unit, was finally resolved in 2020.","Genting Singapore is investing $1.7 billion to revamp its casino Resorts World Sentosa, which will include a new 700-room hotel and is expected to be completed by 2031."]
abouts: ["His late father, Lim Goh Tong, arrived in Malaysia from Fujian, China, in 1937 at age 19 with barely anything to his name.","Lim also has a stake in Singapore-listed luxury yatch company, Grand Banks Yatchs."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lim Wee Chai started Top Glove with his wife Tong Siew Bee in 1991 and took the company public in 2001.","Top Glove is one of the world's largest producers of rubber gloves. It has 48 factories with an annual capacity of 95 billion gloves.","Lim, whose parents are rubber plantation owners and traders, also holds a stake in property developer Tropicana.","In March 2022, Lim postponed plans for a Hong Kong listing amid a sharp drop in profits."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Bin is vice chairman of Xiaomi, one of the world's most well-known smartphone brands.","Lin cofounded the company in 2010 and was president until 2019. Early on he oversaw recruiting, legal, finance, strategic partnerships and overseas expansion. ","Prior to Xiaomi, he worked at ADP, a U.S. provider of online human resources management services, Microsoft and Google.","Lin, whose daughters went to college at Tufts University, is a member of the board of advisors at Tufts' school of engineering.","Xiaomi entered the EV market in 2024 with its SU7 sedan and has since gained popularity primarily in China. "]
abouts: ["Lin and his wife Daisy donated 80,000 face masks and 10,000 pairs of goggles to Tufts Medical Center in 2020.","Lin acquired in 2026 a 1% stake in the Miami Dolphins football team's holding company at a valuation of $12.5 billion - marking a record for a minority transaction."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin is the widow of real estate mogul Lin Rong San. She resigned as chairman of the family's property developer Union Enterprise Construction in 2021.","Lin Rong San died in 2015 and left a $4.2 billion fortune built on real estate developments and investments in northern Taiwan.","Eldest son Jeff Lin runs the publicly traded Union Bank of Taiwan, which was started by his father.","Second son Andy Lin runs the group's media outlets, including Chinese-language newspaper Liberty Times and its sister English-language Taipei Times.","Youngest son Kevin works with another family-owned developer, RSL, which builds upscale residential projects and operates hotels."]
abouts: ["Lin Chang Su-O also chairs her late husband's Lin Rong San Foundation of Culture and Social Welfare.","In 2018 the Lins ended Marriott's franchise agreement for its Taipei hotel to protest the chain's caving in to Chinese pressure by listing Taiwan as part of China."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Chen-hai built his fortune by developing affordable housing for Taiwan's middle class through his privately held Pau Jar Group.","An early foray overseas also landed Lin in the middle of another hot growth story - the real estate market in Australia.","In 2018, Lin swooped up stakes in China Bills Finance, Taishin and SinoPac, sending a shudder up the spine of Taiwan's sleepy financial establishment.","He also acquired stakes in the listed Far Eastern Department Stores and castings supplier Yeong Guan group.","In 2020, through his TSE Foundation, Lin established the Taipei School of Economics and Political Science at the National Tsing Hua University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Fanlian is chairman of Order Group, whose interests include energy, real estate and finance.","Order is headquartered in the eastern Chinese city of Linyi in Shandong Province.","Lin Fanlian was reportedly born into a farming family in a small village of Shandong Province; he dropped out of school and worked as construction worker as a teen."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Jianhua is the chairman of Hangzhou First Applied Material, a supplier of packaging films, backplane and other products to the solar power industry.","Lin worked at a state-owned fertilizer factory in Zhejiang Province from 1982 to 1994, then set up Hangzhou First in 2003 with his wife Zhang Hong.","Zhang Hong is a vice president at Hangzhou First."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Lairong's fortune mainly accrues from his stake in Inner Mongolia Dazhong Mining, an iron ore mining business","The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2021.","Dazhong is headquartered in the city of Baotou in Inner Mongolia."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Li is the chairman of investment firm Liye Group, which has interests in sectors such as healthcare, metals and green energy.","The group is a shareholder of ChinaLin Securities and Tencent-backed online bank WeBank.","Lin's son, Lin Dibang, is the chairman of Shenzhen-based drug maker Cali Biosciences. It planned for an IPO in Hong Kong which didn't go through.","The elder Lin worked at several local branches of the Bank of China before founding Liye in 1995."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Ming-hsiung is the chairman of PX Mart, one of Taiwan's largest supermarket chains.","He took over PX Mart from the government in 1998 when it had 66 outlets. Today it boasts over 1,200 stores as well as minimarkets that serve Taiwan's remote villages.","In 2022, the company completed a $377 million deal to purchase a 96% stake in hypermarket chain RT-Mart's Taiwan business.","Lin also controls real estate developer Yuanlih Construction and Hwatai Bank."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Muqin is the chairman and CEO of energy drink maker Eastroc Beverage (Group), which is dual-listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong. ","The mogul started out as a technician at a state-owned construction firm, and later found a job at a Shenzhen-based beverage company.","In 1997 he joined Eastroc, then a state-run beverage business, as its vice president. Lin reportedly scraped together more than 4 million yuan ($570,000) to acquire that firm in early 2000s. ","He soon focused on making energy drinks. He managed to build Eastroc into China's largest energy drink maker by sales volume partly through offering products at cheaper prices.","Eastroc has diversified into other market segments including coffee and tea-based beverages."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Por-Chun is an executive director of Taiwan Glass, one of Asia's largest glass suppliers.","The company was founded in 1964 by his late father, Lin Yu-Chia, who took it public nine years later.","It has five plants in Taiwan and 15 in mainland China after expanding into the region in 1993.","Por-Chun's brother Por-Fong serves as the company's chairman; another brother Por-Shih is its president and CEO."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Por-Fong has been serving as the chairman of Taiwan Glass, one of Asia's largest glass suppliers, since 2009.","The company was founded in 1964 by his late father, Lin Yu-Chia, who took it public nine years later.","It has five plants in Taiwan and 15 in mainland China after expanding into the region in 1993.","Por-Fong's brother Por-Shih is the company's president and CEO; another brother Por-Chun is its executive director."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Por-Shih is the president and CEO of Taiwan Glass, one of Asia's largest glass suppliers.","The company was founded in 1964 by his late father, Lin Yu-Chia, who took it public nine years later.","It has five plants in Taiwan and 15 in mainland China after expanding into the region in 1993.","Por-Shih's older brother Por-Fong and younger brother Por-Chun serve as the company's chairman and executive director, respectively.","Por-Shih was indicted by Taipei's local authorities in December 2025 for filing fraudulent business documents in an equity transaction in 2020. Taiwan Glass subsequently made an announcement, claiming it has no impact on the company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Shu-hong was chairman of Chang Chun Group, one of Asia's largest petrochemical companies with plants in Taiwan, mainland China and Southeast Asia, until the end of 2013.","He cofounded the business in 1949 with classmates Tseng Shin-yi and M.K. Liao, with only $100. He's the only surviving member of the trio.","The name \"Chang Chun\" in Chinese loosely means \"long spring,\" and reflects the wish among the three that their bonds would endure."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Tsung-Chi is the founder and chairman of Kaohsiung-based King Slide Works.","The company was set up in 1986 as a maker of home furniture rails and other fittings, and has expanded into server rail kits and cable management arms.","His daughter Lin Shu-Chen and her husband Wang Chun Chiang serve as the company's president and executive vice president, respectively."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["After making a fortune in scrap steel during the 1990s, Lin Xiucheng shifted into the light-emitting diode (LED) business.","He injected his LED business into a Shanghai-listed firm in exchange for a majority stake and changed its name to Sanan Optoelectronics in 2008.","Lin shares majority ownership of his main holding company, Fujian Sanan Group, with son Lin Zhiqiang."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Zhijun is the vice chairman of Double Medical Technology.","Double Medical Technology supplies trauma implant consumables and spinal implant consumables.","Lin's elder brother Lin Zhixiong is a member of the 2017 Forbes China Rich List."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lin Zhixiong chairs Double Medical Technology.","Double Medical Technology's main products are trauma implant and spinal implant consumables.","Lin studied at Chiba University in Japan from April 2003 to June 2004.","Lin founded the predecessor of Double Medical Technology after he returned from Japan in 2004."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lina Tombolato is the widow of Ennio Doris, the former chairman of Italian bank Banca Mediolanum, who died at 81 in November 2021.","She and her two children, Mediolanum CEO Massimo and vice president Annalisa, own 41% of the bank, which has 104 billion euros in assets under management.","She and Ennio were both born in the small northern Italian town of Tombolo and were married for 55 years."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Linda Campbell is one of six billionaire heirs to the media and publishing empire founded by her grandfather Roy Thomson (d. 1976).","The family's biggest holding: more than 310 million shares of Thomson Reuters.","Thomson owns around 14% of the business through the family's investment firm, Woodbridge.","The family's other assets include the Toronto-based Global and Mail newspaper, and the Montreal Canadiens and Winnipeg Jets sports teams."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["A scion of the billionaire Pritzker family, Linda Pritzker devotes herself to Tibetan Buddhism rather than her family's enterprises.","She is building a spiritual retreat center in Montana dedicated to Tibetan Buddhist practice; she offers online courses and annual coastal retreats in the interim.","Her father Robert Pritzker and his brother Jay Pritzker built up manufacturing business Marmon Holdings and sold it to Berkshire Hathaway in 2008.","Pritzker goes by Lama Tsomo in her teaching and professional capacities.","The Pritzker family also built the Hyatt hotel empire."]
abouts: ["Pritzker published a Westerner's guide to Tibetan Buddhist meditation that included an introductory letter from H.H. Dalai Lama.","Pritzker was one of the first American women to be ordained as a Lama in the Tibetan Buddhist tradition."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lindsay Fox owns Linfox, Australia's biggest private logistics company, with more than 5,000 trucks, including electric vehicles, across 12 countries in the Asia-Pacific region.","The company also owns a large industrial property portfolio, a half-share in a business park, two airports and currency-management outfit Armaguard.","Fox is no longer involved in day-to-day operations, leaving management to his son Peter, who is executive chairman and runs the logistics business.","His other sons Andrew and David run the property division and look after the airports respectively.","In January 2025, Linfox International Group acquired Singapore-based logistics company Masindo Logistic for an undisclosed amount to strengthen its foothold across the Asia-Pacific region."]
abouts: ["Fox also owns historic Melbourne amusement park Luna Park, more than 100 vintage cars on display for the public, a race track and four homes.","Fox quit his school for academically gifted boys at age 16 to become a truck driver like his father. He bought his first truck at 19."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Ling Tang is a pre-IPO investor in AI-powered advertising technology company AppLovin, which went public on the Nasdaq in 2021.","Tang owns 5% of AppLovin through an entity called Angel Pride Holdings Ltd.\r\n","Tang is one of eight billionaires from AppLovin, including the company's cofounder and CEO Adam Foroughi.","Little is known about Ling Tang, though securities filings list a business address for her on the same street in Hong Kong as another mysterious billionaire AppLovin investor, Hao Tang.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liora Ofer chairs investment vehicle Ofer Investments, which was cofounded by her father Yuli (d. 2011) and uncle Sammy Ofer (d. 2011).","The company's largest asset is a controlling stake in publicly traded real estate firm Melisron.","In 2015, Liora won a years-long court battle with her brother Doron Ofer over their inheritance, which left her with nearly 52% of Ofer Investments.","Liora now owns 100% of the investment company after a conflict-of-interest law forced her cousin, Eyal, to divest, and she bought the remaining 15% from her brother in January 2023.","She and Eyal swapped assets, with Liora giving up her stake in Mizrahi Tefahot Bank in exchange for a greater share of Ofer."]
abouts: ["She is one of just two female billionaires in Israel; the other is Shari Arison.","Her cousins Eyal and Idan Ofer, sons of her late uncle Sammy Ofer, are also billionaires."]

name: Billionaires
bios:
["In 1988 Lirio Parisotto founded Videolar, a video and audiotape company, invested the profits in the stock market and built a fortune.  
","His portfolio runs the gamut from banking, electricity and mining to steel companies. He avoids IPOs and favors stocks that pay high dividends. 
","In addition, he owns bonds, real estate, and a majority of Videolar, which merged with Innova to manufacture and market petrochemical products.
","Innova operates three high-tech industrial facilities: two in Brazil's Amazon region of Manaus and one in southern Brazil."]
abouts: ["He has 11 siblings, holds a degree in medicine and also spent time in a monastery."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lisa Su, the CEO of semiconductor firm Advanced Micro Devices, has led one of the greatest recent turnarounds in the technology sector.","In 2025 the company announced a partnership with OpenAI (the creator of ChatGPT), highlighting the use of AMD chips for computing power. ","Next, she's preparing for battle against Nvidia in the AI revolution, and expects to keep winning; Nvidia is run by her distant relative Jensen Huang.","The daughter of a mathematician and a bookkeeper turned entrepreneur, Su was born in Tainan, Taiwan, in 1969, and immigrated to New York City at age 3.","After graduating from the Bronx High School of Science, Su went to MIT, where she earned a bachelor's (and later a Ph.D.) in electrical engineering because it seemed to be the most difficult major.","She did stints at Texas Instruments, IBM and Freescale, then joined AMD in 2012 and became CEO two years later."]
abouts: ["During her time at IBM, Su worked directly with highly respected CEO Lou Gerstner."]
bio: THE DAUGHTER of a mathematician and a bookkeeper turned entrepreneur, was born in Tainan, Taiwan, in 1969, the same year Sanders founded AMD. Her family immigrated to New York City when she was 3. She chose electrical engineering at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology because it seemed to be the most difficult major.
title: CEO

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Chengyu chairs Shenzhen Kstar Science and Technology, a maker of uninterruptible power supply equipment, inverters and storage for the solar power industry.","KStar went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2010.","Kstar is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.","He joined the company, which is also based in Shenzhen, in 1993 before rising through the ranks.","His first job out of college was a high school teacher."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Debing is the chairman of Chinese AI firm Knowledge Atlas Technology.","Also known as Zhipu.AI, the company went public in Hong Kong in January 2026, raising $560 million.","The AI model developer, which sells its services in China and Southeast Asia, previously raised funding from investors including Ant Group, Tencent and Qiming Venture Partners.","The firm was added to the U.S. government's entity list in 2025, barring it from acquiring advanced American technology. "]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Fangyi is chairman and founder of Shenzhen-listed Intco Medical Technology, a supplier of disposable gloves, wheelchairs and gauze.","Liu founded the predecessor to Intco Medical Technology in the eastern Chinese city of Zibo in 2009.","Intco went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2017."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Gexin chairs Sichuan Kelun Pharmaceutical, a maker of antibiotics and traditional Chinese medicine.","Liu set up Kelun Pharmaceutical Factory, the predecessor company of Sichuan Kelun Pharmaceutcal, in 1996.","Kelun went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2010."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Hanyuan is the chairman of China's Tongwei Group, one of the world's largest in two different industries -- aquafeed and new energy.","Liu worked at a government job in the hydropower bureau in Sichuan province before he took the plunge as an entrepreneur in the fish food business.","Liu's daughter Shuqi became chairman and CEO of Tongwei Group's main listed business, Tongwei Co.,  in 2023."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Jiangwei is chairman and president of Shenzhen H&T Intelligent Control, a major supplier of  products related to home appliances, power tools and the automotive industry.","Liu co-founded H&T Technology, the predecessor of company in January 2000.","He took the company public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2010.","He taught at  Harbin Institute of Technology's School of Astronautics as a professor.\t"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Jincheng is the chairman of Eve Energy, a battery maker listed in China's tech hub Shenzhen.","A smaller competitor to China's BYD and CATL, Eve Energy supplies to auto, wearable devices, renewable energy and other sectors.","Born in a village in China's central Hubei province, Liu worked at a state-owned factory upon graduating college.","He later went on to study electrochemistry at Wuhan University, and worked as a battery engineer before founding Eve Energy in 2000."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Jingkang founded camera maker Arashi Vision, also known as Insta360, in 2015.","The company's products include handheld 360-degree cameras capable of taking spherical videos in high-resolution quality.","Headquartered in Shenzhen, China, Insta360 has opened offices in the U.S., Japan and Germany.","Its backers include Qiming Venture Partners, IDG Capital Partners and Chinese retailer Suning Group.","The company went public on the Shanghai stock exchange in June 2025."]
title: CEO

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Ming Chung leads Nine Dragons Paper, one of Asia's largest paper producers.","Hong Kong-listed Nine Dragons started out as a supplier of packaging for exporters in China, and now also benefits from consumer demand inside China.","Liu is CEO and deputy chairman of Nine Dragons, while his wife Cheung Yan, also a billionaire, is the chairlady. They are both cofounders of the company, which was established in 1995.","Liu was born in Taiwan and grew up in Brazil. He holds a bachelor's degree in dental surgery from the University of Santo Amaro, in Brazil.","His son Ken Liu joined Nine Dragons' board of directors in 2018, after graduating from Harvard University and working as a consultant for PwC.\r\n"]
abouts: ["His wife Cheung has been dubbed by Chinese media as the country's \"wastepaper queen.\" Liu and Cheung met in Hong Kong and married in the US."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Ming Hui is the chairman and cofounder of China Gas Holdings,  a natural gas services operator listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.","Liu is a graduate of China's Hebei Normal University.\r\n","Liu's brother Liu Mingxing and daughter Liu Chang sit on China Gas Holding's board."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Sheng is the chairman and CEO of Shenzhen-listed Zhongji Innolight, a supplier of optical communication modules and devices.","After studying in the U.S., he founded Google-backed InnoLight Technology in 2008.","The company was acquired in 2016 by billionaire Wang Weixiu's Shangdong Zhongji Electrical Equipment in a $396 million deal.","The merged entity later changed its name to Zhongji Innolight."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Shengjun is the second-largest shareholder of Himile Mechanical Science and Technology, a manufacturer of tire molds and rubber machinery, large mechanical components, and CNC machine tools. He was formerly the supervisor of the company.","The company went public in 2011.","The company has subsidiaries in the United States, Europe, India, and Brazil.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Wei is the chairman and CEO of Shanghai-based online games developer miHoYo, which he established in 2012 with college friends, Cai Haoyu and Luo Yuhao.","Liu took over the reins from Cai after he stepped down from the helm in 2023.","The company is best known for its anime-styled adventure games such as Genshin Impact and Honkai: Star Rail.","Cai and Luo are also billionaires.","Apple CEO Tim Cook described that he found a \"phenomenal team\" at company after a visit to its headquarters in 2023."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Weiping chairs snack food maker WL Delicious.","WL is headquartered in the central Chinese city of Luohe.","Liu is a graduate of Southwest University in Chongqing, China, where he was majored in management."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Xiaodong chairs Shanghai Bairun Investment Holding Group, a maker of alcopop beverages.","Liu worked at tobacco and flavoring companies before cofounding the predecessor of Shanghai Bairun in 1997.","Bairun acquired domestic alcopop supplier Shanghai Bacchus in an all-stock transaction in June 2015, boosting Bairun's business."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Xiucai chairs Cathay Biotech, a Shanghai-headquartered supplier of industrial chemicals.","Cathay went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2020."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Yanjun is co-founder, CEO and chairman of Shanghai Bao Pharmaceuticals, a producer of recombinant protein and antibody drugs.","The company went public in December 2025.","Liu trained under the late Wu Mengchao, a leading liver surgeon in China.","Liu was previously vice president of Shanghai Pharmaceuticals Holding."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Yonghao is the chairman of New Hope Group, which has around 100,000 employees and over 600 subsidiaries around the world.","The group has interests in agribusiness, dairy, fast foods, real estate and chemicals.","His daughter Liu Chang replaced him as chairman of the group's animal feed arm New Hope Liuhe, one of China's largest agribusiness firms, in 2013.","In the U.S., New Hope owns stakes in Lansing Trade Group,  a feed and raw materials trading company, and food processing outfit Ruprecht."]
abouts: ["With his 3 brothers, Liu founded New Hope Group in 1982, which started out as an animal feed business. The brothers split amicably in the mid-1990s.","Liu's New Hope Group is one of the largest  suppliers of meat, eggs and dairy products in China."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Yongxing is the chairman of East Hope Group, whose business interests include heavy industry, agriculture and real estate.","He formed East Hope Group in the 1990s after amicably parting ways with his three brothers; the siblings launched agribusiness company Hope Group in 1982.","His son Liu Xiangyu sits on East Hope's board.","Brother Liu Yonghao is also a billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Liu Zhenfeng is a director of Yantai Jereh Oilfield Services Group, a supplier of oilfield equipment.","The company won a US$100 million order for generator sets from a North American data center in November 2025.","Yantai Jereh Oilfield Services Group listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2010."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lívia Voigt de Assis, one of the world's youngest billionaires, is one of the largest individual shareholders of WEG, the largest manufacturer of electrical motors in Latin America.","At twenty years old, she is the world's second-youngest billionaire, behind nineteen-year-old German pharmaceuticals heir Johannes von Baumbach.","WEG was cofounded by her grandfather Werner Ricardo Voigt along with late billionaires Eggon Joao da Silva and Geraldo Werninghaus.","A publicly-traded multinational with factories in over ten countries, WEG has annual revenue of approximately $7 billion.","Lívia does not hold a board seat or any executive position at WEG; she is currently attending university."]
abouts: ["Voigt de Assis was the world's youngest billionaire in 2025 before losing the spot to German pharmaceutical heir, Johannes von Baumbach, a year later."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lloyd Blankfein was chairman and CEO of financial behemoth Goldman Sachs from 2006 to 2018, when he was succeeded by David Solomon.","Before leading Goldman Sachs, he worked under then-CEO Henry Paulson as the company's president and chief operations officer from 2004 to 2006.","Blankfein first became a partner at the firm in 1988.","Blankfein grew up in the projects in Brooklyn, graduated as a valedictorian from Thomas Jefferson High School before getting history and law degrees from Harvard."]
abouts: ["Blankfein was diagnosed with lymphoma late in 2015, and after months of chemotherapy, he said he was likely cured of the disease."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wan Long is the chairman and CEO of meat processor WH Group.","WH acquired Virginia-based Smithfield, the world's largest pork processor and hog producer, in 2013.","Smithfield completed the acquisition of Clougherty Packing, California's largest pork processor, in 2017.","WH Group was formerly known as Shuanghui International, and renamed itself in 2014."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lorenzo Fertitta and his brother, Frank, made the bulk of their fortune through mixed martial arts promoter UFC.","They bought UFC for $2 million in 2001; an investment group led by WME/IMG bought it for $4 billion in 2016.","They sold their remaining stakes in UFC in August 2017 at a $5 billion valuation.","The Fertittas took public their casino business, Red Rock Resorts, in 2016. It was founded by their father.","They each pledged $7.5 million in 2016 to NYU's Stern School of Business for a scholarship for veterans."]
abouts: ["The Fertittas got hooked on martial arts after taking weekly lessons in their casino's basement. In 2001, they bought UFC, owning it until a 2016 sale to WME-IMG.","Fertitta's son Nicco played safety for the University of Notre Dame football team and is now an assistant coach at UNLV."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lőrinc Meszáros is a close friend of Viktor Orbán, Hungary's former Prime Minister, and also the richest and most famous oligarch in the country.","He founded a small gas-fitting company in Felcsút, Orbán's home village, in 1990. In the 2000s the two men became acquainted through football.","Meszaros' gas-fitting company, Meszaros & Meszaros, is now a big player in the construction market thanks to government contracts. Orbán lost power in 2026."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lottie Tham owns more than 5% of cheap chic fashion retailer H&M.","The company was founded by her late father Erling Persson in 1947, and her nephew Karl-Johan Persson is the current CEO.","Her brother, Sweden's richest person Stefan Persson, is H&M's former CEO and chairman.","Her nephew Tom Persson and niece Charlotte S'derstr?m are also billionaires.","Lottie Tham has no role in H&M and tries her best to stay out of the public eye.","Lottie and her husband also invest in real estate, including hotels, commercial buildings and land."]
abouts: ["Her father got the idea for H&M during a road-trip in the U.S. when he saw the department stores in New York."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lou Guoqiang derives his fortune from Ningbo Jintian Copper, a supplier of copper rod and other copper products.","Lou formerly chaired the company before his son Lou Cheng took over the role in 2022.","The company, which was founded in 1986, provides integrated copper solutions for rail transit, power IoT and smart-city development. Its business spans more than 100 countries and regions."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lou Jin is chairman and CEO of 3SBIO Inc, a biopharmaceutical company.","The company first went public on the Nasdaq in 2007 before privatizing in 2013. It listed again in Hong Kong in 2015.","The company's main research and development centers are in Shenyang, Shanghai, Shenzhen and Hangzhou."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["One of Wall Street's macro-trading legends, Louis Bacon cut his teeth as a commodities and currencies trader, earning big profits in the 1987 crash.","He created hedge fund Moore Capital in 1989 using trading profits and a small inheritance.","Bacon announced he was closing his hedge fund and returning outside investors' money in November 2019, citing years of \"disappointing results.\"","Moore Capital still manages internal money and scored 70% returns in 2020 for Bacon and his employees."]
abouts: ["Bacon's environmental preservation-focused Moore Charitable Trust was defrauded out of $25 million by jailed banker Andy Caspersen."]
title: Founder

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Louis Le Duff got his start when he opened a combined restaurant-bakery in a Quebec ski resort while studying abroad for his MBA.","In 1976, he took the concept back to France and opened the first Brioche Dorée bakery in Brittany with just $2,000.","Groupe Le Duff now operates more than 1,000 bakery and restaurant locations, including La Madeleine French eateries chain in the U.S. and Del Arte in France. ","The company's biggest business is Bridor, which produces high-quality breads and pastries for hotels, restaurants and catering services in more than 100 countries.  ","Le Duff also owns frozen food maker Gourming, and he owned the Bruegger's Bagels chain from 2011 until 2017, when he sold it to Caribou Coffee Company. \t "]
abouts: ["In the summer of 1970, when Le Duff studied at Columbia University in the City of New York, he worked night shifts at a French creperie on 3rd Street."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Louise Lindh and her sister Katarina Martinson each own a 15% stake in their family's investment outfit, L.E. Lundbergforetagen AB.","The company has investments in property management and a variety of other businesses, including stakes in firms like truck-maker Volvo and Ericsson.","Both sisters have board seats in the group companies along with their father Fredrik Lundberg.","The company was founded by their grandfather Lars in 1944 as a construction outfit. Fredrik took over management of the firm in 1981.","Lindh runs the group's real estate outfit, and sits on the boards of paper company Holmen."]
abouts: ["In 2018, Lindh and her husband bought battery maker IAB? Global Holding for 36 million Swedish kronor, roughly $4 million.","Louise spent most of her childhood in Switzerland where the family had moved to avoid punitive taxes."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Known as the coal king, Singapore-born Low Tuck Kwong is the founder of Bayan Resources, a coal mining company in Indonesia.","He also controls Singapore's renewable energy company Metis Energy (formerly known as Manhattan Resources) and has interests in The Farrer Park Company and Samindo Resources.","Low  is backing SEAX Global, which is building a submarine sea-cable system for internet connectivity linking Singapore, Indonesia and Malaysia.","Low worked for his father's construction company in Singapore as a teenager and then moved to Indonesia in 1972 for greater opportunities.","In August 2024 he transferred a stake in Bayan, worth $6.6 billion at the time, to his daughter Elaine."]
abouts: ["Low thrived as a building contractor but hit the jackpot after buying his first mine in 1997.","The animal lover has sponsored a zoo with gibbons, sun bears, peacocks and orangutans.","In 2019, Low Tuck Kwong donated $7 million to Dana Lestari ITB, an endowment fund of the Bandung Institute of Technology."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lu Bin is a director of Neway Valve (Suzhou).","Lu co-founded the company in 1997 with Wang Baoqing, Cheng Zhangwen and Xi Chao.","The company went public in 2014."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lu Di was an early investor in Chinese drone maker DJI when it was founded in 2006.","Today the Shenzhen-headquartered business is one of the world's largest drone makers.","Lu has been called a \"penny pincher\" by DJI's CEO Frank Wang."]
title: Investor

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lu Hongyan chairs Shanghai-listed online games company G-bits Network Technology.","Its business benefited during the pandemic, when quarantined Chinese people turned to online gaming for fun.","Lu worked for telecom firms ZTE and Salira Optical Network Systems as a software engineer before he founded G-bits in 2004."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lu Lili derives her fortune from a minority stake in East Money Information and a 8.5% stake in Wanda Film Holding.","Lu is the wife of Qi Shi, who founded and chairs East Money Information, a provider of IT and software for the financial services industry in China.","She previously worked at the company's general manager's office.","Lu bought just over 8% of Wanda Film Holding for $306 million in 2023."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lu Ruibo is the founder and chairman of Impro Precision Industries, a manufacturer of casting and machined components.","Customers of the company include Bosch, Caterpillar, Cummins, Honeywell, HUSCO and Parker Hannifin.","The company has over 7,000 employees."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lu Weiding is the chairman of Wanxiang Group, a maker of auto parts with growing interests in clean energy and agriculture.","His late father Lu Guanqiu (d. 2017) founded the predecessor of Wanxiang Group in 1969. ","Starting from a small blacksmith shop, Guanqiu eventually grew the company to become the first Chinese auto parts supplier that entered the U.S. market. ","Lu Weiding is also the chairman of China Wanxiang, a subsidiary in the insurance and fintech sectors."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lu Xiangyang was working at a local branch of the People's Bank of China in 1995 when he teamed up with his cousin Wang Chuanfu to start BYD, then a battery maker.","Lu is now vice chairman of the company, which has grown into one of the world's largest EV makers.","Lu also runs his own investment firm, Youngy Investment Holding Group."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lu Yiwen is a cofounder of jewelry supplier DR Corp.","DR went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2021.","The company is headquartered in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lu Zhongfang retired from a pesticides factory in northern China's Jilin Province in 1993 and invested in test preparation firm Offcn in 1999.","Lu's son Liu Yongxin chairs Offcn and is also a billionaire.","Offcn Education Technology completed a backdoor listing at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2019."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lu Zongjun is a director of Shanghai Zhonggu Logistics, a container shipping company in China. He stepped down as chairman in November 2023.","Zhonggu went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2020.","Lu holds a graduate degree from the Wuhan University of Technology."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["The world's youngest self-made woman billionaire, Luana Lopes Lara is the cofounder and COO of prediction market platform Kalshi.","Kalshi allows users to bet on everything from sports game results to political elections to entertainment awards and more. It reached a $11 billion valuation in December 2025 following a $1 billion funding round.\r\n","Kalshi received federal approval in 2020 to operate in the U.S., and made history in 2024 after receiving federal approval to allow users to bet on the presidential election, marking the first legal election contracts in the U.S. in over a century.","Lopes Lara performed as a professional ballerina for nine months after graduating high school at Salzburger Landestheater in Austria for a season of \"Swan Lake.\"","An MIT graduate and previous quantitative trader at Citadel Securities, Lopes Lara secured funding from angel investors including Charles Schwab and Henry Kravis, as well as firms Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia Capital, CapitalG and Paradigm.","Lopes Lara owns an estimated 12% stake in Kalshi."]
bio: Kalshi lets investors place bets on future events, like how many Americans will receive a Covid vaccine. Mansour cofounded Kalshi with fellow MIT alum Lopes Lara in 2018. The hardest part: They needed a federal license from the Commodities and Futures Trading Commission, which took two years. VCs like Sequoia and billionaires Charles Schwab and Henry Kravis have invested $40 million into Kalshi, which has processed $10 million in trades since launching in July 2021.
title: Cofounder
qas: [{"label":"Dream Mentor","question":"What living person is your dream mentor?","answer":"Adena Friedman","hidden":false},{"label":"App you can't live without","question":"Go-to app","answer":"Spotify","hidden":false}]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Luc Tack derives his fortune from chemical manufacturer Tessenderlo Group.","In 2023 Tessenderlo acquired Picanol group, a weaving machine and cast iron parts manufacturer, which resulted in the later's privatization.","Tack, who formerly counted Picanol as his primary asset, is now CEO of both companies.","Tack requested emancipation from his parents at 18 so that he could legally start his first business, an importer of American wood products."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Luca Del Vecchio is one of six children of Leonardo Del Vecchio, the late chairman (d. 2022) of EssilorLuxottica, the world's largest eyeglasses firm.","He inherited a 12.5% stake in his father's Luxembourg-based holding company Delfin after his death, along with her stepmother and six siblings.","Besides EssilorLuxottica, Delfin also owns shares in insurer Generali; banks Monte dei Paschi di Siena and UniCredit; and real estate developer Covivio.","He is one of two children Del Vecchio had with Sabina Grossi, Luxottica's former head of investor relations, along with his brother Clemente."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Luca Ferrari cofounded Italian app developer Bending Spoons in 2013 with his three cofounders Matteo Danieli, Francesco Patarnello and Luca Querella. He is CEO.","The four friends launched Bending Spoons after working together on an unsuccessful, earlier startup Evertale, a note-taking app.","The Bending Spoons cofounders met while studying in Copenhagen, Denmark, and would later relocate to Milan, Italy, as their new startup took off.","The Milan, Italy-based startup struck on the strategy of buying apps and companies with a loyal audience where it sees the potential to overhaul its features and pricing.","Bending Spoons was largely bootstrapped until it raised its first major funding round in 2022 and made its first takeover of Evernote in 2023.","The company last raised $270 on a $11 billion in October 2025 to help fund its takeover of AOL and Vimeo. Bending Spoons is now Italy's most valuable startup and has bought, or taken private, a string of apps and startups like Meetup, Eventbrite, and WeTransfer."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Luca Garavoglia is chairman of Campari Group, one of the world's largest alcoholic beverage companies.","Campari's brands includes Skyy Vodka, Wild Turkey, Aperol and Campari.","Garavoglia inherited his stake in the company from his parents. His mother, Rosa Anna Magno Garavoglia, died in 2016.","He now owns an estimated 26% of the company, which listed on the Milan Stock Exchange in 2001.","His late father, Domenico, was a long-time employee before the last remaining heir of the Campari family passed the company to him."]
abouts: ["His Campari group reportedly sold a villa on the French riviera to fellow billionaire Rinat Akhmetov in January 2020 for 200 million euros.","Garavoglia speaks Italian, English, French and Spanish."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Luca Querella cofounded Italian app developer Bending Spoons in 2013 with his three cofounders Luca Ferrari, Matteo Danieli and Francesco Patarnello.","The four friends launched Bending Spoons after working together on an unsuccessful, earlier startup Evertale, a note-taking app.","The Bending Spoons cofounders met while studying in Copenhagen, Denmark, and would later relocate to Milan, Italy, as their new startup took off.","The Milan, Italy-based startup struck on the strategy of buying apps and companies with a loyal audience where it sees the potential to overhaul its features and pricing.  \r\n","Bending Spoons was largely bootstrapped until it raised its first major funding round in 2022 and made its first takeover of Evernote in 2023.","The company last raised $270 on a $11 billion in October 2025 to help fund its takeover of AOL and Vimeo. Bending Spoons is now Italy's most valuable startup and has bought, or taken private, a string of apps and startups like Meetup, Eventbrite, and WeTransfer."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Luciano Benetton started the Benetton Group in 1965 with his three siblings, Carlo (d.2018), Gilberto (d.2018) and Giuliana.","Known for their colorful sweaters, Benetton won over parts of the world, opening its first store in Paris in 1969 and reaching New York in 1980.","In 2018, 12 years after leaving and allowing outside managers to take on greater roles, Luciano returned to help turn the company around.","The family has invested in Italian businesses including Mundys, a highway infrastructure company that accounts for more than half their fortune."]
abouts: ["Luciano was elected to the Italian Senate in 1992 and served until 1994.","At age 14 Luciano's father died. Soon after he started working at a clothing store to help his family make ends meet."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Brazil's Luciano Hang has found success with department store chain Havan by focusing heavily on physical stores rather than online sales.","Hang cofounded Havan in 1986; today it employs approximately 20,000 people in over 150 locations.","Hang bought out his cofounder early on and today owns nearly all of Havan, which had about $1.9 billion in 2020 revenues.","Hang has many followers on social media; he regularly live streams about politics on Facebook and gets up to 1 million views.","Hang is a vocal supporter of Brazil's President Jair Bolsonaro, a right-wing candidate who was elected in October 2018."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lucio Co and his wife Susan control and run Puregold Price Club, a chain of hypermarkets and supermarkets they cofounded in 1998.","Starting with a location in Mandaluyong City, the chain now boasts nearly 800 stores across the Philippines.","Susan is chairman and Lucio a director of Puregold. Their son, Ferdinand Vincent, helps them run the company as president.","The Cos also head listed Cosco Capital, which has stakes in liquor distribution and real estate businesses.","They have interests in gaming and hotels as well."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lucio Tan is the founder and chairman of LT Group, which has interests in tobacco, spirits, banking and property development.","In 1982, Tan established Asia Brewery. Now a subsidiary of LT, the brewery was the only one then to compete with the market leader San Miguel.","Tan's grandson and heir apparent Lucio Tan III was appointed president of LT Group and PAL Holdings in 2023."]
abouts: ["Lucio Tan enjoys riding helicopters.","Tan studied chemical engineering at Far Eastern University.","PAL Holdings, the parent company of Philippine Airlines, completed its debt restructuring and turned profitable in 2021 after four years of losses."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lucy Guo cofounded data labeling giant Scale AI, and founded and runs creator platform Passes.","Guo ranked as the world's youngest self-made woman billionaire from April 2025 to December 2025.","The daughter of electrical engineers who emigrated from China, Guo taught herself to code in elementary school so that she could adopt virtual pets in a game called Neopets.","She studied computer science and human-computer interactions at Carnegie Mellon University but dropped out before graduating to become a Thiel Fellow.","Guo launched Scale AI in 2016 but left in 2018 amid a falling out with her cofounder, Alexandr Wang. She still owns roughly 3% of the company, which is the source of most of her fortune.","In June 2025, Meta bought 49% of Scale AI for about $14 billion and Scale paid its shareholders a hefty dividend.","She founded Passes, a platform for creators and celebrities to connect with fans that's similar to Patreon and OnlyFans, in 2022; she is CEO and has raised $50 million from investors. "]
qas: [{"label":"Dream Mentor","question":"What living person is your dream mentor?","answer":"Sheryl Sandberg","hidden":false},{"label":"App you can't live without","question":"Go-to app","answer":"Twitter","hidden":false}]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lucy Stitzer chairs Waycrosse, the investment company of the Cargill and MacMillan families, one of the 10 richest clans in America.","Stitzer owns an estimated 3% stake in Cargill, the largest food company in the world.","She's one of four billionaire sisters who inherited stakes in the company from their father W. Duncan MacMillan, who died in 2006.","Her great-great-grandfather, W.W. Cargill, founded the business as a single grain warehouse on the end of an Iowa railroad line in 1865.","The family still owns roughly 90% of Cargill, which did $154 billion in 2025 sales across food, agriculture, financial and industrial divisions."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Ludwig Merckle owns 28% of construction group Heidelberg Materials, which he took over in crisis after the death of his father, Adolf, in 2009.","Along with other members of his family, he owns Phoenix Pharma SE, a drug wholesaler that also operates a chain of retail pharmacies.","His father died by suicide during a debt crisis that threatened to crush the family fortune until Ludwig orchestrated a turnround.","To finance the rescue, he refinanced debt, sold drug maker Ratiopharm and a large stake in Heidelberg, and nearly had to sell Phoenix.","He owns the snowcat maker Kaessbohrer and is co-owner of Zollern, which makes a range of  products including bearings, gears, winches and motors."]
abouts: ["Ludwig Merckle was named Family Entrepreneur of the Year in 2017 by PwC's INTES Family Business Academy.","A naturalist by hobby, he also owns the forestry company Blauwald."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Ludwig Theodor Braun owns 10% of the medical device company B. Braun Melsungen, which began in 1839 as a small pharmacy that sold herbal remedies.","His father, Ludwig Georg Braun, took the reins in 1977, when the company had just $24 million in annual sales (now around $8 billion).","A sixth-generation family member, Ludwig Theodor is the youngest son of Ludwig Georg. His sister Anna Maria is CEO of B. Braun.","Today, with more than 64,000 employees globally, B. Braun manufactures products ranging from infusion and injection solutions to surgical instruments."]
abouts: ["B. Braun has been operating in Africa for more than 60 years, and now has subsidiaries in Zambia, Algeria, South Africa, Zimbabwe and Kenya."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Luigi Berlusconi is the son of Silvio Berlusconi, the media mogul and the longest-serving Italian prime minister in the post-war era, who died at age 86 in June 2023.","Luigi is one of five heirs to media group Fininvest, which his father started in the late 1970s and built into a national force, importing American shows like 'Baywatch' to Italy.","His father Silvio, three-time Italian prime minister, was convicted of tax fraud in 2014 and was initially banned from running for political office until 2019.","He has served on the board of directors of Fininvest since 2012."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Luigi Cremonini supplies hamburger meat to McDonald's and Burger King in Italy and other countries through his privately-held Inalca SpA.","Born to poor farmers in an Italian village near Modena, Cremonini got his start by opening a small butcher shop in 1963.","Beginning in the late 1970s he diversified into cured meats, distribution and catering and within a decade expanded the business internationally.","Today Cremonini Group employs more than 19,500 workers all over the globe and generated $5.6 billion in revenues in 2022.","Its catering arm Chef Express sells food on trains in Europe, Turkey and Russia, including the Eurostar service between London and Paris."]
abouts: ["In 1994 the University of Bologna awarded Cremonini an honorary degree in Veterinary Medicine.","An art lover, Cremonini has a vast collection of paintings and contributed to the restoration of an archaeological area near the Trevi fountain in Rome."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Luis Carlos Sarmiento Angulo took a fortune amassed in the construction industry and invested it in banks.","His Grupo Aval now controls one third of all banks in Colombia; his son Luis Carlos Sarmiento Gutierrez is chairman.","After graduating with a degree in engineering, Sarmiento briefly worked at a construction company, but took a 10,000 pesos payout and started his own firm.","He bought Colombia's largest newspaper El Tiempo in 2012 for an estimated $250 million.","His construction firm built the Grand Hyatt in Bogota, which opened in August 2018."]
abouts: ["At age 14 he worked part time at Colombia's national radio network making programs for children.","He is the second youngest in a family of 9 children."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Luis Enrique Yarur Rey is the chairman of Banco de Credito e Inversiones (BCI), a Chilean retail and commercial bank.","BCI has nearly 200 branches throughout Chile, Peru and Florida.","The bank was founded by the Yarur family in 1937. Today, it is one of Chile's largest banking institutions, with more than $80 billion in assets.","In 2015, BCI purchased City National Bank of Florida for $947 million; it was the first time a Chilean bank purchased a U.S. financial institution."]

name: Billionaires
