bios: ["Scott Lin cofounded lens supplier Largan Precision with Tony Chen in 1987.","The company is a leading smartphone lens maker and a major supplier to Apple, claiming a quarter of the global market.","Largan is now run by his sons, En-Ping and En-Chou."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Scott Nuttall is the co-CEO of storied private equity giant KKR.","He and Joseph Bae were appointed as chief executives in October 2021 when KKR co-founders Henry Kravis and George Roberts stepped down.","Nuttall first joined KKR in his early 20s, in 1996, following a brief stint at Blackstone.","He spearheaded KKR's capital markets, fundraising, insurance, credit and hedge fund initiatives, and helped take the company public in 2010.","KKR has about $638 billion in total assets under management."]
abouts: ["Nuttall and his billionaire co-CEO Joseph Bae began as KKR analysts together when they were 24."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Scott Shleifer cofounded Tiger Global Management's private equity investing arm in 2003, two years after Chase Coleman founded the hedge fund firm.","Tiger Global's venture funds now make up the bulk of the firm's $50 billion in net assets under management.","Shleifer made lucrative bets on several Chinese tech companies for Tiger, including JD.com, ride-hailing app Didi Chuxing and e-commerce giant Meituan.","Shleifer stepped down as Tiger Global's head of private equity at the start of 2024, transitioning to a role as senior advisor.","He bought a 21,000-square-foot Palm Beach mansion in 2021 for $123 million."]
bio: At Tiger Global, Shleifer manages private equity investing, a practice he co-founded in 2003, shortly after joining the firm. His repeated appearance on the Midas List is due in part to his international focus. Among his bets: marketplace app Meituan, in which Tiger has seen close to $2 billion in profits, and e-commerce business Shein, also based in China; travel provider Despegar, which went public in 2017 in Buenos Aires; and Grab, the Singapore-based on-demand app set to go public in April 2021.
title: Partner

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Scott Smith is one of three cofounders of Utah-based cloud computing company Qualtrics.","He cofounded the company in Provo, Utah in 2002 with his two sons, Ryan and Jared; Ryan is the CEO.","Three days before its scheduled IPO in January 2019, Qualtrics was acquired by German software firm SAP for $8 billion in cash.","Scott owned about 14% of the company at the time of the sale.","The company sold a second time in March 2023 to Silver Lake and CPP Investments at a $12.5 billion valuation."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Scott Watterson is the cofounder of Logan, Utah-based fitness equipment maker iFIT. He stepped down as CEO in February 2022 but remains the chairman.","The firm makes interactive treadmills, bikes and other machines and offers fitness content under brands like NordicTrack and ProForm and the iFIT app.","Watterson and his college buddy Gary Stevenson started iFIT, then named Weslo, as college students at Utah State in 1977.","iFIT raised $200 million from Bernard Arnault-backed private equity firm L Catterton in October 2020 at a $7 billion valuation.","The company filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a potential IPO in August 2021 but withdrew in April 2022."]
abouts: ["Watterson spent five years as a Mormon missionary in Taiwan over two separate visits; he speaks fluent Mandarin Chinese.","iFIT and its largest rival, Peloton, have been embroiled in multiple patent infringement lawsuits since 2016."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Infosys cofounder S.D. Shibulal oversees his family office, Innovations Investment Management.","While he stepped down as the company's CEO in 2014, he continues to hold a small stake in the firm. \r\n","Shibulal cofounded business incubator Axilor Ventures together with former Infosys colleague Senapathy Gopalakrishnan. \r\n","He also chairs The Tamara, a boutique resort chain, which his daughter Shruti founded and runs."]
abouts: ["Along with wife, Kumari, he donates regularly to various causes through two family foundations.","From 1991 to 1996, Shibulal worked with Sun Microsystems in the US."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sean Parker's fortune stems from his brief tenure, at age 24, as Facebook's president. Parker is now a venture capital investor and philanthropist.","Parker was a teenage hacker and famously founded filesharing site Napster in 1999.","His interest in music led him to invest in Spotify in 2010. He served on the company's board until 2017.","He launched his Parker Foundation in 2015 with $600 million earmarked for science, global health and civic engagement.","In 2016, his foundation announced a $250 million grant to establish the Parker Institute for Cancer Immunotherapy.","Parker became chairman of image-generation startup Stability AI in 2024."]
abouts: ["Parker, who has asthma and allergies to certain foods, also founded the Sean N. Parker Center for Allergy & Asthma Research at Stanford in 2014.","Parker bought Brody House in Los Angeles from Ellen DeGeneres for approximately $55 million in 2014."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sebastian Glaser is the majority shareholder of Sick AG, a world leader in sensor technology.","His grandfather Erwin Sick, an optical engineer, founded the firm in 1946, using earnings from selling radios he made himself to support his family.","After the death of Erwin in 1988, his wife Gisela became the company's primary shareholder and installed external managers.","Active globally with more than 50 subsidiaries, Sick AG now employs around 10,000 people and has annual sales exceeding $2 billion.","Used in factory, logistics and process automation, its technologies are used to measure, locate, inspect and identify."]
abouts: ["After World War II, the American military in Munich granted Erwin Sick a license to set up own engineering firm, which became Sick AG.","Sebastian Glaser serves as managing director of the family's Sick Holding GmbH."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sebastian Kulczyk and his sister Dominika Kulczyk inherited a fortune from their father Jan, who died in 2015 from complications of minor heart surgery.","In 2018, the siblings divvied up assets, with Sebastian getting a stake in Autostrada Eksploatacja, which maintains a major highway.","He also took over the chemical business Ciech and shares in mining companies, the latter of which he sold. He took Ciech private in 2024, renaming it Qemetica.","Sebastian also founded and runs VC tech fund Manta Ray."]
abouts: ["Sebastian Kulczyk worked in the digital media unit at Sony BMG in New York when he was 21."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sefik Yilmaz Dizdar is a partner in LC Waikiki, a producer and retailer of ready-to-wear fashions and home items.","Designer Georges Amouyal and a partner founded LC Waikiki in France in 1985. Dizdar and partners including Mustafa Kucuk acquired it in 1997.","LC Waikiki's first international store opened in Romania in 2009. In 2016, it expanded into home textile products under the brand name LCW Home.","The company prides itself on promoting women into its management ranks.","Today, LC Waikiki has over 1,000 locations in 47 countries; roughly half are outside of Turkey. Its motto: \"Everyone deserves to dress well.\""]
abouts: ["LC Waikiki, with annual revenue of around $2.5 billion, is managed by Kucuk, also a billionaire, and his family.","The brand combines the name of the famous Hawaiian beach with \"LC,\" as in \"Les Copains\" (\"friends\" in French)."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Segolene Gallienne is the daughter of the late Albert Frere, the billionaire industrialist who died in 2018 at age 92.","Albert Frere, who was the richest person in Belgium, turned his family's scrap-metal business into a media, utilities and oil empire","Albert Frere' s business interests included Groupe Bruxelles Lambert (GBL bank), insurer Royale Belge, Petrofina and Tractebel before he began slowly selling off assets later in his career.","Gallienne is not involved in the management of her holding company \tbut her husband Ian Gallienne is the CEO of key participation GBL."]
abouts: ["Galliene sits on board of the Cheval Blanc winery, which is partly owned by the family and Bernard Arnault's Christian Dior.."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sekar Vembu get his wealth from his holding in privately held Zoho, which offers business software on the cloud.","He cofounded AdventNet, the precursor to Zoho, along with his two brothers as well as three other friends.","In 2002, he set up Vembu Technologies in Chennai, which offers data backup and disaster recovery solutions to small and medium firms.","His brother Sridhar, who was the face of the company, stepped down as CEO in February 2025 taking on a role as a chief scientist for company","His sister Radha Vembu is the largest shareholder in Zoho and also a billionaire."]
abouts: ["Zoho is setting up a new campus which an house 2,000 people in the tier 3 city of Kumbakkonam in the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu\r\n","Zoho is headquartered in Austin, Texas and Chennai, India.","Younger brother Mani is now Zoho's CEO."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Selçuk Bayraktar owns 52.5% of Turkish unmanned military drone manufacturer Baykar. He chairs the board and serves as chief technological officer.","He co-owns the firm with his brother Haluk; the company was founded by their father Özdemir in 1984 to make parts for the Turkish auto industry.","Baykar recorded sales of $1.9 billion in 2023 and its exports rose to $1.8 billion in 2024, thanks to contracts with militaries in Europe, Africa and the Middle East.","Baykar's most famous export, the Bayraktar drone, has been used so successfully by Ukrainian troops that it inspired a popular folk song.","He is the son-in-law of Turkish president Recep Tayyip Erdogan, having married his daughter Sümeyye in 2016."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Selina Stihl is a granddaughter Andreas Stihl, the German founder of the famous chainsaw company which bears his name.","She joined the family business in 2011 in Brazil as vice president of Finance and Administration and eventually became the CFO there.","Back in Germany, she's now deputy chair of the advisory board at Stihl, which saw $5.8 billion in sales in 2023.","Prior to joining the family business, she worked as an accountant for Deloitte in London.","The company was founded in 1926 and now employs 19,805 people."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Semahat Sevim Arsel is an heir to the Koc family fortune. She's the oldest member of the clan and the largest shareholder in its main holding company.","Besides energy, automotive, durable consumer goods and finance, Koc is active in technology, food, retail, tourism, agriculture and shipbuilding.","Semahat Arsel serves on the board of Koc Holding and is chairman of its tourism company, Setur. Her husband, Dr. Nusret Arsel, died in 2014 at age 92.","He left all of his wealth to the Vehbi Koc Foundation, named after his father-in-law. Semahat Arsel is president of the foundation.","She also serves as the vice president of the Florence Nightingale Foundation and is the founder of Koc University's School of Nursing."]
abouts: ["She suffered from an extended childhood illness, which later motivated her to establish the Semahat Arsel Nursing Education and Research Centre (SANERC).","Through SANERC, the Vehbi Koc Foundation and the Turkey Education Volunteers Foundation,  which she co-founded, she has impacted many civil society initiatives."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Cofounder of software giant Infosys, Senapathy \"Kris\" Gopalakrishnan retired from the company in 2014.","He occupied various positions at Infosys including that of CEO and vice chairman.","Since his retirement he has  invested in a slew of startups, such as Ki Mobility, a provider of automobile services, both through his business incubator Axilor Ventures and some venture funds.","He's funded the Centre for Brain Research at the Indian Institute of Science as well as the Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Research Center, named after his wife, at IIT Madras."]
abouts: ["Gopalakrishnan has also funded and created Itihaasa, a digital app that chronicles the evolution of India's IT industry.","He contributed $2.5 million to establish a center for innovation and entrepreneurship at IIT Madras, his alma mater.","He has received the Padma Bhushan, the nation's third-highest civilian honour."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Seo Jung-jin is cofounder of Celltrion, a biopharmaceutical firm that makes drugs to treat cancer, influenza and rheumatoid arthritis, among others.","With the success of biosimilars in South Korea, his Celltrion has become a favorite among investors.","In 2023, Seo returned as chairman of his Celltrion group, two years after stepping down from the role, and pledged to make major acquisitions.","Seo's eldest son Jin-seok is cochairman of Celltrion Inc.","Seo started Celltrion Inc. in 2002 and took it public in 2008."]
abouts: ["Seo is a former employee of Samsung Electro-Mechanics."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Serge Godin founded Canadian tech firm CGI Group in 1976 at age 26.","One of nine children, Godin started working for his father (who had just a fifth-grade education) at the family's sawmill at age 12.","He studied computer science and got an MBA from Quebec's Université Laval, then worked in consulting before using $5,000 in savings to start CGI.","Godin serves as co-chair of the $12 billion (revenue) company; he was president and CEO until 2006. His daughter, Julie, was appointed executive chair in 2025.","He has overseen more than 100 acquisitions, including the 1998 purchase of Bell Sygma, which nearly doubled the size of the company at the time."]
abouts: ["When his father's uninsured mill burned down, a young Godin worked at a convenience store after school and at a dry cleaner's on Saturdays to help pay the bills."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergei Galitsky is the founder of Magnit, one of Russia's biggest supermarket chains and cosmetics retailers with more than 30,000 stores in 2024.","Galitsky was CEO of Magnit until February 2018 when he sold almost all of his shares in the company to the state bank VTB for $2.4 billion.","Galitsky got his start in 1994 as a perfume and beauty supplies wholesaler.","An admirer of Wal-Mart, he opened his first grocery store in 1998 and advertised using the slogan \"Always Low Prices.\"","He took the company public in 2006."]
abouts: ["Galitsky owns the soccer team Krasnodar and a soccer academy. He has invested about $460 million in a new soccer stadium nicknamed Galiseum by local journalists.","Galitsky spent $70 million on a park near his soccer stadium, planting 2,500 trees.","With his brother-in-law, Galitsky owns a 173-acre winery that will soon be selling wine under the Galitsky & Galitsky label."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergei Gordeev is an investor in startups including Hyperloop One, a U.S. highspeed-travel startup.","In 2022 Gordeev resigned as CEO of PIK SZ, the biggest Russian real estate developer where he has about 60% shares.","In 1995, he founded Rosbuilding, which bought shares of different plants.","He bought a 20% stake in home builder PIK from billionaire Suleiman Kerimov in 2013, and eventually became the controlling shareholder.","He made his fortune buying up shares of industrial companies in Moscow and then turning factories into office complexes."]
abouts: ["Gordeev, who is interested in architecture, designed his own house in a London suburb.","Gordeev bought a factory once owned by a theater director, founded a theater there and for many years sponsored its troupe."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergei Katsiev, partner of billionaire Igor Kesaev, made his fortune in tobacco after the fall of the Soviet Union. \r\n","From 1991 to 1993, he worked in the government trade mission to the Netherlands.","When he returned to Russia, he headed Mercury Tobacco Corporation, an importer of tobacco products owned by Kesaev.","In 1998 Katsiev founded his own company, Megapolis, which also sold tobacco products.","In 2006 Katsiev and Kesaev merged their companies. Megapolis is now Russia's largest seller of tobacco products.","Philip Morris and Japan Tobacco International bought 40% of Megapolis for $1.5 billion in 2013."]
abouts: ["Katsiev is now the owner of Nizhny Karmadon, a mineral water producer sourced from the Caucasus.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergei Kolesnikov owns 50% of Technonicol, a global producer of roofing, waterproofing and thermal insulation materials.","He is a managing partner of Technonicol, which owns 72 companies and factories in seven countries in Europe and Asia.","Kolesnikov founded the company with his classmate Igor Rybakov in 1992.","Kolesnikov financed an ecopark near Ryazan with an area of more than 500,000 square meters with a hotel complex and biathlon track."]
abouts: ["Kolesnikov finances biathlon schools and built two biathlon stadiums.","Together with colleagues from Technonicol, Kolesnikov participates in sailing competitions."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergei Popov has cashed out of all his major investments in recent years.","He and his former partner Andrei Melnichenko made a fortune managing finance and industrial group MDM.","They later created TMK, one of the world's largest oil and gas pipe manufacturers, with fellow billionaire Dmitry Pumpyansky.","They sold out to Pumpyansky in 2006. That same year the partners started to divide up their assets, a process completed in 2012.","In 2015 he sold MDM Bank to Russia's Binbank. Two years later it went bankrupt and came under the control of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation."]
abouts: ["Popov is a founder of a private fund called Agat, which has a mentoring program that offers young businesspeople startup capital.","Popov hired a special public relations agency to help him stay out of the press."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergei Studennikov is founder of the Krasnoye & Beloye (Red & White) chain of self-service liquor stores, the largest liquor retailer in Russia.","In 2019, he merged it with the Dixy supermarket chain owned by billionaires Igor Kesaev and Sergei Katsiev to form Mercury Retail Group Limited.","Mercury Retail, in which he and his wife have a 49% stake, is the leading alcohol retailer in Russia with 15,000 stores.","Mercury postponed its much anticipated IPO after Putin invaded Ukraine.","In the 1990s, Studennikov founded a company that distributed vodka, beer and tobacco. He opened his first Red & White store in Kopeysk in 2006."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergei Sudarikov is the main shareholder of Region Group, which includes banking, pension fund, insurance, brokerage and asset management companies.","Sudarikov began at Region in 1995 as a trader. In 2011, he and a group of partners bought the business from its founder.","Region bought several asset management businesses from state-owned oil firm Rosneft in 2011, helping it become one of Russia's largest investment groups.","In 2019, Sudarikov agreed to merge his assets with billionaire Roman Avdeev's Rossium concern, active in finance, real estate development and oil.","He bought Avdeev's stake and became owner of 93% of Rossium in 2024."]
abouts: ["Sudarikov's main hobby is wild fishing. He caught his first fish at the age of three.","According to Sudarikov, his first business was selling books in the early 1990s."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergey Brin stepped down as president of Alphabet, parent company of Google, in 2019 but remains a board member and a controlling shareholder.","Brin moved to the U.S. from Russia when he was 6 years old in the wake of anti-Semitism against his family.","He cofounded Google with Larry Page in 1998 after the two met at Stanford University while studying for advanced degrees in computer science.","Google went public in 2004 and began trading as Alphabet, a newly created parent company, in 2015.","Brin has donated more than $2 billion to Parkinson's research, and focuses his charitable giving on conditions of the central nervous system and climate change. "]
title: Cofounder and board member

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergey Dmitriev cofounded software company JetBrains in 2000.","JetBrains' tools are used by more than 10 million software developers and project managers around the world.","Dmitriev serves as president of the Prague-based business.","His partner, Valentin Kipyatkov, is also a billionaire.","Dmitriev renounced Russian citizenship in 2023. He has Cyprus passport and lives in Cyprus."]
abouts: ["JetBrains was among the biggest employers of programmers in St. Petersburg. It closed all Russian business in 2022."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergey Kasyanenko cofounded Orimi, Russia's largest producer of tea and roasted coffee.","Orimi was founded in 1994 as the Orimi Trade company, which ran wholesale trade of flour, sugar and tea.","The company would become a major player in the Russian tea market, eventually launching its own tea packaging production.","Most of his fortune is cash, thanks to $1.5 billion of Orimi dividends paid over more than a decade."]
abouts: ["Kasyanenko has Ph.D. in Physics and Mathematics."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergey Mikhaylov inherited his fortune from his father, Igor Babaev, former managing director Cherkizovsky, a formerly state-owned meat-packing plant in Moscow. ","Babaev became controlling shareholder of Cherkizovsky during Russia's privatization era in the 1990s, later adding pig and poultry farms, feed mills and other meat-packing plants. ","Cherkizovo is now the largest meat producer in Russia, with 360,000 hectares (about 900,000 acres) of agricultural land.","Babaev retired from business in 2015 and gifted the shares to his two sons and ex-wife, who relinquished her shares in 2022. ","Mikhaylov had internships with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley (USA) in the early 2000s."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergey Shishkarev is the founder Delo Group, one of Russia's largest transport and logistics companies, which he started in 1993.","Delo's core asset is DeloPorts, which owns several terminals in the Novorossiysk sea port.","In 2019, state-owned conglomerate Rosatom bought a 30% stake in Delo. Since then Shishkarev has made several mergers and acquisitions to expand the business.","Shishkarev started Delo as a logistics and port management company. It's since become a major domestic player in the transportation industry with interests in sea terminals, rail cars and ships.","In 2022 Delo acquired shipping company SASCO and a stake in Maersk's Global Ports, Russia's largest container operator.\t"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sergio Stevanato is chairman emeritus of the Stevanato Group, a medical packaging firm based in Piombino Dese, Italy.","Founded by his father Giovanni in 1949, the company is now run by his sons Franco and Marco, who serve as chairman and vice chairman, respectively.","Stevanato Group went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021.","Stevanato Group is the second largest maker of glass vials in the world and a major supplier of vials for several Covid-19 vaccine manufacturers.","The company started out making glass bottles for wine and perfume and is now one of the world's largest producers of insulin pen cartridges."]
abouts: ["Stevanato owns a winery in northeast Italy, Tenuta Stella, named after the Stevanato Group's original name, Soffieria Stella.","In 2007, Stevanato was appointed a Cavaliere del Lavoro, one of Italy's highest civilian honors."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Seth Boro is a managing partner of software-focused private-equity firm Thoma Bravo, which ranks among the world's top buyout investors.","The firm, with assets of $181 billion, was formed in 2008, when Orlando Bravo and Carl Thoma split from partner Brian Cressey, who was focused on healthcare deals.","Boro, a Stanford MBA with a track record of over 15 exits and key investments like AI security platform Dynatrace, leads the firm's infrastructure and cybersecurity strategy.","He joined Thoma Bravo in 2005 after stints at Summit Partners and Credit Suisse, and became a managing partner in 2013.","Boro, originally from Canada, is a minority owner of the NHL's Ottawa Senators, the Bay Area-based National Women's Soccer League team Bay FC, and the parent company of the Leeds United soccer team."]
abouts: ["Boro was ranked in Mergers & Acquisitions Magazine's \"Rising Stars\" and San Francisco Magazine's \"40 Under 40.\"","Boro's family foundation, Room to Breathe, focuses on youth mental health issues in under-resourced communities."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Seth Klarman runs Boston-based hedge fund Baupost, which has $27.4 billion under management as of March 2023.","Klarman's book \"Margin of Safety,\" a cult classic among value investors, sells for about $1,700 on Amazon.","Once a major donor to the Republican Party, Klarman publicly denounced Trump in 2016, and has been contributing to the Democratic Party."]
abouts: ["In 2017, Klarman's horse, Cloud Computing, won the Preakness Stakes at Pimlico, the racetrack he grew up next to in Baltimore.","Klarman, whose philanthropic efforts focus on scientific research and promoting access to music learning, is also a major supporter of causes in Israel."]
title: CEO & President

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sezai Bacaksiz and his billionaire partner, Nihat Ozdemir, met as students at Gazi University and founded Limak Construction in 1976.","Besides being contractor for some of the world's largest infrastructure projects, Limak has operations in energy, tourism, transportation and cement.","It's part of a consortium building Istanbul's new airport. When all phases are complete, it will be the world's largest based on passenger capacity.","Limak is a major builder and operator of hydroelectric power plants, ranking among Turkey's top ten electricity producers.","Besides Turkey, Limak operates in Kuwait, Egypt, Kosovo, Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, Eastern Europe, Africa, Pakistan, Ukraine and Russia."]
abouts: ["In partnership with Punj Lloyd, Limak built the Trans-Anatolian Natural Gas Pipeline, which transports natural gas produced in the Caspian Sea to Turkey and Europe."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shahid Khan is the owner of auto parts supplier Flex-N-Gate and the NFL's Jacksonville Jaguars.","An immigrant from Pakistan, Khan bought Flex-N-Gate from his former employer in 1980.","An engineer, his design for a one-piece truck bumper was the basis for his success; the company now has 76 plants worldwide and over 27,000 employees.","Khan bought the Jacksonville Jaguars in 2012 and the UK's Fulham football club in 2013.","He and his son, Tony, launched All Elite Wrestling, a professional wrestling entertainment company and a competitor to WWE, in 2019.","He owns the Four Seasons Hotel Toronto and will open a new Four Seasons property in Jacksonville in December 2026."]
abouts: ["Shahid Khan arrived in the United States from Pakistan at age 16 with just $500 in his pocket.","He worked nights as a dishwasher while studying at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shalom Meckenzie is an Israeli entrepreneur who became the largest shareholder in daily fantasy and sports-betting firm Draft Kings in early 2020.","He secured an 11% stake in Draft Kings when it merged with his company, SBTech.","Meckenzie founded gambling-technology provider SBTech in 2007 and served as a director until May 2014.","DraftKings is an official daily fantasy and sports betting partner of the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, PGA TOUR and UFC.","Meckenzie spent $11.8 million to acquire a rare CryptoPunk NFT in a June 2021 auction run by Sotheby's."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shamsheer Vayalil is founder and chairman of Burjeel Holdings, a network of hospitals, clinics and pharmacies in the Middle East.","His net worth got a boost from the 2022 listing of Burjeel Holdings, which has used Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan as its brand ambassador.","Born into a business family in Kerala state, he migrated to the Middle East after his medical studies and worked as a radiologist at a local hospital.","Backed initially by his father-in-law, Gulf retailing billionaire M.A. Yusuff Ali, Vayalil started with one hospital in Abu Dhabi in 2007. Burjeel now has 19 hospitals and 29 medical centres.","Vayalil was vice chairman of investment firm Amanat Holdings until 2022. He remains chairman of listed Response Plus Holdings, a provider of medical services."]
abouts: ["Egyptian national Eman Ahmed, once billed as 'the world's heaviest woman', was treated free of cost at Vayalil's Burjeel Hospital until her death in September 2017.","Vayalil has signed the Giving Pledge."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shang Xiaobo is a general manager and director at Anhui Honglu Steel Construction Group, a supplier of steel buildings.","Honglu is headquartered in Hefei, the capital of Anhui Province.","Honglu was founded in 2002."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shao Qinxiang chairs Zhejiang Garden Bio-chemical High-tech, a supplier of pharmaceuticals and animal nutrition products.","Shao is the controlling shareholder of parent Garden Group, which was founded in 2000.","Garden Group was founded as a candle factory and then a garment manufacturer. It has since diversified into pharmaceuticals, energy and other fields."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shapoor Mistry controls the 157-year-old engineering and construction giant Shapoorji Pallonji Group","His late brother Cyrus was chairman of Tata Sons for four years until October 2016, when he was ousted.","The family's biggest asset is an 18.4% stake in Tata Sons, holding outfit of the $150 billion (revenue) Tata Group.","Mistry suffered a double loss in 2022: his father and group patriarch Pallonji Mistry died in June. Three months later his younger brother Cyrus Mistry died in a car crash at age 54.","Shapoor and Cyrus were jointly working to restructure the debt-laden family business by selling key assets."]
abouts: ["To reduce debt, the group plans to raise an estimated $850 million by listing privately held construction and engineering firm Afcons Infrastructure."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shari Arison inherited a fortune from her late father Ted (d. 1999), who founded cruise ship line Carnival Corp. Since then, she has reinvested all of it.","Israel's richest woman, Arison created The Doing Good Model - guidelines for incorporating social good into running a business.","She has invested in various real estate projects, including a desalination plant and a thermo-solar power plant. \r\n","Arison held a stake of more than 20% in Bank Hapoalim, Israel's largest bank. She gradually reduced her stake, selling the last of it in 2024.","She also founded the Ted Arison Family Foundation in 1981."]
abouts: ["Arison received the annual Medal of Light award from Israel's parliament in 2016 for her work with Holocaust survivors through the Arison Family Foundation.","In 2007, Arison launched the annual Good Deeds Day to advocate community service. In 2021, Good Deeds Day was recognized in 115 countries."]
title: Investor, Philanthropist

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sharon Azrieli is an heir to the Azrieli Group real estate fortune.","She and her two sisters, Danna and Naomi Azrieli, own about 46% of the publicly traded company.","She sits on the board and inherited her stake after her father, David Azrieli, died in 2014.","Sharon is also on the board of the family's Azrieli Foundation, which supports a number of causes, including science, music and Holocaust education."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sharron Hunt owns the NFL's Kansas City Chiefs with her three siblings. Her brother Clark is chairman and CEO.","Their father Lamar Hunt (d. 2006) founded the team and passed control to his kids in 2005. Lamar is credited with naming the Super Bowl.","Forbes estimates the Chiefs are now worth more than $4.7 billion (net of debt). Each Hunt Sibling owns an estimated 25% stake.","The Hunt siblings also own MLS team FC Dallas and a minority stake in the NBA's Chicago Bulls. Clark is chairman and CEO of the family's soccer club, while brother Dan is president.","Lamar was one of 11 heirs of oil wildcatter H.L. Hunt (d. 1974) who appeared on the first ever Forbes 400 list of the richest Americans in 1982."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shashank Kumar cofounded financial services firm Razorpay, which operates India's largest payment gateway by number of transactions processed.","Privately held Razorpay was last valued at $7.5 billion after raising more than $700 million over multiple funding rounds.","Marquee investors include private equity players such as Singapore's sovereign wealth fund GIC and U.S. private equity giant TVC Capital.","Credit card giant Mastercard also holds a stake.","It caters to the startup space serving 113 of the top 125 unicorns in India."]
abouts: ["It has acquired eight businesses to date including a payroll management outfit and a point-of-sale platform.","He has a B. Tech degree from India's elite Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shaul Shani is an Israeli investor who sold Brazilian firm Global Village Telecom to Vivendi for $4.5 billion in 2009; his take was $1.4 billion.","He has since increased his fortune via mezzanine lending and investments in emerging economies.","Starting in the 1980s, he cofounded three companies; two of them, Oshap Technologies and Tecnomatix, were acquired for $210 million and $228 million.","In 2014, Shani took control of Israeli communications equipment maker ECI Telecom; he agreed to sell to publicly traded Ribbon Communications in 2019.","In 2021, Shani became chairman of Rashi, one of Israel's largest charities."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shayne Coplan is the founder and CEO of Polymarket, which is one of the world's largest prediction markets.","Coplan launched Polymarket in 2020 to facilitate bets on everything from sports results, political elections, entertainment awards and more.","In October 2025, billionaire Jeff Sprecher's global stock exchange operator Intercontinental Exchange invested $2 billion in Polymarket at a $9 billion valuation.","The deal made Coplan the world's youngest self-made billionaire at the age of 27, thanks to his estimated 11% stake in Polymarket.","An NYU dropout, Coplan had previously secured a number of other billionaire backers including Airbnb cofounder Joe Gebbia, Ethereum founder Vitalik Buterin, Figma cofounder Dylan Field, Zynga cofounder Mark Pincus, Uber cofounder Travis Kalanick and hedge fund veteran Glenn Dubin.","Billionaire Peter Thiel's Founders Fund and Coinbase, cofounded and run by billionaire Brian Armstrong, are also investors in Polymarket."]
title: Founder

name: Billionaires
bios: ["She Yingjie chairs China's Olympic Circuit Technology.","Founded in 1985, the company produces a variety of printed circuit boards.","Olympic went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2017."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sheila Johnson cofounded cable TV channel Black Entertainment Television in 1979 with her then-husband Robert Johnson. Viacom bought it for $3 billion in 2001.\r\n","After her divorce in 2002, she sold her BET shares and has since invested in a portfolio of hotels known as the Salamander Collection, as well as other real estate and horses.","Her Innisbrook resort in Palm Harbor, Florida, hosts an annual PGA Tour championship.","She was an executive producer of the critically-acclaimed 2013 film The Butler, which tells the story of a former slave turned White House employee.","Through her investment in Monumental Sports & Entertainment, she owns stakes in three Washington sports teams: the WNBA's Mystics, NBA's Wizards and NHL's Capitals."]
abouts: ["Johnson is the only black woman to own stakes in three professional sports teams.","Johnson's parents enrolled her in an all-white school in early 1950s Kentucky before desegregation was federally mandated."]
title: CEO

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shekhar Bajaj hails from the storied clan behind the nearly century-old Bajaj Group.","The group was chaired by his late cousin Rahul Bajaj, who died in February 2022 at age 83.","The group is best known for motorcycle maker Bajaj Auto and financial services arm Bajaj Finserv.","Shekhar Bajaj, a New York University business grad, is chairman and managing director of  consumer durables company Bajaj Electricals.","In 2025, the family agreed to buy out Germant giant Allianz's stake In their two insurance joint ventures for $2.8 billion."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shen Guojun is the founder and chairman of Yintai Group, whose interests cover retail, real estate and investment.","Yintai's department store chain Intime was taken private from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange by Shen and Alibaba in 2017, in a deal that valued it at $2.6 billion.","Shen worked in a state-run bank before he started his own business.","The tycoon has divested sizable stakes in gold, property and other businesses amid China's slower growth.","In 2024, Alibaba sold its 99% stake in Intime to a consortium led by China's textile heavyweight Youngor Group for $1 billion, registering $1.3 billion loss."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shen Jinhua chairs Focus Technology, the parent company of InQbrands, which operates two of China's popular business-to-business e-commerce sites: Made-in-China.com, Abiz.com, xyz.cn and InQbrands.","Launched in 1998, Made-in-China.com connects 12 million buyers to suppliers who hail from 220 countries and regions and cover a slew of categories ranging from food and chemicals to medicine and transportation.","In 2015 Focus Technology acquired U.S.-based Doba Inc., a similar platform that connects buyers and suppliers."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shen Xiqiang is vice chairman of Jiangsu Yoke Technology, a supplier of electronics, insulation and plastics materials.","Shen cofounded Yoke in 1997 in the Yixing county of Jiangsu province.","His elder son Shen Qi is Yoke's chairman; younger son Shen Fu is deputy general manager.","Jiangsu Yoke Technology went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2010."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sherry Brydson is one of six billionaire heirs to the media and publishing empire founded by her grandfather Roy Thomson (d. 1976).","The family's biggest holding: more than 310 million shares of Thomson Reuters.","Thomson owns around 23% of the business, the largest stake of any of the heirs, through the family's investment firm, Woodbridge.","The family's other assets include the Toronto-based Globe and Mail newspaper, and the Montreal Canadiens and Winnipeg Jets sports teams."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sheryl Sandberg served as chief operating officer of Facebook, now Meta, from 2008 until the fall of 2022.","Sandberg and her husband, Tom Bernthal, launched Sandberg Bernthal Venture Partners in 2021 to invest their own capital in startups.","Sandberg is the author of the bestselling books \"Lean In: Women, Work, and the Will to Lead\" and \"Lean In for Graduates.\"","The Harvard MBA was previously an economist at the World Bank and chief of staff to then U.S. Treasury Secretary Larry Summers."]
abouts: ["Sandberg was previously vice president of online sales and operations at Google and a management consultant at McKinsey & Co.","Sandberg married Tom Bernthal, who was CEO of a consulting agency, in 2022."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shi Yonghong cofounded Sichuan hot pot chain Haidilao in 1994 with Zhang Yong, also a billionaire, and two friends who became their wives.","The company, which had about $4.4 billion in sales from almost 1,300 locations in 2020, went public in Hong Kong in September 2018.","Known for offering special services such as free manicures for waiting customers, Haidilao has expanded to the U.S., Japan, South Korea and Singapore. \r\n","Shi, who owns his stake in Haidilao with wife Li Haiyan, has a stake in Yihai International, hot pot condiment maker that was spun off from Haidilao.","Shi sits on the board of both companies."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shi Yuzhu is chairman of Giant Interactive, an online game developer and operator in China.","Giant, which had traded in New York, was relisted on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2016 through a reverse merger with Chongqing New Century Cruise.","Shi was a revered entrepreneur in China in the 1980s when he first made his fortune in computer hardware.","A graduate of Zhejiang University, Shi got his degree in math."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shigefumi Wada is the president and founder of publicly traded software and IT firm Obic Business Consultants.","Obic Business Consultants is known for its cloud accounting services and its television ads featuring a kabuki actor.","Wada started the business in 1980; his wife Hiroko is vice president and a board member.","Together Wada and his wife own a significant stake in the company.","Obic, another IT services firm, is a major shareholder and its founder and CEO Masahiro Noda is chairman of Obic Business Consultants."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shigenobu Nagamori is the founder and chairman of motor manufacturer Nidec.","Nidec bills itself as the world's largest manufacturer of motors for hard-disk drives and optical drives, by units sold.","Nagamori has said publicly that his goal is to hit ¥10 trillion ($91 billion) in revenue by 2030, partly by focusing on drivetrains for electric vehicles.","In 2024, Mitsuya Kishida, one of five executive vice presidents, became the new president and CEO.","Nidec was removed from Nikkei 225 and Topix indexes in November 2025. The exchange marks it a \"security on special alert\" due partly to lax internal controls and an ongoing investigation over accounting scandal at one of its subsidiaries."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shin Chang-Jae is the chairman and CEO of Kyobo Life Insurance, founded by his father in 1958 as Daehan Kyoyuk Insurance.","When Shin assumed the posts in 2000, Kyobo was reeling from investment portfolio losses in the aftermath of the Asian financial crisis.","He turned the company around, focusing on customer satisfaction and risk control.","With a network of agents and financial planners, the company now offers insurance and asset-management products to more than 5 million customers."]
abouts: ["He has a mischievous penchant for staging stunts to make a point, such as reportedly taking part in his own fake funeral.","In 2010, he received the 19th Montblanc de la Culture Arts Patronage Award for his support of Korean literature through the Daesan Foundation."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shin Dong-joo is the eldest son of Shin Kyuk-Ho, the late founder of Lotte Group, one of South Korea's largest conglomerates.","The retail heavyweight has interests ranging from food and beverage to chemicals, construction and professional baseball.","In 2015, he was dismissed from his executive positions in the group after a bitter feud with his brother Dong-Bin."]
abouts: ["Lotte started as a confectionery manufacturer in Japan in 1948 and expanded into South Korea in 1967.","At the start of his career, he worked for Mitsubishi in Japan in 1978."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shintaro Tsuji is founder and honorary chairman of Sanrio, the Japanese creator of Hello Kitty.","He founded it as a gifts company in 1960 and went on to create the bestselling Hello Kitty character.","Tsuji's son Kunihiko died in 2013 and he passed the baton to his grandson Tomokuni, who is now Sanrio's CEO.","Sanrio, which operates two amusement parks in Japan, posted over $1 billion in revenue in the fiscal year through March 2025."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shirley Kao owns stakes in Uni-President Enterprises, the food and beverage conglomerate cofounded by her father, Kao Chin-Yen, in 1967.","She was the sole inheritor of her father's fortune after he died in 2016.","She has been a board member at Uni-President since 2013 and heads the group's health and beauty-related subsidiaries.","Her husband, Alex Lo, was promoted to CEO of  the group in 2007 and doubled as its chairman after his father-in-law retired in 2013.","Before Lo turned 60 and stepped down from the CEO post in 2016, he had more than doubled the company's market cap to over $10 billion. He continues to lead the group as chairman."]
abouts: ["Kao and her husband, Alex Lo, were high school sweethearts, but had a second chance at love only after her first marriage failed.","By that time her father was no longer opposed to her marrying a mainland Chinese descendant."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shiv Kishan Agrawal, who was running Nagpur-based Haldiram Foods International, merged his company with Delhi-based Haldiram Foods in 2023 to create Haldiram Snacks Food.","A consortium of investors led by Singapore's Temasek, acquired a 20% stake in the merged company in 2025 at an estimated valuation of $10 billion.","Agrawal is the grandson of the founder Ganga Bishan Agarwal, who started selling snacks from a tiny shop in Bikaner in Rajasthan and went on to create the popular Haldiram brand.","The business was eventually divided among the patriarch's grandsons into three separate companies, operating out of Nagpur, Delhi and Kolkata."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Indian IT pioneer Shiv Nadar cofounded HCL in a garage in 1976 to make calculators and microprocessors with five friends.","Today, his $14.5 billion (revenue) HCL Technologies is among India's largest software services providers.","In 2020, he stepped down as chairman of HCL Technologies, handing over the position to his daughter, Roshni Nadar Malhotra. He's now chairman emeritus and strategic advisor.","HCL Technologies, which employs over 226,000 people in 60 countries worldwide, hires high school grads and trains them on the job.","In March 2025, Nadar transferred a chunk of shares in his investments companies that hold shares in the listed flagship to his daughter Roshni as part of his succession planning. "]
abouts: ["One of India's leading philanthropists, Nadar has donated $1.1 billion to his Shiv Nadar Foundation, which backs education-related causes.","Nadar's education was primarily in the south Indian language of Tamil, and he didn't start speaking much English until age 22.","Nadar's wife Kiran, who is an avid art collector, has two private art museums in Delhi that showcase her vast collection."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shiv Ratan Agarwal was the founder and chairman of Bikaji Foods International, a maker of Indian snacks and sweets. He died in April 2026 at age 75.","It was started as Shivdeep Products in 1986, combining his name and that of his son Deepak. He launched the Bikaji brand in 1993.","Bikaji Foods got listed in November 2022 at an 8% premium to its IPO price.","His grandfather Gangabishan Agarwal founded the famous Haldiram brand of Indian snacks."]
abouts: ["The name Bikaji is derived from Bika Rao, the founder of Bikaner city in the state of Rajasthan. "]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shlomo Eliahu owns about 45% of Migdal, a leading insurance and finance group in Israel.","Eliahu grew up poor and, in 1950, emigrated with his family from Iraq to Israel, where he went from living in a transit camp to founding an underwriting agency.","His Eliahu Insurance Company was the country's first insurance company.","Politically active, Eliahu served as a member of Israel's parliament from 1978 to 1981 and was chairman of the finance committee."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shlomo Kramer is cofounder and CEO of Cato Networks, a cloud security startup last valued by investors in 2021 at $2.5 billion.","He cofounded Check Point Software, a firewall security pioneer, with fellow Israelis Gil Shwed and Marius Nacht in 1993. Check Point went public in 1996.","Kramer cofounded data security company Imperva in 2002; it went public in 2011 and was acquired by Thoma Bravo in 2019 for about $2.1 billion.","Kramer was an early investor and board member at cybersecurity company Palo Alto Networks, founded by former Check Point employee Nir Zuk.","He has also invested in sales software maker Gong, cybersecurity company Exabeam and cloud data company Sumo Logic."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shmuel Harlap was part owner of Colmobil, Israel's largest car importer. He died in August 2026 at age 82.","Harlap's father acquired Colmobil in 1962. Harlap became chairman in 1982.","He was also an active investor. He put $10,000 into automotive tech startup Mobileye in 2001 and eventually acquired a 7.2% stake.","When Intel purchased Mobileye for $15.3 billion in cash in 2017, Harlap netted $750 million from the deal, making him a billionaire.","Harlap was a major investor in Israeli startups, particularly in the cybersecurity, nanotechnology and life sciences industries."]
abouts: ["While Harlap was fighting in the Six-Day War, his father was persuading Mercedes-Benz to deliver 1,625 trucks to Israel to move supplies.","Harlap earned a Ph.D. in political philosophy from Harvard."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shrikant Badve is the founder and managing director of Pune-based automotive parts supplier Belrise Industries, which makes everything from shock absorbers to rearview mirrors for motorcycles, cars and commercial vehicles.","The company's marquee clients include motorbike manufacturers Eicher, Hero Motocorp and TVS, as well as auto companies Jaguar Land Rover and Mahindra and Mahindra.","Badve started out making fasteners in 1988 in a 150-square-foot shed with three machines and two workers.","Belrise shares were listed in May 2025 at an 11% premium to the issue price.","His wife Supriya sits on the board and his sons, Sumedh (a Harvard MBA) and Swastid (a Wharton graduate), lead business development and strategy respectively."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shu Ping is a cofounder of Chinese hot pot chain Haidilao International Holding.","Shu and three friends, including Zhang Yong who became her husband and is now chairman and CEO of the company, set up their first restaurant with personal savings in 1994.","Haidilao has nearly 1,400 restaurants in Greater China. It is renowned for its spicy dishes and attentive customer service, including free manicures for waiting customers.","It spun off its overseas business Super Hi, which went public in Hong Kong in 2022 and had a dual listing on Nasdaq in 2024. Super Hi has over 120 restaurants in international markets.","Shu became chairman of Super Hi in 2023."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shuo Wang is cofounder and chief revenue officer of HR software company Deel. \t","In 2019, Wang started Deel with MIT classmate Alex Bouaziz to make it easier for companies to hire employees globally.","Deel raised funding at a $17.3 billion valuation in October 2025 and surpassed $1 billion in annual recurring revenue earlier in the year.","Wang moved to the U.S. from China when she was 16, then studied mechanical engineering with a focus on robotics at MIT.","After college, Wang cofounded and was chief technology officer of air purifier maker Aeris; iRobot bought it in 2021 for around $100 million."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Shyam Bhartia chairs the Jubilant Bhartia group with interests in energy, fast food, pharma and auto distribution.","The Jubilant group has four listed companies.","Jubilant Foodworks has hundreds of Domino's Pizza outlets across India.","Jubilant Life Sciences was split into two companies, Jubilant Pharmova and Jubilant Ingrevia. The latter was listed in March 2021.","His younger brother Hari, who is also a billionaire, is co-chairman."]
abouts: ["Bhartia's wife Shobhana has her separate media company, which publishes the Hindustan Times daily newspaper.","In February 2025, a police case was filed against him for allleged rape and criminal intiimdation of an aspiring Bollywood actress. Bhartia denied the allegations.","In December 2024, the Bhartia brothers acquired a 40% stake in Coca Cola's Indian bottler for 125 billion rupees ($1.5 billion).\r\n","In December 2024, the Bhartia brothers acquired a 40% stake in Coca Cola's Indian bottler for 125 billion rupees ($1.5 billion)."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Palantir's chief technology officer, Sankar has worked with the company in various positions since 2006. When he joined the company, he was its 13th employee.","In June 2025, Sankar was one of four tech executives to join the U.S. Army Reserves' Executive Innovation Corps.","Sankar serves on the board of Gingko Bioworks, a biotech company working on genetically engineered bacteria.","He is also a trustee of the Hudson Institute, a right-leaning think tank based in Washington, D.C.","Sankar's wife, Pooja, worked as a software developer at Oracle, Kosmix and Facebook, before starting Piazza, a classroom discussion software."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sid Bass inherited several million dollars from his oil tycoon great-uncle Sid Richardson in 1959. He's been diversifying ever since.","Bass has nurtured the careers of famed investors like Richard Rainwater.","He personally negotiated the $6 billion sale of Bass oilfields in 2017 with then ExxonMobil CEO Rex Tillerson.","He rescued ice cream maker Blue Bell with an investment after a 2015 listeria outbreak."]
abouts: ["The 2018 Malibu wildfires destroyed the Frank Gehry-designed home Bass bought there in 2015 for $15 million.","A September 2001 margin call wiped out billions worth of Bass-owned shares in Disney."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sidney Kimmel founded apparel company Jones Group more than four decades ago; it owned brands including Stuart Weitzman and Nine West.","In 2014, he sold the company for $2.2 billion to private equity firm Sycamore Partners.","His production company Sidney Kimmel Entertainment was responsible for movies including ?The Place Beyond The Pines? and ?Crazy Rich Asians,? before he sold a majority stake in 2022 to London-based investment firm Centricus.","Kimmel has donated more than $200 million to Thomas Jefferson University over the past two decades, much of which has gone to cancer research."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Silvana Armani is the niece of billionaire fashion designer Giorgio Armani (d. September 2025) and the daughter of his late brother Sergio Armani.","She is a board member of Armani's namesake fashion firm and leads the womenswear division. She is also seen as her uncle's stylistic successor.","Under the terms of Armani's will, Silvana is entitled to 17% of the net proceeds from the sale or public listing of 45% of the company within five years of Armani's death.","She also inherited some of Armani's shares in eyewear giant EssilorLuxottica as well as a stake in Armani's superyacht and his empire of luxury homes."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Simon Nixon earned the bulk of his fortune from his price-comparison website MoneySuperMarket.","He cofounded the company in 1993, took it public in 2007, and sold all his shares in it by 2016.","Nixon has invested in dozens of private companies, including--before they went public--Airbnb, Robinhood and Wise (formerly called Transferwise).","He also owns luxury homes around the globe, including in Malibu and Barbados, which he lists for private holiday rentals on his site, SimonEscapes."]
abouts: ["In 2013, Nixon moved from Chester, England, to tax haven Jersey, where he owns a multi-million dollar home.","Nixon studied accounting at Nottingham University before dropping out at the age of 20."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Simón Pedro Barceló Vadell is the co-chair and largest shareholder of the Barceló Group, one of Spain's largest hotel operators and tourism companies.","The group traces its roots to Simon Barceló, who founded the business in 1931 as a transportation company and expanded to tourism in 1954.","In 1962, the company opened its first hotel on the island of Majorca, and through a series of acquisitions expanded overseas, starting with the Caribbean, then Costa Rica and later the U.S.","Today Barceló has more than 300 4-star and 5-star hotels with 65,000 rooms in 30 countries.","Barceló Vadell's cousin, Simón Barceló Tous, is co-chair but is expected to step down in 2025, when he turns 65 years of age."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Simon Reuben shares a real estate, technology and investment fortune with his brother David Reuben.","In 2016, they sold 49% of their data center business, GlobalSwitch, to a consortium of Chinese investors for nearly $3 billion.","They sold a further 25% of the business in 2018 for $2.7 billion to a consortium of Asian institutional and private investors for $2.7 billion.","The brothers were born in Mumbai and raised in the U.K., where David started off trading metals and Simon imported carpets and bought real estate.","Their firm Transworld, a metals trader, invested in Russia and Kazakhstan in the 1990s and was active in trading aluminum.","The Reuben family owns an estimated 14% of Premier League's Newcastle United F.C."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Simona Giorgetta is the largest shareholder and on the board of MAPEI, a manufacturer of chemical products used in construction based in Milan, Italy.","She is the niece of Giorgio Squinzi, who led MAPEI from 1984 until his death in October 2019; Giorgio's father Rodolfo founded the company in 1937.","The company's products have been used in projects ranging from the Panama City metro to the restoration of the Coliseum in Rome.","Giorgetta shares ownership of the company with her cousins Marco and Veronica, Giorgio's two children, who serve as co-CEOs of MAPEI.","Together, Giorgetta and her cousins also own Italian soccer team Sassuolo Calcio, which Giorgio acquired in 2003."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Simone Maag de Moura Cunha owns 3.5% of Swiss dental giant Straumann Group.","Her billionaire uncle Rudolf Maag is the company's second largest shareholder after her brother-in-law Thomas Straumann.","Rudolf Maag bought out Straumann's medical device division in 1990 and later took it public as Stratec Medical.","In 1999 he merged Stratec with Swiss medical device powerhouse Synthes and built up a 15% stake, which was later sold to Johnson & Johnson."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sky Xu is cofounder and CEO of Shein, a fast-fashion phenomenon with Gen Z, selling trendy clothes in more than 150 countries.","Backed by HongShan, formerly Sequoia China, it's one of the world's most popular shopping apps whose users love its low prices.","The company raised money at a valuation of $100 billion in the first half of 2022; it subsequently fell back amid a global stock rout. ","It ventured offline in 2023, teaming up with Sparc Group, the operator of fast fashion chain Forever 21, to step into the retailer's locations across the U.S.","Facing regulatory hurdles to an IPO in the U.S., Shein had been pursuing a listing in London and subsequently in Hong Kong. It went public in Hong Kong in September 2026, raising $1.7 billion at a valuation of $26.5 billion. "]
abouts: ["In 2022, Shein opened its first U.S. distribution center in Whitestown, Indiana and its first Canadian one in the greater Toronto area."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Nurlan Smagulov is the founder and president of Astana Group, a Kazahkstani business with interests in car dealerships and shopping malls.\t","The group was founded in 1992 as Astana Motors, a car dealership, which now operates as a distributor and dealer for over a dozen automobile brands, as well as a manufacturer of passenger and commercial vehicles.","Smagulov launched one of the country's first modern shopping and entertainment center formats, MEGA, in 2006.\r\n","In 2025, he built Kazakhstan's first private museum of contemporary art, the Almaty Museum of Arts, investing more than $120 million in the project.","The museum will include works by Richard Serra, Anselm Kiefer, Yayoi Kusama, and Bill Viola, as well as art by Yinka Shonibare, Jaume Plensa, and Alicja Kwade created specifically for the museum.\t"]
abouts: ["Astana Motors Manufacturing produces the Chinese car brands Chery, Changan, Haval, and Tank."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Smita Crishna-Godrej hails from the storied Godrej clan and controls the Godrej Enterprises Group, along with her brother Jamshyd Godrej.","In 2024, the siblings and their cousins Adi and Nadir Godrej divided the family's business empire into two separate business groups.","The flagship of the Godrej Enterprises Group is privately held consumer goods giant Godrej & Boyce, which makes everything from locks to refrigerators.","Their biggest asset is a 3,400-acre land parcel in suburban Mumbai.","While Jamshyd Godrej is chairperson of the newly carved group, her daughter Nyrika Holkar is tipped to succeed him."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Soegiarto Adikoesoemo founded AKR Corporindo as a chemicals trader in 1960 and listed it on the Indonesian Stock Exchange in 1994.","AKR Corporindo is now engaged in petroleum trading and distribution, logistics services, chemical manufacturing and industrial estate.","AKR Corporindo and British oil and gas firm BP's joint venture distributes aviation fuel and  operates jointly branded service stations in Indonesia.","Soegiarto is AKR's president commissioner. His son Haryanto is president director.","In September 2024, AKR's East Java industrial estate JIIPE inaugurated the world's largest single line copper smelter by capacity, run by Indonesia-U.S. joint venture Freeport Indonesia."]
abouts: ["His son Haryanto Adikoesoemo started collecting art over 25 years ago and has accumulated 800 pieces, including works by Andy Warhol and Mark Rothko.","Haryanto opened a museum dedicated entirely to modern and contemporary art, Museum MACAN, in November 2017."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sofia Schorling Hogberg is the daughter of Melker Schorling, the billionaire Swedish investor who died in 2023.","Schorling had built up a portfolio of stakes in publicly-traded companies he controlled through the family holding vehicle, Melker Schorling AB.","Her sister, Marta Schorling Andreen, is also a billionaire.","The two sisters are the majority owners of Melker Schorling AB.","Today, the family holding company controls large stakes in stock traded companies Hexagon, AAK, Assa Abloy, Hexpol and Securitas."]
abouts: ["One of the guests at her 2005 wedding was the crown princess Victoria, whose guest was her now husband and Prince of Sweden Daniel Westling."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["A fourth-generation owner of Lego, Sofie Kirk Kristiansen, her father, sister and brother together split ownership of a 75% stake in the company.","Kristiansen is not involved in the business; her brother, Thomas, serves as Lego's deputy chairman.","Her great-grandfather Ole, a carpenter, started making wooden toys in his workshop in 1932 before moving into plastic in the 1940s.","The family has a 47.5% stake in theme park operator Merlin Entertainments, which it took private with a consortium."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sol Daurella is the chairwoman of the world's largest Coke bottling company, Coca-Cola Europacific Partners.","CCEP which generates some $23 billion in annual revenue, employs around 39,000 people and operates in 31 markets across Europe, Asia and Oceania.","Daurella owns about 7% of the company, which has a dual listing on the NASDAQ and the London Stock Exchange.","CCEP, whose brands also include Sprite, Fanta and Monster, has 85 manufacturing sites. ","The Daurella family's ties to Coca-Cola began in 1951, when they were awarded a bottling license."]
abouts: ["Daurella is a board member of Banco Santander, Spain's largest bank, and serves as Honorary Consul for Iceland in Barcelona."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Solina Chau, also known as Chau Hoi Shuen, runs Horizons Ventures, a venture capital firm that backs disruptive tech startups.","It was among the earliest investors in Facebook, Spotify, Zoom and U.S. energy drink maker Celsius Holdings.","Chau cofounded Horizons in 2002 with her longtime business partner, Debbie Chang Pui Vee, who is a cousin of Hong Kong shipping tycoon Tung Chee Hwa.","Chau has amassed a fortune from her stakes such as in Celsius Holdings, Zoom and Canada's Well Health Technologies.","The long-time companion of Hong Kong billionaire Li Ka-shing, Chau invests some of Li's fortune and is a director at his Li Ka Shing Foundation. She also runs her own H.S. Chau Foundation."]
abouts: ["Prior to Horizons, Chau started China-focused online media company Tom Group and took it public in Hong Kong in 2000, sparking a dot-com buying frenzy."]
bio: Solina Chau continues to invest in tech ventures, including companies that address innovations in the global environment and food, tackle infectious diseases and tap artificial intelligence and virtual reality. Horizons has invested over $420 million to date. Among her biggest bets are Hampton Creek, Impossible Foods, BlueDot, and AI software provider Sentinel Technology. Her influence is multiplied by her role as director of the Li Ka Shing Foundation, which has put to work $2.5 billion since 1980, 80% benefitting the Greater China region. She compares her partnership with Li, Asia's richest man and her financier and close confidante, to that of Sancho Panza and Don Quixote.
title: Director

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Solomon Lew chairs Melbourne-based Premier Investments, an apparel retailer.","The company is the largest shareholder in Australian department store Myer and home appliance maker Breville.","Premier's brands also include the Smiggle stationery store franchise aimed at children, and sleepwear label Peter Alexander.","In 2025, Myer bought Premier's five apparel brands in exchange for new shares issued to Premier. This will create one of the largest retail and apparel companies across Australia and New Zealand.","Following five apparel brands acquisition, Lew will join the board of Myer in April 2026."]
abouts: ["Lew says he always had an entrepreneurial mindset, working in retail after school and during holidays before opening his first apparel business on his 18th birthday.","He was the first Australian to enter the World Retail Hall of Fame, in 2016, when he was inducted along with Jo Malone and Tommy Hilfiger."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Somsri Lamsam draws her wealth from a 4.21% stake in the holding outfit of the Charoen Pokphand Group, one of the world's largest producers of animal feed and livestock.","Her late father Montri Jiaravanont was the son of Chia Ek Chor, who along with his brother Choncharoen Chiaravanont, opened a shop selling seeds imported from China in 1921.","CP's other assets include stakes in Chinese insurer Ping An, Hong Kong conglomerate CITIC and telecom unit True Corp. It also owns Tesco's operations in Thailand and Malaysia."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Somurai Jaruphnit draws her wealth from an 8.42% stake in the holding outfit of the Charoen Pokphand Group, one of the world's largest producers of animal feed and livestock.","Her late father Montri Jiaravanont was the son of Chia Ek Chor, who along with his brother Choncharoen Chiaravanont, opened a shop selling seeds imported from China in 1921.","CP's other assets include stakes in Chinese insurer Ping An, Hong Kong conglomerate CITIC and telecom unit True Corp. It also owns Tesco's operations in Thailand and Malaysia."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Song Chi-hyung is cofounder and chairman of Dunamu, which operates Upbit, South Korea's largest crypto exchange by daily trading volume.","In November 2025, South Korean search engine behemoth Naver said its payment arm, Naver Financial, will acquire Dunamu in a stock swap that values the combined entity at $13.6 billion.","Dunamu's previous investors include Kakao Ventures, Silicon Valley-based venture capital firm Altos Ventures and Hybe, the agency behind K-pop powerhouse BTS.","Before starting Dunamu with Kim Hyoung-nyon, who is also a billionaire, Song worked at local mobile payment company Danal."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Song Fei chairs Shanghai-listed Yantai Eddie Precision Machinery, which produces and sells construction machinery.","Song shares his fortune with his wife Feng Xiaohong and son Song Yuxuan.","Song's sister-in-law Feng Xiaohua and his brother Song Ou are Eddie executives."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Song Zuowen's privately-held Nanshan Group has interests in aluminum, apparel, education, tourism and a regional airline.","It listed its main aluminum company, Shandong Nanshan Aluminum, on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1999.","Nanshan Group is the majority investor in startup Qingdao Airlines, which launched in April 2014."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sophie Luise Fielmann is the daughter of Guenther Fielmann, the founder of Fielmann Group AG.","Together with her brother Marc, who heads the company as CEO after the death of their father in 2023, she is the majority shareholder of the company.","Fielmann is one of the biggest optician chains across Europe with revenues of more than EUR 2 billion.","Some 24,000 people work for Fielmann across more than 1,000 locations.","Her father Guenther openend the first store in Cuxhaven in 1972."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Spiro Latsis inherited the fortune of his late father, Greek shipping tycoon John S. Latsis (d. 2003) alongside his siblings Marianna and Margarita.","The siblings split up the family fortune in 2019, with John and Margarita taking over the investments in banking and real estate.","John and Margarita own stakes in Zurich-based private banking group EFG International and Greek real estate developer Lamda Development.","Alongside his sisters, John also owns shares in oil company Helleniq Energy and shipyard TALOS.","Latsis is a three-time graduate of the London School of Economics and a board trustee of Princeton's Institute for Advanced Study."]
abouts: ["He has been a Visiting Professor at Harvard University Graduate School of Education and Boston University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Sri Prakash Lohia made much of his fortune producing fertilizers and polymers.","In the 1970s he and his father moved from India to Indonesia, where they cofounded Indorama  Corp. as a maker of spun yarn.","It is now a materials powerhouse, making industrial products including fertilizers, polyolefins, textile raw materials and medical gloves.","Lohia remains chairman while his son Amit is vice chairman. They both live in London.","His younger brother Aloke Lohia, also a billionaire, lives in Thailand, where he runs PET polymer maker Indorama Ventures."]
abouts: ["Lohia's brother-in-law Lakshmi Mittal is a steel billionaire based in London.\r\n","Lohia owns the world's second-largest collection of colored lithographs.","Lohia owns Castelfalfi, a 2,700-acre Tuscan resort located on a hill, which has an adventure park and a golf course."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Stanley Druckenmiller made it big as a hedge fund manager for 30 years. He now manages his money through a family office.","Until 2000, he worked for George Soros. The duo famously bet against the British pound in 1992 and made massive profits.","He shut down his $12 billion hedge fund Duquesne Capital Management in 2010, returning funds to clients."]
abouts: ["At Bowdoin College, Druckenmiller reportedly ran a hot dog stand for extra cash and graduated magna cum laude.","A major donor to his alma mater, he has given more than $40 million to higher education institutions like Bowdoin, Brown and Stanford since 2014."]
title: Founder

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Veteran media mogul Stanley Hubbard helms Hubbard Broadcasting, which owns 13 TV stations and 57 radio stations across the U.S.","Founded by Hubbard's father in 1925, the Minnesota-based company has expanded its portfolio to include cable network Reelz.","Hubbard grew up in the family business, working as prop person at 17, a photojournalist in college and later moving into management."]
abouts: ["Hubbard played hockey for the University of Minnesota.","Hubbard's father founded the first commercial TV station in Minnesota; he also bought the first TV camera ever sold, in 1938."]
title: Chairman and CEO

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Stan Kroenke is a real estate and sports mogul with an international portfolio.","He owns some 60 million square feet of real estate -- much of it shopping plazas near Walmart stores.","Kroenke owns the Los Angeles Rams, which he moved back to California from St. Louis in 2016.","His sports empire also includes the Denver Nuggets, Colorado Avalanche, Colorado Rapids and the U.K.'s Arsenal soccer club.","He is a major landowner, with more than 1.6 million acres of ranches across the U.S. and Canada."]
abouts: ["Kroenke is married to Walmart heiress Ann Walton Kroenke, also a billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Stanley Tang is a cofounder and head of labs at san Francisco-based restaurant delivery app DoorDash.","Tang owns about 4% of DoorDash, which went public on the New York Stock Exchange in early December 2020."]
title: Cofounder

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Stefan Kaluzny founded Sycamore Partners in 2011. The private equity firm now manages more than $13 billion in assets","Sycamore has invested in consumer and retail brands including department store chain Belk, office supply retailer Staples and fast-fashion chain Hot Topic.","Sycamore led the acquisition of drugstore giant Walgreens in a $10 billion transaction in 2025.","The son of a pianist and a teacher, Kaluzny grew up on the Lower East Side of Manhattan and earned a bachelor's degree from Yale and an MBA from Harvard.","He worked as a consultant at Bain & Co. but in 1994 left to cofound Delray Farms, a chain of fresh grocery stores serving low-income Hispanic communities in Chicago."]
bio: One of three new billionaires to make the list, Kaluzny launched PE firm Sycamore in 2011. The firm owns major brands including Walgreens, Staples, Hot Topic, and Torrid. The son of a pianist and a teacher, Kaluzny grew up on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Yale and an MBA from Harvard. He worked as a management consultant at Bain & Co. and, in 1994 he left to cofound Delray Farms, a chain of fresh grocery stores serving low-income Hispanic communities in Chicago. Today, Forbes estimates Kaluzny is worth $1.3 billion. Before starting Sycamore, Kaluzny was Managing Director at private equity firm Golden Gate Capital.
title: Founder/Managing Director

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Stefan Olsson is a part owner of Stena Sphere, a privately held Swedish conglomerate.","Interests include cruising, shipping, offshore drilling, property and metal recycling.","Stena was founded in 1939 as a trading company by Stefan's father, Sten.","His brother Dan took over in 1983 and now owns 51% of the company. Stefan and his sister Madeleine Olsson Eriksson own 24.5% and 12.5%, respectively.","Madeleine's kids Gustav  and Marie each own 6% of the business."]
abouts: ["Olsson is a catholic priest.","Olsson is a honorary director of the Royal Opera House in London, and often lends financial support to put up shows."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Stefan Persson is Sweden's richest person by way of global cheap chic fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz, of which he owns almost 50%.","Persson stepped down as chairman in May 2020 after 22 years in the role; his son Karl-Johan succeeded him.","H&M was founded by Persson's father Erling in 1947.","Persson's two other children, Charlotte S'derstr?m and Tom Persson, and his sister Lottie Tham, are also billionaires."]
abouts: ["Persson personally owns real estate in some of the world's most glamorous shopping districts, spanning  New York, London, Rome and Paris."]
title: Chairman

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Stefan Quandt owns 23.6% of automaker BMW; his sister, Susanne Klatten, the richest woman in Germany, owns 19.1%.","Their late mother, Johanna, was the third wife of legendary industrialist Herbert Quandt, who guided BMW to preeminence in the luxury market.","Both siblings serve on BMW's supervisory board; Quandt is deputy chairman.","His holdings also include Heel (homeopathic medicine), Entrust (digital identity and data security) and Logwin (logistics).","He graduated from the Technical University of Karlsruhe, where he studied economics and engineering."]
abouts: ["After university, Quandt worked at Boston Consulting and as a Hong Kong-based marketing manager for Entrust, which is headquartered in Minneapolis."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Stefan Reimann-Andersen and three of his siblings own 95% of Luxembourg-based investment firm JAB Holding Company s.? r.l (JAB).","Upon the death of their father in 1984, Stefan and eight other heirs each inherited 11.1% of JAB; five of them subsequently divested their stakes.","The brands associated with the Reimann fortune include Pret A Manger, Krispy Kreme donuts, Peet's Coffee and Panera Bread.","Stefan is a descendant of chemist Ludwig Reimann, who, in 1828, joined with Johann Adam Benckiser and his namesake chemical company.","JAB made its first foray into the pet care sector in 2019 with the acquisition of Compassion-First Pet Hospitals."]
abouts: ["In 2016, the Reimanns commissioned a study which revealed close ties between their family, its business and the Nazi regime during World War II.","Following this discovery, the family formed the Alfred Landecker Foundation to support Holocaust survivors, conduct research and combat antisemitism."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Stefan Soloviev is the chairman of the Soloviev Group, which has interests in agriculture, ranching, real estate, railroads and hospitality.","He formed the group in April 2021, merging his agriculture company with his late father Sheldon's (d. 2020) real estate firm Solow Building Co.","The Soloviev Group owns 700,000 acres of farm and ranch land in Kansas, Colorado and New Mexico, as well as two railroads in Colorado and Kansas.","The group sold several apartment buildings in New York for $1.75 billion in 2022; its properties include the iconic 9 West 57th St office tower.","Soloviev started working for his father as a teenager but the two fell out when he was 21; he then moved to Phoenix to trade commodities and grain."]
abouts: ["Soloviev uses the older Russian spelling of the family's name.","In 2023, the group bid for a New York City casino license, with plans to build a complex with a Ferris wheel, hotel, residential towers and a democracy museum."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Stefan von Holtzbrinck, his brother Dieter and sister Monika Schoeller inherited Holtzbrinck Publishing Group from their father, Georg.","Originally founded as a book club in 1948, Holtzbrinck's businesses include Macmillan Publishers, S. Fischer Verlag and Holtzbrinck Digital.","In 2006, Dieter sold his shares to his siblings, leaving each of them with 50% of the company. Monika died in 2019.","Holtzbrinck Ventures (now HV Capital) was founded in 2000 as an investment arm of the publishing business and became independent in 2010.","HV has invested in many internet and e-commerce startups including Zalando, Groupon, HelloFresh and Rocket Internet."]
abouts: ["Stefan, who serves as CEO of Holtzbrinck Publishing Group, is a lawyer by trade.","Prior to joining his father's company, he apprenticed at Bloomsbury Publishing in London."]

name: Billionaires
