bios: ["Walther Moreira Salles Junior (also known as Walter Salles) is a Brazilian filmmaker and member of one of Brazil's oldest banking families.","His late father, Walther Moreira Salles, was the founder of Unibanco and a former ambassador to the United States.\r\n","In 2008 Unibanco merged with Itau, then Brazil's second-largest commercial bank, creating Itau-Unibanco, the largest bank in Latin America.","Moreira Salles and his three brothers, all billionaires, also own stakes in CBMM, the world's leading supplier of the mineral niobium.\r\n","Moreira Salles directed more than 20 films, including 'The Motorcycle Diaries' and 1998 Academy Award nominee 'Central Station.'"]
abouts: ["His screenplay adaptation of Jack Kerouac's book On the Road, with Francis Ford Coppola producing, was nominated for the Palme d'Or at the 2012 Cannes Film Festival.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Baoqing is the chairman of Neway Valve (Suzhou).","Wang co-founded the company in 1997 with Lu Bin, Cheng Zhangwen and Xi Chao.","The company went public in 2014."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Changtian, a rising success in China's fast-growing entertainment industry, chairs film maker Beijing Enlight Media.  \r\n","Wang holds a journalism degree from Fudan University in Shanghai.","Early in his career, he worked as a news journalist and radio and TV producer.","Beijing Enlight Media's investors include Alibaba Group.","Beijing Enlight Media was founded in 2005."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Chaobin chairs the Zhonglu Group,  one of the largest non-government real estate owners in the central Chinese city of Zhengzhou.","Son George is heir apparent.","The Wang Chaobin Charitable Foundation in Zhengzhou provides financial support for disaster relief, cultural exchanges, education and other fields."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Chou-hsiong started athletic-footwear maker Feng Tay Enterprises in 1971. Eight years later it formed a partnership to make sports shoes for Nike.","Over the years the company has expanded into casual shoes, bags and sporting goods such as golf balls and ice hockey helmets.","Headquartered in the western Taiwan county of Yunlin, Feng Tay operates plants in mainland China, India, Indonesia and Vietnam, as well as Taiwan.","Wang's older son Richard took over from him as chairman in 2018. Younger son Kevin became vice chairman in 2017."]
abouts: ["Wang Chou-Hsiong was mentioned in the autobiography of Nike cofounder Phil Knight."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Chuanfu is the chairman and CEO of BYD and has led it to become one of the world's largest EV companies by sales.","Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway acquired a 10% stake for $230 million in 2008. It fully exited in 2025 and made billions of dollars in returns.","Born in a farm village in one of China's poorest provinces in 1966, Wang was orphaned as a teen and raised by his elder brother and sister.","The high achiever made it to college, excelling as he trained his sights on battery technology.","Wang cofounded BYD as a rechargeable battery company in 1995."]
abouts: ["BYD stands for \"Build Your Dreams.\"","BYD started out making batteries for the booming mobile phone market, with customers such as Motorola and Nokia."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Dong is a cofounder of Chinese semiconductor maker Moore Threads Technology.","The company went public in Shanghai in December 2025, raising $1.1 billion.","Wang worked as a sales director for Nvidia for over a decade before cofounding Moore Threads in 2020.","The company's Chairman and CEO, Zhang Jianzhong, is also a billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Jianfeng chairs Ningbo Joyson, a manufacturer of automotive accessories.","Wang is an avid photographer whose work has been exhibited in the Ningbo Museum of Art.","Joyson is headquartered in the coastal Chinese city of Ningbo."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Jianlin is the chairman of Dalian Wanda Group, which has investments in real estate, finance and movie theaters.","Dalian Wanda is one of the world's biggest commercial real estate developers with more than 500 plazas across China.","Once the richest man in Asia, Wang has been retreating in recent years, selling his Chinese hotel and tourism portfolio for over $9 billion in 2017.","The tycoon has also sold most of his stake in U.S. movie theater chain AMC and a stake in Spanish soccer club Atletico de Madrid.","In 2024, Wang ceded control of property management unit Zhuhai Wanda Commercial Management in an $8.3 billion deal, after failing to take it public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange."]
abouts: ["Wang served in the Chinese military from 1970 to 1986 before turning around a government real estate venture and then going into business himself in 1989.","Wang previously served as a deputy to the 17th National Congress of the Communist Party of China."]
title: Chairman

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Jilei is a director of express delivery firm ZTO Express. \r\n\r\n","He has served as its vice president of infrastructure management since October 2012.","From October 2009 to March 2012, Wang was a deputy general manager of Beijing ZTO Daying Logistics, a ZTO Express network partner."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Junmin chairs China Kings Resources, which sells fluorite products and develops fluorite mines.","Wang is a member of China's Communist Party.","China Kings is headquartered in the eastern Chinese city of Hangzhou."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Junlin is the chairman of Sichuan Langjiu, a smaller competitor to the state-run Kweichow Moutai that makes the fiery Baijiu liquor.","The company sells its potent spirits -- whose alcohol by volume (ABV) can top 50% -- under the Lang brand.","The brand is named after its place of origin, the town of Er Lang in western China's Sichuan Province.","The company says it has 20,000 employees and more than $2.8 billion in annual sales.","Wang's son, Wang Bowei, is the firm's CEO."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Junmin is cofounder and chairman of Haisco Pharmaceutical Group, a Tibet-headquartered drugmaker in areas such as anesthesia, chronic diseases and metabolic disorders.","Wang was a sales manager at Huaxi Medical University Pharmaceutical Factory before cofounding Haisco with Fan Xiulian and Zheng Wei, who are also billionaires.","Founded in 2000, Haisco currently has more than 6,000 employees. ","Haisco went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2012."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Junshi cofounded Ginlong Technologies, a manufacturer of solar inverters, with wife Lin Yibei and son Wang Yiming in 2005.","He stepped down as director and deputy general manager in 2021. Yiming now chairs the firm.","Wang was a high school teacher earlier in his career."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang is vice chairman of Yantai Jereh Oilfield Services Group,a supplier of oil exploration equipment.","Jerehis headquartered in the coastal city of Yantai in China's Shandong Province.","Jereh is founded by in 1999 by its chairman Sun Weijie, who is also a member of the 2021 Forbes Billionaires List."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Laichun, also known as Grace Wang, is the chairman and general manager of electronics component manufacturer Luxshare Precision Industry.","One of the company's most important customers is Apple. Executive Chairman Tim Cook has visited its China factories often.","Wang worked for Taiwanese billionaire Terry Gou's Hon Hai Precision Industry (also known as Foxconn) for 10 years.","Wang left in 1997 and teamed up with her brother Wang Laisheng to set up Luxshare in 2004; he is now the vice chairman.","The Shenzhen-listed company raised in 2026 $3.1 billion through a separate share sale in Hong Kong, as it seeks to expand production capacity in China."]
title: Co-Founder & Chairwoman

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Laisheng is vice chairman of Shenzhen-headquartered electronics manufacturer Luxshare Precision Industry.","Luxshare, whose products include connectors and wireless headphones, is a supplier to Apple.","Wang started his own business in the mid-1980s, and later teamed up with sister Wang Laichun to buy Luxshare's precursor in 1999.","Wang Laichun, Luxshare's chairman, is also a billionaire. ","The Shenzhen-listed company raised in 2026 $3.1 billion through a separate share sale in Hong Kong, as it seeks to expand production capacity in China."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Linxiang is the cofounder of Inner Mongolia Erdos Resources, a supplier of cashmere.","Wang resigned as chairman in 2014. The position was succeeded by his daughter Wang Zhen.","Inner Mongolia Erdos Resources listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2001."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Liping is the chairman of Shanghai-listed Jiangsu Hengli Hydraulic, which makes oil cylinders, hydraulic valves and hydraulic castings.","Wang founded the company in 1990. Today it has seven research centers and 12 manufacturing sites in China, Germany, the U.S., Japan and Mexico.","Hengli's clients include Caterpillar, Kobelco and China's Sany Heavy Industry.","Hengli opened a 141,000-square-meter factory in Mexico in 2025 to serve customers across the Americas."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Mingwang is the co-founder of China electronics maker Sunwoda, a supplier of lithium-ion battery modules.","Wang Wei, his brother and co-founder, chairs the Shenzhen-headquartered company.","Sunwoda's customers include Apple and Huawei."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Minwen chairs Hangzhou Lion Electronics, a supplier of semiconductor materials and chips.","Hangzhou Lion went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2020.","Wang and four siblings own 76.5% of paper manufacturer Xianhe Co. through their wholly owned Zhejiang Xianhe Holding Group."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Ning is the founder, chairman and CEO of Hong Kong-listed toy maker Pop Mart International Group.","Set up in 2010, it sells small figurines and plush toys in so-called blind box packaging that doesn't reveal the exact toys inside.","Pop Mart's Labubu line of dolls once ignited a global collection craze over the rabbit-ish creature that has jagged teeth and a mischievous grin.","The company has launched Labubu-themed jewelry and bakery brands as it seeks additional revenue streams. It has also built a theme park named Pop Land in Beijing. "]
abouts: ["Labubu was created by Hong Kong-born artist Kasing Lung. It has been collected by celebrities including Dua Lipa, Rihanna and Blackpink's Lisa."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Qiangxiang chairs CoCreation Grass, or CCGrass, a leading global supplier of artificial grass. ","CCGrass is used for athletic and landscape purposes.","The company supplies to sports organizations such as FIFA, FIH and World Rugby.","CCGrass was founded by Wang Qiangxiang and his brother Wang Qiangzhong in 2004 in Nanjing city. "]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Shih-Chung is the chairman of Taiwan's AirTAC International Group, a maker of pneumatic equipment for the automotive, electronics, medical and other sectors.","He worked at a factory upon graduating high school, and set up the company in 1988.","AirTAC is headquartered in Taipei with a strong foothold in mainland China, where it has two manufacturing sites."]

name: Billionaires
bios:
["Wang Shuifu chairs equipment manufacturer Xizi Clean Energy Equipment.","Xizi Clean Energy was previously known as Hangzhou Boiler Group; Hangzhou Boiler went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2011.

","Wang Shuifu started his career selling agricultural machinery in 1970.
"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Wei is the chairman of S.F. Holding, the package delivery giant known for its SF Express brand.","Wang founded the company in Shunde, Guangdong, in 1993 and is its majority owner.","Unlike peers that often outsource deliveries to franchisees, S.F. relies on its own employees as well as fleets of aircraft and vehicles to achieve same- or next-day delivery.","Wang took the firm public through a reverse merger on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2017. It then listed in Hong Kong in 2024 through a secondary offering.","Its delivery unit Hive Box's 2024 application for a Hong Kong IPO has lapsed amid heavy losses."]
abouts: ["In 2023, S.F. sold its economical delivery unit Fengwang Information to competitor J&T Express for $173 million."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Weixiu's fortune derives from his stake in Zhongji Innolight, a supplier of optical communication modules and devices.","Zhongji Innolight was founded in 1987 and formerly known as Shandong Zhongji Electrical Equipment.","He stepped down as its chairman in 2023.","His son Wang Xiaodong serves as the company's director and executive vice president."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["China's software industry pioneer Wang Wenjing chairs Yonyou Network Technology, once known as UFIDA.","Wang began his undergraduate studies at age 15 and founded Yonyou at age 24.","Outside of the office, Wang's interests include wine, golf and tennis.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Wenmois a non-executive director at Anta Sports, China's largest sportswear company.","Wang is a cousin of fellow Anta billionaires and directors Ding Shizhong and Ding Shijia.","Wang oversees Anta's apparel operations."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Xiancheng is the vice chairman of JCHX Mining Management.","Wang founded the company with his brothers","Wang's son, Wang Qinghai, chairs the company.","JCHX Mining Management listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2015."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang is vice chairman of Jiangxi Ganfeng Lithium, a supplier of lithium products.","Earlier in his career, Wang worked for state-run China Nonferrous Metals.","Wang received an EMBA from China Europe International Business School in 2002."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Xicheng's fortune rose following the July 2016 IPO of his tire manufacturer, Shandong Linglong Tire, on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.","Its predecessor was a state-owned tire factory founded in 1975 in Shandong Province.","The company was on the verge of collapse in 1987 when Wang was named leader and shifted its focus to pricier tires.","The company is now a supplier to GM, Ford, Tata, Fiat and Hyundai."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Xin is the chairman and CEO of Guangdong Dtech Technology, the world's largest PCB drill bit manufacturer by sales volume. ","Wang worked as an accountant for a local PCB manufacturer in Guandong before starting her entrepreneurial business. \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t","The company went public in Shenzhen in 2022 and became dual-listed in Hong Kong in July 2026.","Wang's husband, Lin Xia, and her brothers, Wang Xuefeng and Wang Junfeng, are active in the business."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Xing is the chairman and CEO of Hong Kong-listed Meituan, which was created through a 2015 merger of Groupon-like group buying site Meituan and Yelp-like Dianping.com.","Wang cofounded China's first college social network xiaonei.com, which was sold to Oak Pacific  Interactive in 2006.","After growing Meituan into a food-delivery heavyweight in mainland China, Wang is also expanding in regions including Hong Kong, the Middle East and Latin America.","Wang in 2021 transferred shares at the time worth more than $2 billion to his foundation amid a China antitrust investigation."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Yanqing is the founder, chairman and CEO of Wuxi Lead Intelligent Equipment, one of the world's leading makers of equipment for the battery and electronics industries.","Lead counts Tesla, BMW, Panasonic, Samsung, CATL and BYD among its clients.","His son, Wang Lei, sits on the board.","The Shenzhen-listed company filed for a Hong Kong IPO in August 2025."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Yun'an is the chairman and CEO of Chinese bubble tea maker Guming Holdings.","Founded in 2010, Guming sells bubble tea products under the Good Me brand.","It operates a network of almost 10,000 stores across China, where each cup of tea is priced at no more than $3.","Wang launched the first Good Me store in his hometown of Daxi in Zhejiang Province."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Energy entrepreneur Wang Yusuo went into business after he failed to pass the country's tough college entrance exams.","He is the founder of ENN Group, one of China's largest private energy companies with over 40,000 employees.","Wang stepped down as chairman of ENN Group in 2025 but still sits on the board. His son Wang Zizheng is also a director.","The company also has interests in property development, tourism and wellness. "]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Zelong derives his fortune from Tinergy Chemical, which produces titanium dioxide in China.","Wang's entrepreneurial journey traces back to his father, Wang Deliang, who was a chemical trader known for his early ventures in China.","Wang's fortune soared in 2021 while still at university, placing him among Asia's youngest billionaires."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Zhenggen is a director and general manager of Suzhou Maxwell Technologies, a supplier of equipment used in the solar power industry.","Maxwell went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2018","The company holds 802 patents and has expanded into markets in Thailand, Turkey, and the United States."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Zhenghua is a director and the largest individual shareholder of Spring Airlines of China, one of the world's largest budget carriers.","Wang was a district government official in Shanghai before he set up his first company, Shanghai Spring Tour, in 1981.","Spring has a fleet of 122 aircraft, according to the company's website."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wang Zhenhua is the chairman of property developer Future Land Development Holdings.\r\n","Hong Kong-listed Future Land Development is headquartered in Shanghai.","Wang first entered the property development business in 1993.","Wang received an EMBA degree from Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business in July 2005."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Known as the \"Oracle of Omaha,\" Warren Buffett is one of the most successful investors of all time.","Buffett chairs Berkshire Hathaway, which owns dozens of companies, including insurer Geico, battery maker Duracell and restaurant chain Dairy Queen. He retired as CEO at the end of 2025. ","The son of a U.S. congressman, he first bought stock at age 11 and first filed taxes at age 13.","He has promised to donate over 99% of his wealth. So far, he has given away more than $68 billion, mostly through the Gates Foundation and his kids' foundations.","In 2010, he and Bill Gates launched the Giving Pledge, asking other billionaires to commit to donating at least half of their fortunes to charitable causes."]
abouts: ["Buffett still lives in the same Omaha, Nebraska home he purchased in 1958 for $31,500.","Buffett was rejected from Harvard Business School; he got a master's in economics from Columbia University instead."]
title: CEO

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Warren Chen is a cofounder of Chroma ATE, a supplier of automatic testing equipment for sectors such as automotive and semiconductors.","The company was set up in 1984 by Chen and other alumni of Taiwan's National Chiao Tung University, including Leo Huang who is also a billionaire.","Chroma's power testing equipment is finding increasing uses worldwide as the AI boom leads to rising electricity usage.","Chen struck out on his own and set up Dynacolor, a Taiwan-listed maker of video surveillance products, in 1991."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Warren Kanders is the chairman and CEO of Jacksonville, Florida-based Cadre Holdings, which makes equipment for defense, law enforcement and nuclear safety.","In 1996, Kanders started buying up defense businesses with Robert Schiller and formed Armor Holdings. The pair sold the firm to BAE Systems for $4.5 billion in 2007.","In 2012, Kanders bought back some of those businesses, collectively known as Safariland, for $124 million alongside Safariland's management team.","He later reorganized Safariland and other defense and law enforcement suppliers under Cadre Holdings and took it public in 2021; he owns 28% of the firm.","In 2024, he bought L3Harris' antenna and test equipment business for $200 million and formed defense products manufacturer Fisica."]
abouts: ["Kanders served on the board of the Whitney Museum of American Art from 2006 to 2019, when he stepped down after protests amid Safariland's sales of tear gas.","Kanders owns stakes in outdoor equipment and apparel brands Clarus Corp, Mountain Khakis and Carve Designs."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Warren Stephens is an investing billionaire and the current United State ambassador to the United Kingdom.","His uncle Witt founded Little Rock-based investment bank Stephens Inc. in 1933; his father Jackson joined in 1946.","The outfit underwrote Walmart's public offering in 1970.","The two brothers plowed their earnings into private equity, hewing to the investment criteria, \"whim and caprice.\"","Stephens grew up in the business, became CEO in 1986 and bought out his cousins in 2006.","Stephens sold a group of newspaper holdings, including the Las Vegas Review Journal, for $400 million in 2015."]
abouts: ["A golf nut, Stephens built the Alotian Club outside Little Rock; it's ranked one of the nation's best."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wayne Rothbaum, who founded investment firm Quogue Capital in 2001, became a wildly successful biotech investor, deploying only his own funds.","In 2012, Rothbaum cofounded and became the largest investor in cancer drug developer Acerta Pharma, whose drug Calquence was approved to treat forms of lymphoma and leukemia.","In 2016, AstraZeneca paid $4 billion for 55% of Acerta Pharma and agreed to acquire the remainder of Acerta for nearly $2.5 billion paid between 2022 and 2024.","Rothbaum is executive chair of two cancer drug firms: Kartos Therapeutics, which he cofounded in 2016, and Telios Pharma, cofounded in 2019.","Rothbaum also led a restructuring of listed biotech firm Iovance Biotherapeutics, where he is a board member and the largest shareholder, with a 9% stake."]
abouts: ["Rothbaum's career was first described in the book \"For Blood and Money: Billionaires, Biotech and the Quest for a Blockbuster Drug\" published in 2023.","Rothbaum donated $300 million to SUNY Binghamton--for a sports complex and scholarships--and to Ohio State University to build housing for cancer patients."]
title: Investor

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wee Ee Chao, son of the late banker Wee Cho Yaw, is chairman of Singapore brokerage United Overseas Bank Kay Hian as well as chairman of Haw Par Corporation, maker of the popular Tiger Balm ointment.","He has spent  more than four decades growing UOB Kay Hian into one of the largest brokerages in Asia.","He replaced his father as Haw Par's chairman in 2024.","He was chairman of the Singapore Tourism Board for two years until 2004.","In March 2025, the estate of his father, the late Wee Chow Yaw, was transferred to him, his mother and siblings, completing a process that happened over many months."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wee Ee Cheong is deputy chairman and CEO of United Overseas Bank, Singapore's third-largest bank by assets.","His father, Wee Cho Yaw, who was chairman emeritus of UOB, died in 2024 at age 95.","He is the eldest of five children.","His brother Wee Ee Lim, also a billionaire, has a board seat.","In March 2025, the estate of his father, the late Wee Chow Yaw, was transferred to him, his mother and siblings, completing a process that happened over many months."]
abouts: ["He joined UOB in 1979, and became deputy chairman in 2000 and CEO in 2007."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wee Ee Lim chairs Singapore property development company UOL Group.","He was appointed UOL chairman in 2024 after the death of his father Wee Cho Yaw.","He Joined Haw Par, maker of the popular Tiger Balm ointment, in 1986, and has been serving as its president and CEO since 2003.","In March 2025, the estate of his father, the late Wee Chow Yaw, was transferred to him, his mother and siblings, completing a process that happened over many months."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wee Wei Chi is the younger daughter of late patriarch Wee Cho Yaw, cofounder of United Overseas Bank, one of Singapore's largest banks.","She sits on the board of Kheng Leong, the family's commercial property development and investment outfit.","Her husband, David Eu, is from the family that founded Eu Yan Sang, a traditional Chinese medicine company in Singapore.","She has a bachelor's degree in fine arts from Moravian University in Pennsylvania."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wee Wei Ling is the eldest child of late patriarch Wee Cho Yaw, cofounder of United Overseas Bank, one of Singapore's largest banks.","She sits on the board of Kheng Leong, the family's commercial property development and investment outfit.","She is the executive director of asset, lifestyle and sustainable partnerships at Pan Pacific Hotels Group, the luxury hotel arm of the family's real estate heavyweight UOL Group.","She also manages Pan Pacific's lifestyle brands such as St. Gregory and Si Chuan Dou Hua.","She is a director of the family's philanthropic Wee Foundation."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Huang Wei controls Xinhu Zhongbao, one of China's largest real estate developers.","Xinhu Zhongbao holds a minority stake in Wind, one of China's largest providers of financial information.","Huang's Xinhu Group has a controlling stake in Xiangcai Securities, a Chinese brokerage.","Huang's son Huang Licheng is a company supervisor at Xinhua Zhongbao."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wei Ing-Chou and his three younger brothers, Ying-Chiao, Yin-Chun and Yin-Heng, started Tingyi in 1991.","Tingyi is now one of the largest producers of ready-to-drink tea and bottled water in China. It is also a major supplier to the country's instant-noodle market.","As of 2019, Ing-Chou is no longer a director of Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding, but he remains a senior consultant to the company.","His eldest son, Wei Hong-Ming, born in 1978, is now the chairman. His third son, Wei Hong-Chen, born in 1982, is an executive director.","The family's private company, Ting Hsin, sold its 37.17% stake in Taipei 101, Taiwan's tallest building, to Itochu for $665 million in 2018."]
abouts: ["Ing-Chou's second son, Wei Hong-Fan, started his own bicycle business in 2011.","The senior Wei graduated from a local middle school in Changhua County, central Taiwan, and never went to high school or college.","The family also controls the Dicos fried-chicken chain."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wei Jianjun is the chairman of Great Wall Motor, one of China's largest SUV manufacturers, which sells to over 170 countries and regions.","He took over the debt-plagued Great Wall Automobile Industry Company, the predecessor to the current business, in 1990 when he was only 26.","Wei worked at a carpet factory and a water-pump factory before joining Great Wall.","Great Wall started up its first Brazil plant in August 2025. It is part of the company's 10 billion reais ($1.9 billion) planned investment in the country."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wei Lidong chairs Shanghai-headquartered Weaver Network, which provides digital collaboration and workflow software to more than 80,000 clients.","Weaver went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2017.","In 2019, the company added a regional headquarter in Singapore to expand its footprint in the Asia-Pacific region.","Wei holds a bachelor's degree from Zhejiang University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wei Yin-Chun and his three brothers founded Tingyi, one of the largest producers of ready-to-drink tea and bottled water in China.","Tingyi is also a major supplier of instant noodles in the country.","The family also controls the Dicos fried-chicken chain.","The family's private company, Ting Hsin, sold its 37.17% stake in Taipei 101, Taiwan's tallest building, to Itochu for $665 million in 2018.","Yin-Chun was sentenced in 2018 to 15 years in prison for his part in a tainted-cooking-oil scandal."]
abouts: ["Yin-Chun graduated from a local high school in Changhua County, central Taiwan, and never went to college."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wei Yin-Heng and his three brothers, Ing-Chou, Yin-Chun and Ying-Chiao, started Tingyi in 1991.","Tingyi is now one of the largest producers of ready-to-drink tea and bottled water in China. It is also a major supplier to the country's instant-noodle market.","The family also controls the Dicos fried-chicken chain.","The family's private company, Ting Hsin, sold its 37.17% stake in Taipei 101, Taiwan's tallest building, to Itochu for $665 million in July 2018."]
abouts: ["Wei graduated from a local high school in Changhua County, central Taiwan, and never went to  college."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wei Ying-Chiao and his three brothers, Ing-Chou, Yin-Chun and Yin-Heng, started Tingyi in 1991.","Tingyi is now one of the largest producers of ready-to-drink tea and bottled water in China. It is also a major supplier to the country's instant-noodle market.","The family also controls the Dicos fried-chicken chain.","The family's private company, Ting Hsin, sold its 37.17% stake in Taipei 101, Taiwan's tallest building, to Itochu for $665 million in 2018."]
abouts: ["Wei graduated from a local high school in Changhua County, central Taiwan, but didn't go to  college."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Weijian Shan is the chairman of PAG, an Asia-focused private equity firm with $50 billion in assets under management.","Before founding PAG's private equity business in 2010, he worked for 12 years at TPG Capital and was the U.S. private equity giant's top China dealmaker.","At TPG, Shan spearheaded the first purchase of a state-owned Chinese bank by a foreign investor.","In 2022, Shan became an independent director of Alibaba. He also served on the boards of Wilmar International, Bank of China (Hong Kong), Baosteel and Lenovo."]
abouts: ["The Beijing-born grew up during the Cultural Revolution and labored in northern China's Gobi Desert.","His memoir, published in 2019, is called Out of the Gobi: My Story of China and America.","He earned a Ph.D. in business administration from UC Berkeley, where U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen was one of Shan's thesis advisors."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Weili Dai cofounded semiconductor company Marvell Technology with her husband, Sehat Sutardja, in 1995.","Dai was president of the company until she and Sutardja were forced out in 2016 amid an internal accounting investigation.","No evidence of fraud was found in the Marvell accounting investigation.","The couple moved to Las Vegas in 2017 and have been investing in real estate and technology; Sutarjda died in 2024.","Dai cofounded AI startup MeetKai in 2018, and semiconductor packaging company Silicon Box in 2021."]
abouts: ["Dai played semi-professional basketball in Shanghai as a teen.","A native of Shanghai, Dai studied at UC Berkeley, and was reportedly the first woman to deliver a commencement address at the university's engineering school."]
title: Cofounder-President

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wen Pengcheng chairs Guangdong Wens Foodstuffs Group of China, which sells and breeds chicken.","More than 50,000  family farms work with Wen.\r\n","Wens went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2015."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lars Wenaas is the owner of Wenaasgruppen, a hotel property empire with 18 hotels and 7,800 rooms across Europe.","Wenaasgruppen also manages a portfolio of listed stocks and bonds through its financial investment arm.","Wenaas began in the family's workwear business before shifting to hotel real estate investments in the 1990s.","The group has acquired or developed over 58 hotels, including Radisson Blu Plaza in Oslo and hotels in Copenhagen."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wendy Abrams is a shareholder of Illinois-based medical supplies giant Medline, which her father Jon Mills and uncle Jim Mills founded in 1966.","The extended Mills family, which includes four other billionaires, owns roughly 18% of the company, which IPO'd on the Nasdaq in December 2025 and ended its first trading day with a market cap of more than $55 billion.","The Mills family previously sold 79% of Medline to a group of private equity firms in a leveraged buyout that valued the company at more than $30 billion in 2021.","Abrams' cousin Charlie Mills served as Medline's CEO for 26 years until 2023, while her brother Andy Mills served as president during that same period. Charlie still serves as chairman and Andy still sits on the board.","Abrams' husband Jim Abrams served as chief operating officer of Medline from 1997 to 2023. The company is now run by non-family executives."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Weng is the majority shareholder of Shenzhen New Industries Biomedical Engineering, a supplier of clinical instruments.","Weng was the first person to be appointed as representative of China's securities watchdog in the city of Shenzhen back in 1992.","The company was founded in 1995 and is based in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wesley Batista is one of two billionaire brothers who control publicly traded JBS S.A., one of the world's largest meat processing companies.","Their father, Jose Batista Sobrinho, founded a small butcher shop in central Brazil in 1953. It grew by acquiring slaughterhouses in the region.","Wesley and his brother Joesley took control in the 2000s, leading JBS's 2007 acquisition of U.S. pork and beef processor Swift & Co. for $225 million.","His son, Wesley Batista Filho, became a director in the company's U.S. division in May 2023.","In 2017 Wesley was arrested as part of a large Brazilian bribery probe and reportedly held for six months.","In May 2017, the brothers agreed to pay a $3.2 billion fine to Brazilian authorities to atone for their role in a large corruption scandal."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wes Edens cofounded asset manager Fortress Investment Group in 1998.","A former BlackRock partner, Edens first became a billionaire alongside his four cofounders when Fortress went public in 2007.","Fortress was acquired by SoftBank in 2017 for $3.3 billion. Edens walked away with about $500 million pretax.","He is the CEO of publicly traded liquefied natural gas company New Fortress Energy.","He is a co-owner of the NBA's Milwaukee Bucks, Premier League soccer team Aston Villa and Portugal's Vitoria Club Sport soccer club.","His Brightline railway, the only private passenger line in the U.S., operates high-speed trains from Orlando to Miami."]
abouts: ["Edens began construction on Brightline West, his second railway, in 2024. The $12 billion project line will be the first true high-speed train in the U.S."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lawyer-turned-investor Wichai Thongtang gets a substantial chunk of his fortune from a minority stake in hospital operator Bangkok Dusit Medical Services.","His son Att has a board seat at Bangkok Dusit.","Wichai's portfolio includes TWZ, a distributor of mobile phones and peripheral devices, and E For L Aim, a dealer of medical equipment and suppliers.","He is chairman of listed Royal Orchid Hotel (Thailand) and Grande Asset Hotels And Property."]
abouts: ["He has represented former prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra.","Wichai had a loss-ridden cable-TV company, which was shut down in 2016."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wilhelm Beier is the chairman of the supervisory board of Dermapharm, a pharmaceutical company he founded in 1991.","Dermapharm, based in Gruenwald near Munich, manufacturers generic drugs for maladies ranging from insect bites to fungal diseases and osteoporosis.","Nearly half of its revenues come from the so-called \"parallel trade'': arbitraging price differences for drugs between countries.","Dermapharm, which went public in 2018, is expanding into the business of medical marijuana. Beier and his family still own more than 70% of the company.","The company holds over 40% of one Germany's most popular home shopping television channels."]
abouts: ["Wilhelm's wife Elisabeth runs the company's international business, while son Michael runs online perfume shop Point Rouge.","Known as \"Willi\" in Munich, Beier has reportedly hosted parties with celebrity guests at his estate in Kitzbuehel, Austria, one of the world's top ski resorts."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Will Adderley is the son of Bill and Jean Adderley, the founders of UK home furnishings retailer Dunelm.","The business was founded after the couple set up a market stall in Leicester, U.K. in 1979.","They took the company public on the London Stock Exchange in 2006.","The Adderleys own 43% of the business and Will serves as the company's deputy chairman.","There are now almost 200 Dunelm stores across the U.K."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Bill Ackman founded and runs Pershing Square Capital Management, a hedge fund with $20 billion in assets under management.","Ackman created Pershing Square in 2004 and rose to fame for his short of bond insurer MBIA and his rescue of mall operator General Growth Properties.","Pershing Square's stock portfolio is concentrated in 10 companies, including Chipotle, Uber and Amazon.","Ackman is known for being outspoken, with more than 2 million followers on X. He endorsed Donald Trump in 2024 after decades of supporting Democrats.","He publicly pressured Harvard to oust president Claudine Gay amid accusations of plagiarism and antisemitism until she resigned in January 2024."]
abouts: ["Ackman's Pershing Square Foundation has committed some $500 million to causes like the Innocence Project, Human Rights Watch and Teach For America."]
title: Founder, CEO

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William R. Berkley, who died in June 2026 at age 80, was the founder of insurance firm W.R. Berkley, which he started with only $2,500 in 1967 while getting his MBA from Harvard.","His company, which went public in 1974, insures everything from medical equipment to jewels to fine art and has operations in more than 60 countries.","Berkley stepped down as CEO in 2015 but remained its executive chairman until his death; he owned 20% of the company, which generated $14.7 billion in 2025 revenue.","His son, W. Robert Berkley Jr., is the current CEO and Chairman of W.R. Berkley."]
abouts: ["Berkley was chair emeritus of the board of trustees of NYU, his alma mater.","He was an active political donor, contributing to Democratic campaigns over the years."]
title: Chairman

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Bill Boyd cofounded Las Vegas-based casino firm Boyd Gaming Corporation with his father, Sam Boyd, in 1975.","He took over as CEO of the company after his father passed away in 1993 and served in that role until 2008.","He now serves as chairman emeritus and owns around 17% of the company.","Boyd Gaming, which is publicly traded, has 28 casino properties in 10 different states."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William \"Bill\" Chisholm, a private equity executive, is leading a group of investors to buy the Boston Celtics NBA team for $6.1 billion.","Chisholm is the managing partner of STG Partners, a software-focused Silicon Valley private equity firm with about $12 billion in assets under management.","He cofounded Symphony Technology Group, the predecessor to STG, in 2002 with software billionaire Romesh Wadhwani.","Chisholm has worked in Silicon Valley for decades but grew up near Boston and has been a lifelong Celtics fan.","The Celtics' current CEO and governor, Wyc Grousbeck, will stay in his roles through the 2027-2028 season."]
abouts: ["Prior to Symphony Technology Group, Chisholm worked in venture capital and as a management consultant at Bain & Co.","Chisholm was a member of the varsity soccer team at Dartmouth College that won Ivy League titles in 1988 and 1990."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William Conway Jr. is one of three billionaire founders of private equity firm Carlyle Group.","Conway stepped down as co-CEO in 2018 and now serves as non-executive co-chairman with cofounder and billionaire David Rubenstein.","The trio took Carlyle public on the Nasdaq exchange in 2012 and the firm is now approaching $453 billion in assets under management.","They used their Beltway connections--George H.W. Bush was among their advisers--to invest in defense-oriented companies.","Before founding Carlyle, he was the chief financial officer of telecom company MCI Communications.","Conway contributed $10.5 million in 2020 to his son Bill Conway's failed campaign for Cook County State's Attorney in Illinois."]
abouts: ["Conway was owner of Merrywood, Jackie O's childhood home in McLean, Virginia, until 2005 when he sold the estate to former AOL CEO Steve Case for $24.5 million.","Conway went to night school for his MBA at the University of Chicago."]
title: Co-Chief Executive Officer and Co-founder

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William Ding is the founder and CEO of NetEase, one of the world's largest online games companies.","In addition to legacy titles such as Fantasy Westward Journey, the company's portfolio also includes casual game Eggy Party and battle game Justice Mobile, which uses AI to generate storylines.","Facing tough competition in games from rival Tencent, NetEase has expanded into movies, e-commerce and online music.","Ding was China's richest man and its first internet and gaming billionaire back in 2003.","The mogul also has an interest in sustainable agriculture, with NetEase's e-commerce arm Yanxuan selling pork sourced from its own farms."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William Fisher is one of the heirs to the Gap retail fortune. He sits on Gap's board alongside his brother Robert.","Known as \"Bill,\" he was founder and president of the International Division for Gap Inc. and expanded the company into Canada, Japan and Europe.","He is CEO of Manzanita Capital, a London-based private equity firm he founded in 2001.","Bill's parents Doris and Don (d. 2009) founded retailer Gap in San Francisco in 1969."]
title: Director

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William \"Bill\" Foley II founded title insurance company Fidelity National Financial in 1984 and still serves as its chairman.","He also served as chairman of Black Knight, a software and data provider for the mortgage industry, and Fidelity National Information Services.","With decades of experience overseeing acquisitions, sales and spinoffs of public companies, Foley was quick to capitalize on Wall Street's SPAC boom.","A serial dealmaker, he has sponsored 6 blank-check companies; one that has gone public merged in March 2021 with payments firm Paysafe.","In 2016, Foley paid $500 million to purchase the Vegas Golden Knights hockey team, which played its inaugural NHL season in 2017."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William Franke is the chairman of low-cost carrier Frontier Airlines and the owner of air transport-focused private equity firm Indigo Partners.","Raised in Latin America, Franke attended law school at Stanford and then worked as an executive at firms including Valley National Bank and Circle K.","He first got into the airline business as the CEO of America West Airlines from 1993 to 2001, turning the company into a low-cost carrier.","He was an early investor in Ryanair; since starting Indigo Partners in 2002, he's invested in several airlines including Volaris, Wizz Air, and Spirit.","He took Frontier public in April 2021; eight months later in February 2022, the firm announced a $6.6 billion merger with its rival Spirit Airlines.","Spirit and Frontier terminated their merger agreement in July 2022, with Spirit shareholders instead agreeing to a merger with JetBlue three months later."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William Fung and his older brother Victor own a significant stake in Li & Fung, which operates as a middleman between global manufacturers and retailers in the U.S. and Europe.","William stepped down as chairman of Li & Fung in 2020 when Victor's son, Spencer, took the helm.","In 2020 Li & Fung was privatized through a deal worth $930 million.","In 2022, Danish shipping giant A.P. Moller-Maersk acquired the brothers' logistics business, LF Logistics, for $3.4 billion.","Their grandfather, Fung Pak-liu, founded Li & Fung with partner Li To-ming in 1906, exporting porcelain and silk."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William Goldring's Sazerac Company owns some 500 alcohol brands and a dozen distilleries in the U.S., Canada, France, Ireland and India.","The $3 billion (est. sales) business produces storied spirits such Pappy Van Winkle and George T. Stagg, but has ballooned in size thanks to lower-shelf offerings like Fireball Cinnamon Whisky.","Goldring took over the alcohol business built up by his father, Stephen Goldring (d. 1996), in the 1960s.","He grew the family's wholesaling operations, selling their stake in 2010 for an estimated $400 million, and bought up spirits brands such as Southern Comfort, Goldschlager and Myers's Rum.","In 2024 Sazerac acquired BuzzBallz line of premixed cocktails for an estimated $400 million."]
bio: He inherited a liquor distribution business based in the Big Easy, which he grew to cover 38 states, before selling in 2010 to focus on making booze instead. Now Goldring's Sazerac Company makes and sells 400 brands. Its biggest hit is Fireball Cinnamon whisky, while bourbon snobs seek out its cult status Pappy Van Winkle offerings. In 2024 acquired BuzzBallz and its line of premixed cocktails. Owns 12 distilleries worldwide.

name: Billionaires
bios: ["U.S.-born hotelier William Heinecke came to Thailand as a child and started his first business before he turned 18, hence naming his company Minor.","A Thai citizen since 1991, his Minor International has more than 600 hotels and resorts, over 2,700 restaurants and nearly 200 retail stores spread across more than 60 countries.","He tripled the size of his hotel portfolio by acquiring Spain's NH Hotels for $2.6 billion in 2018, the year of Minor's golden anniversary.","Minor also has franchises for such brands as Swensens, Sizzler, Dairy Queen and Burger King.","Three resorts from Minor's Anantara hotel chain were featured in hit TV series The White Lotus."]
abouts: ["An auto enthusiast, Heinecke has a collection of 36 cars and motorcycles.","In 2020, Heinecke ceded the CEO's position to a Minor veteran. In 2021, Minor expanded into China, partnering with Funyard Hotels & Resorts."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["In 2012, William Hockey cofounded payments company Plaid, which helps other fintechs connect to customers' bank accounts.","He met his cofounder Zach Perret while they were both working as junior consultants at Bain & Company.","He stepped down as Plaid's chief technology officer in 2019, but he remains a board member.","In 2022, he launched Column, a chartered bank based in San Francisco that helps other businesses (including Mercury and Brex) offer banking services. Hockey self-funded Column and owns the vast majority of it.","Hockey studied history and business at Emory University in Atlanta, Georgia."]
title: Cofounder

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William \"Bill\" Koch, brother of Koch Industries chairman and co-CEO Charles Koch, is the founder of petroleum coke and sulphur products company Oxbow Carbon Corp.","The Kansas native formed his own company after selling his stake in Koch Industries to brothers Charles and David (d. 2019) for $470 million in 1983.","He battled his brothers for two decades over the payout amount. The case was settled for an undisclosed amount in 2001.","Bill's brother Frederick (d. 2020) also sold his stake in Koch Industries to Charles and David in 1983 and was involved in the ensuing legal battle.","Koch Industries was started in 1940 by Bill's father, Fred Koch, who improved a method of refining heavy oil into gasoline."]
abouts: ["Bill and David were fraternal twins; the duo went to MIT together and played on the same basketball team.","The thrice married industrialist built a private Wild West-style town in Colorado, complete with saloons, a jail house and a train station."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William Lauder is a grandson of Estée Lauder, who founded the cosmetics firm, and eldest son of Leonard Lauder, who was CEO and chairman for 17 years.","A member of the family's third generation, he was Estée Lauder's CEO from 2004 to 2009.","In January 2025, he stepped down as executive chairman of the company, a position he'd held since 2009.","He now serves as chairman of Estée Lauder's board of directors.","He lives in a Park Avenue co-op, and has homes in New York's Westchester County and in Aspen, Colorado. \r\n \r\n"]
abouts: ["Lauder graduated from the University of Pennsylvania and now sits on the institution's board. He started lecturing Penn MBA students in 2012.","Lauder joined family's cosmetics company Estee Lauder in 1986 as regional marketing director of Clinique USA. He created the Origins brand in 1990."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William MacMillan is one of 21 billionaire heirs to Cargill, the world's biggest agriculture business.","His great-great-grandfather, W.W. Cargill, founded the business as a single grain warehouse on the end of an Iowa railroad line in 1865.","The family still owns roughly 90% of Cargill, which did $154 billion in 2025 sales across food, agriculture, financial and industrial divisions.","The Cargill-MacMillan family collects an estimated 18% of net profits as dividends every year.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Bill Stone started financial-software firm SS&C Technologies in 1986 with the $20,000 he had saved from his days as a KPMG executive.","His product became popular among asset managers, bankers and insurers who wanted to electronically manage their books.","He guided the firm to an IPO in 1996, but the dot-com crash nearly crippled the company in 2001.","Stone refocused and added services such as data centers, then took the company private in 2005.","In 2011, a resurgent SS&C went public again; Stone remains the firm's largest individual shareholder, with a 15% stake."]
abouts: ["Between June 1999 and December 2001, SS&C went from 610 to 250 employees, as the markets crashed.","The Evansville, Indiana native was the captain of his high school football team."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William Teh Lee Pang is the son of late banker Teh Hong Piow, who founded Malaysian banking behemoth Public Bank and chaired it for several decades.","Teh Hong Piow founded the bank in 1966. He died in December 2022 at age 92.","n addition to Malaysia, the bank serves millions of customers across Cambodia, China, Hong Kong, Sri Lanka and Vietnam.","The late Teh owned a substantial minority stake in the bank as well as in the listed insurance business, LPI Capital."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William \"Beau\" Wrigley Jr. is an heir to the Wrigley's chewing gum fortune.","In 1999, he took over the business his great-grandfather started in 1891.","Wrigley Jr., who was CEO, expanded the company in 2005 by purchasing Altoids and Life Savers from Kraft Foods for $1.46 billion.","In 2008, he sold the Chicago-based firm to candy giant Mars Inc. for $23 billion in cash.","Wrigley became CEO of cannabis product-maker Parallel in 2018.","A 2021 SPAC deal to take Parallel public fell through and Wrigley stepped down as CEO. The company is now embroiled in lawsuits waged by investors."]
abouts: ["Wrigley's great grandfather originally sold baking soda. He switched businesses after realizing that the chewing gum he gave away was much more popular.","His grandfather P.K. Wrigley owned the Chicago Cubs, but the family had to sell the baseball team in 1981 in order to pay the estate taxes after his death."]
title: Chairman and CEO

name: Billionaires
bios: ["William Young is CEO of plastic container maker Plastipak, which does some $3.7 billion in annual sales.","Young and his father founded Plastipak in 1967, shortly after he graduated from the University of Detroit Mercy with an engineering degree","After six years of running the business, the duo sold the majority to Beatrice Foods for an undisclosed amount.","In 1982, the family bought back Plastipak. Three decades later, they sold a minority stake to a division of Goldman Sachs. They bought out Goldman by 2020."]
abouts: ["Plastipak holds over 500 U.S. patents for package design and manufacturing processes.","Plastipak manufactures plastic packaging for companies such as Procter & Gamble, Pepsi and Kraft Foods."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Willis Johnson is the founder of Dallas-based Copart, a leader in online auctions for used and totaled cars; he owns about 6% of the stock.","Johnson founded the company out of a single lot in Vallejo, California in 1982 after several years operating a dismantling yard near Sacramento.","He took the company public in 1994 and expanded across the country; Copart now has more than 200 locations in 11 countries.","Johnson stepped down as CEO in 2010 and handed over the reins to his son-in-law, Jay Adair, who first joined Copart in 1989 at age 19. (Adair stepped down as CEO in 2024 and is now executive chairman.)","Before starting Copart, Johnson worked at a Safeway grocery store and at his father's scrapyard in California."]
abouts: ["Johnson was drafted into the Vietnam War and was awarded a Purple Heart for his service.","Johnson owns a large collection of classic cars at his home outside Nashville, Tennessee; his prized possession is a black 1955 Chevrolet."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Willy Michel is the founder of Ypsomed Selfcare Solutions, a Swiss pharma company that develops self-injection and diagnostic systems.","Ypsomed was started in 2003 out of Disetronic Holding, which Michel founded in 1984 with his brother and sold to Roche for $1.2 billion.","As part of the sale agreement, Michel got the injection business back from Roche for $310 million, forming what is known as Ypsomed today.","Michel and his three children together own a 71% stake in the company."]
abouts: ["Michel founded an art museum with his collection of Franz Gertsch portraits.","Michel reportedly owns a yacht called the Vive La Vie that features rotating beds, a disco dance floor and floating glass staircase."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wilma Tisch's husband Laurence and his brother Bob started Loews Corp as a New Jersey hotel venture in 1946. She died in June 2026 at age 98.","Publicly traded Loews now has interests in drilling, natural gas pipelines and insurance.","At NYU, the Tisch family donated funds to support the Tisch School of the Arts and the Tisch Hospital at Langone Medical Center.","Wilma donated some of her Loews shares annually to her three children's charitable foundations."]
abouts: ["Tisch was the first woman to be elected president of the Federation of Jewish Philanthropies of New York.","Tisch was an honorary board member of WNYC Radio and held an honorary doctorate from NYU."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Winai Teawsomboonkij founded his Thaifoods Group in 1987 with a chicken farm of 20,000 chickens.","He went on to expand into breeding pigs and producing animal feed, taking the company public in 2015. \r\n","Winai holds a majority stake with his family in Thaifoods.","It's one of the top three producers of chicken meat and live pigs in Thailand.","In 2022, the company set up a renewable energy subsidiary.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Winifred J. Marquart is the president of the Johnson Family Foundation, the main purpose of which is to facilitate meetings and build community.","She is the great-great-granddaughter of SC Johnson (d. 1991), the company's founder.","She is an heir to family-owned SC Johnson, the privately-held cleaning products company whose products include Pledge and Windex.","Winifred and her siblings pledged $150 million to Cornell in 2017 to fund the SC Johnson College of Business."]
abouts: ["Marquart lives with her family in Virginia Beach, the only sibling to live outside of their hometown of Racine, Wisc.","Like her parents and siblings, she attended Cornell University.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wirastuty Fangiono controls palm oil company FAP Agri, which went public in Indonesia in 2021.","The company was founded in 1994 and currently has a concession of  more than 110,000 hectares of palm oil plantation across the country.","She also owns a stake in First Resources, a Singapore-listed palm oil company headed by his younger brother Ciliandra."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Together with his brother Michael, Wolfgang Herz derives his fortune from two of Germany's most recognized companies: Tchibo and Beiersdorf.","Their father, Max, along with Carl Tchiling-Hiryan, founded Tchibo, which imports and sells coffee, in 1949. Max passed away in 1965.","Tchibo expanded into retailing a range of other consumer goods and services including clothing and electronics.","Family holding company maxingvest ag controls 100% of Tchibo and around 47% of the voting shares of Beiersdorf, whose brands include Nivea and Eucerin.","Older brother Guenter and sister Daniela Herz-Schnoeckel were bought out in 2003."]
abouts: ["Max Herz came up the idea of opening stores where coffee could be both sipped and sold over the counter -- a forerunner to Starbucks.","A fourth brother, Joachim, died in a motorboat accident in 2008."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wolfgang Leitner heads listed Austrian plant and equipment manufacturer Andritz; he said in July 2021 that he would step down as CEO become chairman of the board.","A chemist by training, Leitner joined Andritz in 1987, became CEO in 1994 and took a 26% stake in the company in 1999. \r\n","He eventually turned Andritz into one of Austria's largest companies.","In 2018, Andritz completed the biggest acquisition in its history, buying North Carolina based Xerium Technologies for $833 million.","Leitner's initial wealth stems from the sale of Pharmavit, part of pharmaceutical outfit Genericon he founded, for $110 million in 1995."]
abouts: ["Leitner comes from a modest background - his father also worked for Andritz, serving the company for three decades as a metal worker.","Most days, Leitner enjoys a simple lunch, consisting of a sandwich, an apple, a yogurt and the newspaper's business section."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wolfgang Marguerre founded Octapharma in Switzerland in 1983 and turned it into one of the world's largest manufacturers of blood plasma products.","Positioned in a lucrative market, Octapharma has production plants in six countries, over 11,000 employees and annual revenue of more than 3 billion euros.","The company has research and development and manufacturing operations, and has about 200 donation centers.","Octapharma is also a leading corporate sponsor of Save One Life, an international nonprofit that supports children and adults with blood disorders."]
abouts: ["Octa is taken from the Greek word for eight, the factor deficient in people with hemophilia A.","Marguerre donated $17.5 million to renovate Theater Heidelberg and $1.13 million to accept and integrate refugees in Heidelberg."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wolfgang Reimann and three of his siblings and three of his siblings own 95% of Luxembourg-based investment firm JAB Holding Company s.? r.l (JAB).","Upon the death of their father in 1984, Wolfgang and eight other heirs each inherited 11.1% of JAB; five of them subsequently divested their stakes.","The brands associated with the Reimann fortune include Pret A Manger, Krispy Kreme donuts, Peet's Coffee and Panera Bread.","Wolfgang is a descendant of chemist Ludwig Reimann, who, in 1828, joined with Johann Adam Benckiser and his namesake chemical company.","JAB made its first foray into the pet care sector in 2019 with the acquisition of Compassion-First Pet Hospitals."]
abouts: ["In 2016, the Reimanns commissioned a study which revealed close ties between their family, its business and the Nazi regime during World War II.","Following this discovery, the family formed the Alfred Landecker Foundation to support Holocaust survivors, conduct research and combat antisemitism."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wong Luen Hei chairs Hong Kong-listed China Lesso, a supplier of building materials and interior decorations products like pipes and windows.","Wong's wife Zuo Xiaoping and brother-in-law Zuo Manlun sit on Lesso's board.\r\n","Lesso is headquartered in the southern Chinese city of Foshan."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wong Man Li is the chairman and CEO of Man Wah Holdings, one of the world's largest suppliers of recliner sofas best known for its high-end Cheers brand.","It also manufactures and sells mattresses.","In 2005, Man Wah went public in Singapore and became the first Chinese furniture enterprise on the Main Board of the Singapore Stock Exchange.","After delisting in 2009, the company re-listed in Hong Kong the following year."]
abouts: ["He got his start earning $4 a day as a factory worker after arriving in Hong Kong from the mainland's Fujian Province in 1990.","Before a recliner goes into production at Man Wah, it is tested by a machine that pokes it for the equivalent of 72 years of use to see if it stays firm."]

name: Billionaires
bios:
["Wu Bo chairs Estun Automation, a Chinese supplier of components for artificial intelligence equipment and industrial robots.","Nanjing Estun Automation went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2015.

","Wu Bo received his bachelor's degree and master's degree in mechanical engineering from Southeast Universtiy in Nanjing. 
"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Cheng is chairman of Guocheng Mining, a Beijing-based miner of metals. ","His Guocheng Co, a holding company, has interests in chemical, logistics and hotels. ","Guocheng employs a staff of 7,000 and has operations across China, including Beijing, Inner Mongolia, Sichuan and Tibet, among others."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Chung-yi is the chairman of central Taiwan's auto parts maker Fine Blanking & Tool.","Most of his fortune comes from the 2007 sale of a stake he owned in Hong Kong-listed Tingyi,  the maker of Master Kong beverages and instant noodles.","He is also known by his Western name Tony."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Guangming is founder of China's Jiangsu Yuyue Medical Equipment and Supply, which is chaired and run by his son Wu Qun.","The company supplies medical equipment such as rehabilitation machines, oxygen tanks and diagnostic equipment.","In 2008, the elder Wu took the company public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.","Wu was born to a fisherman's family, and cofounded the predecessor of Yuyue with his father in 1990s."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Guanjiang is cofounder of Chongqing Zhifei Biological Products, a vaccine maker.","Wu, who was previously chairman, gradually reduced his stake and no longer has a management role in the company.","Zhifei listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2010.","Wu's fortune is comprised primarily from the sale of his shares over the years; his stake in Zhifei in now less than 5%."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Jianbin is chairman of Ningbo Shuanglin Auto Parts, which manufactures auto parts, including automobile accessories, bearings and electronic control modules.","His father Wu Yonglin founded the company in 1987 and stepped down from management in 2006 due to health reasons.","Wu Jianbin's sister Wu Weijing is a director of the company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Jianshu is the chairman of Ningbo Tuopu Group, a supplier of vibration control, acoustic and suspension systems for the auto industry.","Founded in 1983, Tuopu today supplies automakers including Audi, BMW and BYD.","The company has expanded into humanoid robotics sector, supplying components such as actuators and sensors. ","Wu's son, Wu Haonian, is the company's vice chairman. "]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Jinzi Wu is the founder, chairman and CEO of Ascletis Pharma","Wu served as vice president at GSK R&D in USA before founding the company.","Ascletis Pharma listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2018."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Kai is the scientist in chief of Contemporary Amperex Technology, a supplier of lithium-ion batteries.","Wu holds a PhD from Shanghai Jiaotong University.","Earlier in his career, Wu was a lecturer at Wuhan University of Technology."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Kaiting is the chairman of Xiamen Intretech Inc., a supplier of electronics products including remote controls for home entertainment equipment.","Intretech went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on Jan. 15, 2018.","Wu owns a 55% stake in Intretech.","Wu is the son of Wanlida Group founder Wu Huitian, a member of the Forbes China Rich list in 2008; Wu died in 2012."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Lanlan is the vice chairman of Shenzhen Yuto Packaging.","Shenzhen Yuto went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2016.","Wu holds a MBA from Tongji University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Shaoxun chairs Jing Brand,  a supplier of Chinese liquor.","Wu worked for a textile company after leaving the army in 1980.","Seven years later, he took a job at a distillery factory in Daye in China's Hubei Province; the business was the predecessor to Jing.","Wu bought that business in 1998; Jing's sales in 2017 exceeded $1.6 billion."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Xiangdong is founder and chairman of liquor maker ZJLD Group, best known for its colorless spirits (baijiu) in China.","The company's Hong Kong IPO in 2023 valued it at $4.5 billion.","Wu also chairs Vats, a liquor store chain in China.","Vats is headquartered in Beijing and listed at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2019.","Wu also started Jinliufu, a well-known baijiu brand in the country, more than 20 years ago."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Xiaoge was formerly a director and vice president at CNGR Advanced Material, a supplier of battery materials, before stepping down in 2023.","Her husband Deng Weimin is chairman and also a billionaire.","The company went public in Shenzhen in 2020 and five years later dual-listed in Hong Kong."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Xushun is a cofounder of Wuhu Shunrong Sanqi Interactive Entertainment Network Technology in China.","Wuhu Shunrong Auto Parts, which is listed on the Shenzhen stock exchange, acquired 60% of Sanqi Interactive Entertainment Shanghai Technology in 2014.","Following the acquisition, Wuhu Shunrong Auto Parts was rebranded as Wuhu Shunrong Sanqi Interactive Entertainment Network Technology.","Wu dropped out of school after he finished middle high school in 1963. He was once a government official in Xitan in Nanling County in Anhui Province."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Yajun draws the bulk of her wealth from a stake in Hong Kong-listed real estate developer Longfor Group Holdings. She stepped down as chairman in 2022.","She and her ex-husband Cai Kui, who cofounded Longfor with her in 1993, divorced in 2012. He no longer has a role in the company.","Wu, who holds a degree in engineering, worked as a journalist before entering the real estate business."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Yiling is the honorary chairman of Yiling Pharmaceutical, a supplier of cardiovascular and flu drugs, among others.","Wu, whose father was a doctor, practiced Chinese medicine for 11 years himself before he founded Yiling Pharmaceutical in 1992. \r\n","Yiling's Lianhua Qingwen capsules have been recommended by China health experts for treating mild Covid cases.","The company is listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Yingming is chairman of the board of supervisors at Contemporary Amperex Technology, a supplier of lithium-ion batteries also known as CATL.","Wu holds an undergraduate degree from Northeastern University in China.","CATL is headquartered in the city of Ningde in China's Fujian Province."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Yonghua is a director and CEO of Anta Sports, one of the world's largest sportswear businesses.","Wu joined Anta in 2003 and has over 20 years of experience in sales and marketing.","Anta is headquartered in southern China's Fujian Province."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Zhigang is the founder of Shanghai-listed bakery chain Shenyang Toly Bread.","Wu was a teacher at an industrial school before founding the chain with his son Wu Xuequn in 1995; Xuequn is the company's general manager.","Wu Zhigang's wife, Sheng Yali, and sons Wu Xuedong, Wu Xuequn and Wu Xueliang hold shares in Toly.","Xuedong, Xuequn and Xueliang are board members.","Wu Zhigang retired as chairman in 2019 and was succeeded by Wu Xueliang."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Wu Zhongyi is the vice chairman of Yealink Network Technology, a supplier of video conferencing solutions and Internet phones.","Yealink Chairman Chen Zhisong is also a member of the 2019 Forbes China Rich List.","Yealink is headquartered in the eastern Chinese city of Xiamen."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xavier Neil owns telecoms giant Iliad, the parent company of Free, one of France's largest internet service providers.","His portfolio also includes ownership of Monaco Telecom and Orange Switzerland, the latter of which he acquired in 2014 for $2.9 billion and renamed Salt.","Niel also owns stakes in French newspaper LeMonde, British telecoms company Vodafone and Paris-based commercial real estate firm Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield.","His early venture WorldNet was France's first Internet provider. He started it in 1993 at age 25 and exited seven years later for $50 million."]
abouts: ["Niel used to own Parisian peep shows."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xavier Rubiralta owes his fortune to Spain-based Werfen, a diagnostics company that specializes in hemostasis, acute care, transfusion, autoimmunity and transplants.","A member of Werfen's board since 2013, he inherited his stake in the company from his late father in 2012.","Werfen's roots stem from his father and uncle who founded the business in 1966 as a health products distributor; it went on to acquire U.S.-based Instrumentation Laboratory in 1991.","Each inheriting equal stakes from his father, his brother Jordi, Jose Luis and Marc are also billionaires."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xi chao is a director of Neway Valve (Suzhou).","Xi co-founded the company in 1997 with Wang Baoqing, Lu Bin and Cheng Zhangwen.","The company went public in 2014."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xia Zuoquan is a non-executive director of BYD, one of the world's largest EV makers.","Xia worked in the Hubei branch of the People's Insurance Company before joining the group in 1997.","He graduated from Guanghua School of Management of Peking University with an EMBA in 2007 and studied computer science as an undergraduate.","Xia founded investment firm Zhengxuan Capital in 2003, which claims to manage more than $1.4 billion in assets. BYD is also one of its investments."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xiang Guangda is the chairman of Tsingshan Holding Group, which has interests in stainless steel, nickel and new energy.","Tsingshan's overseas investments include a nickel ore smelting facility in Indonesia.","It is also building a $233 million plant in Chile for lithium iron phosphate, which is used to power electric vehicles, slated to be commissioned in 2025.","Tsingshan's battery subsidiary Rept Battero Energy went public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2023."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xiang Guangming chairs Shanghai-listed Zhejiang Weiming Environment Protection.","Weiming's main business is solid waste incineration disposal.","Xiang's wife, Wang Suqin, also holds shares in the company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xiang Wenbo is chairman of Sany Group, a heavy equipment manufacturer.","Xiang is one of three billionaires from Sany Group, along with Liang Wengen and Mao Zhongwu.","Xiang is a graduate of Dalian University of Technology with a master's degree in molding."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xiao Hongxing is the chairman of Delton Technology, a maker of printed circuit boards headquartered in Guangzhou.","Two years after taking the firm public in Shenzhen, the mogul raised in 2026 $421 million through a separate share sale in Hong Kong. ","The dual-listed company, which has production bases in China and Thailand, supplies clients in sectors such as AI, clouding computing and data centers.","Xiao worked for an electronics firm based in the manufacturing hub of Dongguan before launching his own business with his wife, Liu Jinchan.","Liu is a director at Delton Technology."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xiao Yongming accrues his wealth from a stake in Zangge Mining, a Chinese mining business whose products include potassium chloride.","The company is headquartered in western China's Qinghai province.","Early in his career Xiao ran a plastics factory in Sichuan province.","His son, Xiao Yao, serve as the company's vice chairman and CEO.","The other son, Xiao Ning, stepped down as chairman of the company in 2025."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xie Juhua is a director and the largest individual shareholder at Kingfriend, a pharmaceuticals supplier.","Kingfriend's main products include cardiovascular and anti-tumor drugs.","Xie's son Tang Yongqun chairs Kingfriend."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xie Liangzhi chairs Beijing-based Sinocelltech Group, a supplier of biological products.","Xie holds a Ph.D. from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in chemical engineering.","He worked for Merck & Co. in the U.S. as a senior engineer from 1997 to 2002."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xie Weitong was the largest shareholder of Huayou Cobalt, a mainland Chinese supplier of cobalt and lithium battery chemicals. He sold all his stakes in 2021.","The company also operates cobalt and copper mining businesses in the Congo, and acquired a $422 million lithium mine in Zimbabwe in 2022.","Xie resigned in 2019 after serving as the company's vice chairman for 17 years since its inception."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xie Yi is the chairman and CEO of Suzhou Tianmai Thermal Technology, a maker of thermal management products including heat pipes and graphite films.","The company went public in Shenzhen in 2024, raising $87 million.","The mogul started his first job when he was only 16, working at a local factory that makes thermal management products.","Xie founded Suzhou Tianmai in 2007 with his wife Shen Fenghua, who is a director at the company.","Nowadays, Suzhou Tianmai supplies to customers including Contemporary Amperex Technology Company (CATL), Huawei and Samsung."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["XiongHaitao is a director of Shanghai-listed Kingfa Sci.and Tech, a plastics supplier.","The company entered the markets for medical and protective gloves during the global pandemic in 2020.","Xiong is the wife of Yuan Zhimin, who founded Kingfa in 1993."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xiong is a director at Sangfor Technologies, a supplier of IT infrastructure services.","Sangfor listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2018.","The Shenzhen-headquartered company has more than 9,500 employees."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xiong Xiaochuan chairs Chinese medical device and personal protective equipment supplier MeHow Innovative.","MeHow went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in October 2022.","Xiong worked for Sichuan Changhong Electric early in his career, before earning an MBA from the University of Warwick."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xiu Laigui's privately owned Xiuzheng Pharmaceuticals is one of China's largest pharmaceutical firms. \r\n","Xiu worked as a policeman in China in the early 1990s.","Xiuzheng is located in Tonghua in northeastern China's Jilin province."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Chuanhua founded a small family workshop to produce liquid soap and detergent in 1986 when he was 52 years old.","Today, his Transfar Group generates most of its business from logistics and chemicals. It also operates in agribusiness and investment industries.","Xu has retired from daily operations, handing reins to sons Guanju and Guanbao, who are chairman and vice chairman of Transfar Group respectively."]
title: Founder

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Gaoming is the founder and chairman of Chinese jewelry maker Laopu Gold.","Dubbed by consumers as \"Hermes of gold jewelry,\" the luxury brand features traditional Chinese design and craftsmanship.","Xu worked with a local fishery bureau and a tourism investment firm before officially launching Laopu in 2016.","He took the company public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2024. His son, Xu Dongbo, is also a major shareholder."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Guozhong chairs Jiangsu Guomao Reducer, a Chinese motor manufacturer.","Xu founded the processor of Guomao in Jiangsu Province in 1993.","Son Xu Bin, 32, is Guomao's general manager."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Hang is cofounder and director of Shenzhen Mindray Bio-Medical Electronics, a supplier of medical devices.","Mindray, founded in 1991, is headquartered in Shenzhen.","He also owns China's real estate developer Parkland Group, best known for its mixed-use skyscraper complex One Shenzhen Bay."]
abouts: ["Xu has earned an EMBA degree from China-Europe International Business School."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Jiangnan chairs Jiangxi Tianxin Pharmaceutical, a suppier of vitamins.","Jiangxi Tianxi went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2022.","Xu's daughter Xu Jing is a member of the board of directors."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu chairs Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology, a supplier of chemicals to sectors such as lithium-ion battery and personal care.","The company has 20 sites in China, Europe and the U.S., and is eyeing new plants in Texas and Morocco.","Xu obtained a bachelor's degree from Zhejiang University and a master's from the Chinese Academy of Sciences, both in chemistry."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Shihui is the chairman of Chinese snack and beverage maker Dali Foods Group.","Xu started out in the cookie business and took the food empire public in 2015. Today it is best known for its Copico potato chips, Heqizheng herbal tea and Haochidian soda crackers.","Citing reasons including unsatisfactory share performance, Xu took Hong Kong-listed Dali private in 2023 in a deal that values it at $6.6 billion.","His daughter Xu Yangyang rose from Dali's vice president to its president in 2025."]
abouts: ["Xu works seven days a week and hopes his work style inspires other managers. (He met Forbes Asia in his office in 2016 during a national holiday.)","Xu is the son of a laborer who worked at Dali when it was a collective and amassed shares by turning the business around."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Shijun is the founder of Jiangsu Haili Wind Power Equipment, a Chinese supplier of wind power generation equipment.","Haili went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2021.","Xu's son, Xu Chengchen, serves as a board member and vice general manager of the company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Shugen is the founder and chairman of Shanghai-listed Zhejiang Dingli Machinery.","Founded in 2005, Dingli manufactures industrial lifts.","Xu's brother, Xu Zhilong, is a board member."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Wanmao chairs the Huamao Group, whose interests include education, real estate and investment.","Huamao Group is headquartered in the eastern Chinese city of Ningbo, where it ranks as one of the city's largest service industry businesses.","Huamao Group's investments include the Bank of Ningbo."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Xudong chairs Ningbo Xusheng Auto Technology.","Xusheng is a supplier of gear boxes and battery protection shells to Tesla.","Other customers include Eaton, BMW and Bosch."]

name: Billionaires
