bios: ["Xu Yingzhuo is cofounder and director of Guangdong Haid Group, a supplier of aquatic products.","Xu holds degrees from South China University and an MBA from HEC Paris.","Guangdong Haid Group went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2009."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Yuejuan is a supervisor of Zhejiang Rongsheng Holding Group, a petrochemicals supplier.","Xu Yuejuan is a sister-in-law of Li Shuirong, the chairman and cofounder of Rongsheng's publicly traded Rongsheng Petro Chemical.","Zhejiang Rongsheng Holding is headquartered in the eastern Chinese city of Hangzhou."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xu Zhenhua cofounded Moonton Games, a business bought by ByteDance for $4 billion in 2021.","Cofounder Justin Yuan is also a billionaire.","Xu worked at China online game leader Tencent before taking the plunge as an entrepreneur himself."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xue Hua is cofounder and chairman of Guangdong Haid Group, a supplier of animal feed products.","Haid employs 20,000 people.","Xue graduated from Huazhong Agricultural University with a major in aquaculture in 1992."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xue Min controls Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare, a supplier of medical equipment for imaging and radiation therapy.","The company sells to 50 countries, including the U.S., Italy, Japan and New Zealand.","It went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange's Sci-Tech Innovation Board in 2022.","Earlier, in 1998, Xue founded Shenzhen Mindit Instruments, which was later acquired by  Siemens Medical Solutions."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Xue Xiangdong chairs Shenzhen-listed DHC Software, which makes software for industrial applications.","Xue worked at a state-owned company after graduation but quit in 1992 to become a representative in China for a Canadian software firm.\r\n","DHC went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2006."]

name: Billionaires
bios:
["Yair Hamburger is a controlling shareholder of Harel Insurance, an Israeli insurance and financial services company.
","He is one of three siblings - alongside Gideon Hamburger and Nurit Manor - who control Harel through G.Y.N Consulting, the family's privately held company.
","Harel, now one of Israel's biggest institutional financial firms, was founded in 1939 and has remained under family control.
","Harel manages assets valued at NIS 571 billion ($176 billion) and operates across health, motor, life insurance, pensions and asset management. 
"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yakir Gabay owns 15% of Frankfurt-listed German real estate company Aroundtown SA, where he serves as deputy chairman of the advisory board.","Aroundtown has around a $30 billion portfolio of commercial real estate in Europe.","It also has a 63% stake in Grand City Properties, which owns around 63,400 apartments in Germany and London.","Originally from Israel, Gabay previously served as CEO of the underwriting arm of Bank Leumi, one of Israel's largest banks.","Gabay started his career in the Prospectus Department of Israel's SEC before transitioning to the private sector."]
abouts: ["Gabay's father was Meir Gabay, the former Civil Service Commissioner of Israel and Director-General of the Israeli Ministry of Justice."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yan Junjie is the chairman and CEO of Chinese AI model company MiniMax Group.","The company sells products such as audio- and video- generating models to enterprises as well as individual developers.","The mogul took the firm public in Hong Kong in January 2026, raising $618 million. It previously raised funding from investors including Alibaba, Tencent and Chinese gaming firm miHoYo.","Liu Wei, billionaire cofounder of miHoYo, is a board director at MiniMax.","Yan worked at fellow Hong Kong-listed Chinese AI company SenseTime for over six years before founding MiniMax in 2021."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["A former advertising executive, Yan Zhi chairs Hong Kong-listed Zall Smart Commerce Group, previously called Zall Group.","The firm started with shopping mall development and then got into e-commerce as well as wholesale trading, logistics and warehousing.","Yan holds an EMBA from the Cheung Kong Graduate School.","Yan holds 30% of Z-Bank, a Wuhan-based bank that specializes in lending to small businesses involved in supply chain transactions."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yan Zhou is the chairman and general manager of Chinese snacks retailer Busy Ming Group.","The company went public in Hong Kong in January 2026, raising $470 million.","It sells under the Busy for You and Super Ming brands, offering products such as small-packaged biscuits and nuts across a network of about 20,000 stores in China.","The group was formed in 2023, when Yan's company Busy for You merged with fellow snacks retailer Super Ming.","Super Ming's founder, Zhao Ding, is also a billionaire."]
abouts: ["Yan grew up in a rural village in China's Hunan province, and worked in the real estate industry for about eight years before venturing into the snacks business."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Chang-Chih is the founder of Gold Circuit Electronics, a maker of printed circuit boards for servers and networking equipment.","He handed over the chairman position to his son Chen-Tse in 2017. The older Yang still serves as a director.","Gold Circuit Electronics listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange in 1998.","The company opened its first Thai plant in 2025 with $40 million investment and is pumping another $40 million into its expansion project.","His daughter Chen-Jung also sits on the board."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Huiyan chairs property developer Country Garden. She became the only one at the helm after her father Yeung Kwok Keung stepped down as co-chair in February 2023.","Yang has long been groomed for succession. Yeung transferred a 57% Country Garden stake to her back in 2007, which once made her the world's youngest female billionaire.","Her sister Yang Ziying also sits on the board; husband Chen Chong is a non-executive director.","In August 2023, Country Garden triggered fresh turmoil in China's beleaguered real estate market after it missed interest payments of $22.5 million on two offshore bonds.","Yang donated in the same year $826 million worth of shares in property management arm Country Garden Services to a Hong Kong charity set up by sister Ziying."]
abouts: ["Yang obtained a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Meng is the founder and chairman of Anker Innovations Technology, a supplier of smart charging technologies and a developer of consumer products such as earbuds and home security systems.","Yang founded Anker in 2011, after working as a senior software engineer at Google parent Alphabet for six years in the U.S.","The company first went public in Shenzhen in 2020.","It raised in 2026 $590 million through a dual listing in Hong Kong, as the firm seeks to develop new smart charging and power storage products."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Min is the founder and former chairman of China Hanking Holdings,  an iron ore mining and processing company.\r\n","Yang took China Hanking public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2011.","Yang's son, Yang Jiye, is chairman, CEO and president of the company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Qiumei's wealth derives from a stake in Chinese AI giant SenseTime.","She inherited the stake from her late husband Tang Xiao'ou, cofounder of the company who died in 2023 at age 55.","Yang is a managing director and advisor to the CEO at Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing. She doesn't hold any position at SenseTime.","Prior to joining the Hong Kong bourse, Yang had stints at Investment Company Institute, an industry association of investment funds, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission.","Yang donated in December 2025 $2.6 million to four universities in Hong Kong through her Sophie and Sean Foundation, which was set up in the same year to support innovation and research in AI."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Shaopeng's fortune derives from a stake in SITC International Holdings, a shipping and logistics company.","Yang stepped down as chairman in 2024; then CEO Yang Xianxiang, not related to him, took over the position.","Yang Shaopeng's daughter Yang Xin is the company's vice chairman."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Weidong chairs Zhejiang Satellite Petrochemical.","The company's product line includes acrylic acid esters, methacrylic acids, pigment intermediates and acrylic emulsion polymers.","Satellite went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2011."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Xuegang is the chairman and CEO of China Risun Group, a supplier of coke and chemicals.","Founded in 1995, China Risunis headquartered in Beijing.","Yang Xuegangworked at the Dongwushi Reservoir Management Center-- under a government water bureau -- earlier in his career.","Yang Xuegang holds an executive master's degree in business administration from Hebei University of Technology in Tianjin."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Ying is a director of Chinese drugmaker Xiamen Amoytop Biotech.","Founded in 1996, Amoytop supplies recombinant protein drugs.","Yang's husband Lan Chun is the company's chairman; the two are investors."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Yuanqing is chairman and CEO of Lenovo, one of China's largest makers of computer hardware.","He joined the company in 1989 and became its CEO twenty years later. \t\t","An engaging leader, Yang speaks frequently at conferences (lately on A.I.) and posts often about his business activities on social media.","He sits on the board of Chinese search giant Baidu as an independent director, a post he's held since 2015."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Yunchun is the chairman and general manager of Sai MicroElectronics, a producer of micro sensors.","The company is headquartered in Beijing.","The company went public in 2015."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yao Hsiao Tung is the executive chairman and CEO of Hi-P International, which the former DuPont executive acquired as a small tool maker in 1983.","Today it is one of Singapore's largest contract manufacturers of smartphones, tablet computers and consumer electronics with customers such as Apple.","In 2017, he acquired the stake of longtime partner Molex, a manufacturer of electrical connectors owned by U.S. billionaire Charles Koch.","He delisted the company from the Singapore Stock Exchange at a valuation of $1.2 billion in 2021, with the aim of securing greater flexibility in running the business. He plans to relist it by 2030.","In 2024, Temasek-backed 65 Equity Partners invested S$100 million ($74 million) in the company."]
abouts: ["Yao was born in mainland China but moved to Taiwan as a child; he's now a Singaporean citizen."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yao Kuizhang chairs Hebei Yangyuan Zhihui Beverage, a supplier of walnut drinks.","Yao owns 30% of the company.","Yao worked for Hebei Hengshui Laobaigan Liquor as a technician early in his career."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yao Liangsong is the chairman of Guangzhou-headquartered Oppein Home Group, one of China's largest makers of custom kitchen cabinets and home furniture.","Yao set up Oppein in 1994, which has prospered amid a rise in home ownership and growth in the middle class.","The company has opened 7,400 stores in more than 100 countries.","His brother Yao Liangbo is a director at Oppein."]
abouts: ["Yao holds a bachelor's degree in machinery manufacturing from Beihang University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yao Runhao is the chairman and CEO of Shanghai-based Paper Games.","The company has developed Love and Deepspace, one of the most popular dating simulation games in China.","Launched in 2024, Love and Deepspace lets players build a virtual romance with five AI-powered characters.","Paper Games also develops other female-oriented mobile games such as Love and Producer, a dating simulation game as well.","Yao established Paper Games in 2013 after returning to China from Japan's Waseda University."]
abouts: ["Tim Cook visited Paper Games' Shanghai office in 2024, and discussed introducing its dating simulation games to the Apple Vision Pro device."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yao Yi is the chairman and CEO of Luster LightTech, a supplier of machine vision equipment.","Yao worked as a teacher in Institute of Optical Communication, Beijing Jiaotong University before cofounding Luster LightTech in 2002.","Luster LightTech listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2022."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yasemin Zeynep Keyman is one of more than a dozen family members who hold shares in ENKA, one of Turkey's largest construction and energy companies.","ENKA, which was cofounded in 1957 by Sarik Tara and his brother-in-law, Sadi Gulcelik, is Turkey's leading private electricity producer and also operates in real estate, tourism, transport and trade (construction equipment and machinery).","In Moscow, ENKA owns a hotel, shopping malls and approximately 370,000 square meters of net rentable Class A office space.","Sadi Gulcelik died in a plane accident in Saudi Arabia in 1980, and Mehmet Sinan Tara took over in 1984 at age 26. His son Agah Mehmet Tara became CEO in 2012, at age 29."]
abouts: ["Over the last 20 years or so, ENKA has been the biggest builder of U.S. consular and embassy buildings.","These government projects can be found in locations ranging from Turkey, Algeria and Nepal to Equatorial Guinea, the Dominican Republic and the Netherlands."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yasseen Mansour is a shareholder in family-owned conglomerate Mansour Group, which was founded by his father Loutfy (d. 1976) in 1952.","Mansour Group is the exclusive distributor of GM vehicles and Caterpillar equipment in Egypt and several other countries.","His brothers Mohamed and Youssef are also billionaires and part owners of Mansour Group.","He's chairman of Palm Hills Developments, one of Egypt's biggest real estate developers."]
abouts: ["Mansour Group is the sole franchisee of McDonald's in Egypt, as well as the distributor of Gauloises cigarettes."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yasuhide Uno runs U-Next Holdings, a company that's become a streaming services giant in Japan.It also provides payment and point-of-sales services to restaurants and stores, broadband services and energy to companies.","His father Mototada started the Osaka-based company providing background music via cable to retailers and restaurants. Yasuhide joined the firm in 1998, just before his father died.","In 2001, it listed on the Osaka Stock Exchange's bourse for startups and moved to the Tokyo Stock Exchange in 2013.","In June, the company announced a tie-up with Tokyo-based e-commerce giant Rakuten for a mobile package to enable unlimited U-Next videos and data usage.","The Tokyo-based company posted nearly $2.5 billion in revenue in the fiscal year through August 2025."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yasuhiro Fukushima founded gaming software firm Enix, which merged with rival Square in 2003 to become Square Enix.","The Tokyo-listed company made its mark with its Final Fantasy franchise and its Dragon Quest series.","He currently serves as the honorary chairman of Square Enix Holdings."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yasuhisa Ito is the son of Seven&I Holding's late honorary chairman Masatoshi Ito and gets his wealth from a minority stake in the global retailing giant.","His two siblings, Junro Ito and Hisako Yamamoto, are also billionaires based on their stakes.","Masatoshi Ito, who helped build 7-Eleven into a global giant, died in March 2023 at age 98.","Seven & i Holdings has 87,000 stores in 19 countries and over $80 billion in annual revenue.","In 2024, Canadian retail giant, Alimentation Couche-Tard made a $47 billion takeover bid for the company but withdrew in July 2025 citing the retailer's lack of cooperation during negotiations."]
abouts: ["The company also runs Denny's restaurants in Japan and owns department stores, supermarkets, and financial services firms.","The family was mulling making a $58 billion management buyout of the company but backed out in February 2025  citing financial issues.","In March 2025, the company announced a massive share buyback plan in a bid to bolster its share price.","In March 2025, Seven & I agreed to sell its York Holdings unit, which includes major supermarket chains and specialty retailers, to Bain Capital for $5.4 billion."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yasumitsu Shigeta is chairman of Tokyo-listed Hikari Tsushin, which sells mobile phones and cellular services for major Japanese carriers.","The company also supplies electricity and gas to small and mid-size businesses besides selling insurance and office equipment.","He founded Hikari Tsushin in 1988. The dotcom crash in 2001 wiped out much of his fortune.","He rejoined the Forbes World Billionaires list in 2005 when shares of Hikari Tsushin rebounded."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["A politician turned entrepreneur, Ye Chenghai chairs Shenzhen Salubris Pharmaceuticals which makes cardiovascular, cancer and anti-infective drugs. \r\n","Ye was the mayor of Shenzhen in the 1980s.","Ye's son Kevin is Salubris' CEO; his daughter Ye Yujun is a board member."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Ye Guofu is the founder and CEO of budget retail chain Miniso, known for its value-for-money goods such as $1.5 mascara and $6 headphones.","The company went public on the New York Stock Exchange in October 2020.","Once branded as Japan-inspired, Miniso apologized in 2022 for its marketing strategy amid consumer backlash at home. It has has since removed Japanese elements from its store and logo designs.","Banking on a franchise-heavy model for expansion, the company now has over 5,000 Miniso shops, including more than 2,000 overseas.","Ye holds a degree from Zhongnan University of Economics and Law."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Ye Qiongjiu is deputy general manager of Hithink RoyalFlush Information Network, an online financial information services business.","Ye cofounded the predecessor business of Hithink with its chairman and fellow billionaire Yi Zheng.","Hithink founded Hithinkin Hangzhou in 1994 with 100,000 yuan, currently worth $14,000; it went public in 2009."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Ye Xiaoping is the chairman of Hangzhou Tigermed Consulting, one of China's largest contract research organizations in the pharmaceutical industry.","Ye holds an EMBA from Peking University and a Ph.D. from Oxford University.","Ye was an executive at Swiss pharmaceutical giant Roche before becoming an entrepreneur.","Tigermed was founded in 2004."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yeh Kuo-I is the founder and group president of Inventec, which started as a maker of electronic notebooks in 1975.","Inventec has since expanded into other consumer electronic products such as computers and servers, and today employs more than 36,000 people.","Apart from Inventec, Yeh also has stakes in Taiwan-based Win Semiconductors.","His wealth includes stakes held by his wife, his two sons and his two daughters-in-law. His younger son Sam is Inventec's chairman."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yeung Kin-man is the founder, president and chief technology officer of Biel Crystal.","Lam Wai Ying, Yeung's wife and Biel's chairman, owns 49% of the business; Yeung holds 51%.","Biel is a supplier of smartphone touch screens to Apple and Samsung, and employs 90,000 people around the world.","Since 2021 Biel has filed twice for a Hong Kong IPO but it never materialized."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yi Dasheng chairs Hunan Fortune Group, whose business interests include property development, auto-related services and trade.","Yi worked in a government office in the southern Chinese city of Yueyang before taking the plunge as an entrepreneur.","He made his early fortune in auto repair."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yi Zheng is the chairman and CEO of Hithink RoyalFlush Information Network, a Shenzhen-listed financial data and information provider.","The company operates Tonghuashun, a trading app for retail investors that counts over 35 million monthly active users in China.","It also provides research and financial data services to enterprises through the iFinD platform. ","Yi took gig jobs and started to develop analytics software for local brokerages before graduating from college. ","He cofounded his first IT company in 1994 and Hithink's predecessor Shanghai Hexin in 2001."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yigal Dimri is the CEO and owner of the real estate group Y.H. Dimri, a Tel Aviv-based real estate business.","Y.H. Dimri is one of the largest residential construction companies in Israel, operating in the residential, office, and commercial real estate sectors.","He began his career as a renovation contractor in 1980 together with his father and established Y.H. Dimri in 1989.","In 2004, the company went public, and its securities are traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Lee Yin Yee is the founder and chairman of Xinyi Glass Holdings.","Xinyi Glass produces glass products for the automobile, construction and household good industries.","Early in his career, Lee was involved in auto-parts trading."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yinon Costica cofounded Israeli cloud security business Wiz and owned a 10% stake in the company. ","Google's parent company Alphabet acquired Wiz for $32 billion in cash in March 2026.","Wiz software scans storage providers such as Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure to flag and prioritize security risks.","The company's revenue surpassed $100 million in 2023, when the founders began their \"suicide plan\" of hiring fast, raising funds and targeting top-of-market corporations.","Wiz customers include Fox, Morgan Stanley and LVMH, whose billionaire CEO wrote the unicorn a personal check."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yitzhak Tshuva made his billions in energy and real estate.","His private El Ad Group, a real estate firm, has developments in Manhattan, Florida, Louisiana, Montreal and Israel.","His is also the controlling shareholder of Delek Group, a publicly-traded conglomerate with interests in automotives, oil and gas.","His family immigrated from Libya to Israel when he was six months old. He later served in the Israeli army and worked in Israel's Ministry of Defense."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yoichi Erikawa cofounded videogame developer Koei more than four decades ago with his wife Keiko Erikawa.","The company, now called Koei Tecmo Holdings, trades on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.","The founders are stepping away from executive roles. Starting April, Yoichi, who is now CEO, will become chairman; and Keiko, who is now chairman, will become chairman emeritus.","The company is known for its Samurai Warrior games.","Hisashi Koinuma, currently executive vice president, is set to become president and CEO in June."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yoni Nahmad is one of three sons of the late art billionaire Ezra Nahmad, who died in 2023.","Ezra Nahmad, along with his billionaire brother David, was an international megadealer of modern and impressionist art.","At the time of his death, the brothers' art inventory, which is stored in a duty-free warehouse in Geneva, Switzerland, was worth almost $7 billion.","Ezra's half of the collection - which includes works by more than 30 blue chip artists, from Monet and Matisse to Renoir and Rothko - was split evenly among his three sons after his death.","The family also owns 300 Picassos worth at least $1 billion and real estate in London, Monaco and the U.S."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yoo Jung-hyun owns a minority stake in online gaming giant Nexon through NXC.","Her husband Kim Jung-ju built up Nexon and then retired from management in 2006; he died in 2022 at age 54.","She joined NXC in 1995 and has been serving as its statutory auditor since 2010."]
abouts: ["Yoo Jung-hyun met her future husband at a ski resort when he was a freshman."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yoon Dae-in is the chairman of South Korean biotechnology company Sam Chun Dang Pharm (SCD).","SCD develops active pharmaceutical ingredients used in treatments for dry-eye disease and high blood pressure.","The company also develops novel drug delivery systems, such as S-Pass, which turns injectable medicines into easy-to-take pills.","In January 2026, SCD signed an agreement with Japanese big pharma Daiichi Sankyo to jointly develop and commercialize SCD's weight-loss pill, which was developed using S-Pass, in Japan.","SCD was established in 1943 during the Japanese occupation under the name Chosun Sam Chun Dang. In 1986, after completing his M.B.A. studies, Yoon used family funds to acquire Chosun Sam Chun Dang."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yoshiaki Yoshida is the founder of Japanese beauty brand DHC. He started the company in 1972 to provide translation services.","In 1980, he started the cosmetics business using organic olives. In 1983, he got into the mail order segment. It also sells nutritional supplements and health foods.","The privately held company sells both through retail stores and online.","In 2023, Yoshida sold his company to Japanese leasing giant Orix, which valued it at ¥300 billion."]
abouts: ["DHC stands for Daigaku Honyaku Center.","Yoshida is a supporter of conservative political causes and has his own TV production company providing online and broadcast content.","DHC sources its olive oil from organic olive groves in Spain."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yoshiko Mori was the widow of real estate tycoon Minoru Mori, who died in 2012. She died in December 2025.","She inherited part of Minoru's estate, including a share of his real estate firm, Mori Building.","Mori Building is known for developments such as Tokyo's swank Roppongi Hills complex, a mix of retail, restaurants, apartments, hotel and offices.","Mori Building also co-developed one of China's tallest buildings, the Shanghai World Financial Center.","In 2023, it opened its largest project in two decades, the $4.3 billion Azabudai Hills in Tokyo, an office, condo, retail and hotel complex, including Japan's tallest building at 330 meters."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["You Xiaoping is the chairman of Huafon Group, a maker of polyurethane products.","Huafon Group is also involved in metals, finance, logistics and trade.","One of its units, Shenzhen-listed Huafon Chemical, is among the world's largest spandex fiber makers by production volume."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Youssef Mansour is chairman of family-owned conglomerate Mansour Group, which was founded by his father Loutfy (d. 1976) in 1952.","Mansour Group is the exclusive distributor of GM vehicles and Caterpillar equipment in Egypt and several other countries.","He oversees the consumer goods division, which includes supermarket chain Metro, and sole distribution rights for L'Oreal in Egypt.","Younger brothers Mohamed and Yasseen are also billionaires and part owners of Mansour Group."]
abouts: ["Former Egypt President Gamal Abdel Nasser nationalized his father's original cotton trading business.","Mansour is a founding member of the American Egyptian Chamber of Commerce."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yousuf Mohammad Salah Jamjoom, the founder of Jamjoom Pharmaceuticals Factory, one of Saudi Arabia's largest producers of over-the-counter medicines, died at age 96 on January 29, 2026.","Yousuf owned a nearly 42% stake in the company, which is based in Jeddah and went public on the Saudi stock exchange in 2023. ","His son Mahmoud Yousuf Jamjoom is the chairman of the company.","From 1965 to 2005, Yousuf was the CEO of Jamjoom Medicine Store, which specialized in storing and distributing pharmaceutical products. ","Yousuf Jamjoom earned a diploma in commerce from the University of Wales in the U.K. in 1947."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yu De-Chao, also known as Michael Yu, is the chairman and CEO of Innovent Biologics, a China-headquartered biotech company.","Innovent went public at the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2018.","Yu holds a PhD in molecular genetics from the Chinese Academy of Sciences.","Yu had a postdoc position in pharmaceutical chemistry at the University of California San Francisco from 1993 to 1996."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yu is chairman of KTK Group, which provides electrical control systems for railroads.","KTK Group is headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province.","Yu's son, Ge Jianming, sits on the board of the company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yu Kai is the chairman and CEO of Beijing-based Horizon Robotics, which develops both the software and hardware needed for self-driving cars.","The company listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in October 2024 in what was the bourse's largest IPO so far in the year, raising nearly $700 million.","Before it went public, Horizon has attracted investors including SAIC Motor, 5Y Capital, Hillhouse, HongShan and Volkswagen.","Horizon claims to be the largest Chinese provider of assisted and autonomous driving systems in the country by installation volume, counting Volkswagen, Hyundai Motor and BYD as its customers.","An AI scientist, Yu started an autonomous driving project at Baidu before cofounding Horizon Robotics in 2015 with other former Baidu employees."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yu Lili is a director of electronic products maker Changsha Jingjia Microelectronics. She stepped down as vice chair in August 2024.","Changsha Jingjia Microelectronics went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2016.","Yu's husband Zeng Wanhui chairs Jingjia."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yu Peidi chairs Shanghai-listed real estate developer Greattown Holdings. \r\n\r\n","Yu left his hometown Fuzhou in 1976 and got his start in the home appliances trade in Indonesia.","Yu began to invest in Fuzhou in the 1980s, starting with minerals and later real estate."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yu Qibing is a former chairman of the Kibing Group, a glass manufacturer.","Zhuzhou Kibing Group listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2011.","The Group is headquartered in Shenzhen, China."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yu Renrong is the founder and chairman of fabless image sensor chip maker OmniVision Integrated Circuits Group, formerly known as Will Semiconductor.","The company supplies to sectors such as smartphones and electric vehicles.","It has become one of the world's largest image sensor chip makers after acquiring U.S. competitor OmniVision in 2019 for $2.2 billion.","Yu worked as an engineer in China's tech conglomerate Langchao, now called Inspur, after graduating from college.","Yu is also the founder of the Eastern Institute of Technology, a university in east China's Ningbo, Zhejiang, established through his Yu Renrong Education Foundation."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yu Rong chairs Meinian Onehealth Healthcare Holdings, which offers health exams throughout China.","Yu holds a doctor's degree in Chinese medicine from the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences and an EMBA of China Europe International Business School.","Yu is a director at Shenzhen Rapoo Technology and Beijing Huamei Kangxun Information Technology."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yu Yong's wealth mainly comes from his holdings in CMOC Group, formerly China Molybdenum, one of the world's largest producers of the metal.","He also owns a stake in global lithium-ion battery leader CATL.","Yu's investment holding firm Cathay Fortune is an early investor in Zeekr, an electric vehicle brand under China's automobile giant Geely. Zeekr went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2024.","In 2025, CMOC took Canada-listed Lumina Gold private in a $419 million deal. Lumina fully owns the Cangrejos gold-copper project in Ecuador.","In January 2026, CMOC acquired four producing gold mines in Brazil from Canada-listed Equinox Gold for $1 billion."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yu Zhuyun is the chairman and CEO of Central New Energy Holding Group. ","A veteran property entrepreneur, Yu founded the company in 2004 and built it into a business whose diverse interests span new energy, real estate and wellness.","In September 2026, the mogul proposed to change the company's name to Central AI Technology Group, which he says better reflects the firm's direction in constructing and operating data centers. ","One of Central's significant acquisitions is its 2019 deal to buy Hong Kong-listed construction company Wang Yang Holdings for HK$560 million ($70 million).","Yu holds an MBA from Hong Kong Baptist University and an EMBA from Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yuan Fugen cofounded Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing, a maker of precision metal plates and cast metal.","Sons Yuan Yonggang and Yuan Yongfeng are chairman and general manager, respectively, of the company.","It listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2010. ","Dongshan Precision acquired Source Photonics, a maker of optical transceiver which is vital in AI systems, for over $800 million in 2025."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yuan Jiandong chairs Shanghai-listed BrightGene Bio-Medical Technology, a pharmaceutical supplier.","Following university, he worked for U.S.-based Enzo Biochem from 1998 to 2001 before returning to China to start BrightGene.","He holds an undergraduate degree in chemistry from Peking University and a Ph.D. in chemistry from the State University of New York."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yuan Zhimin is founder of Shanghai-listed Kingfa Sci & Tech, a supplier of modified plastics.","In 2020, due to the global pandemic, the company expanded into the production of medical and protective gloves.","Yuan, who holds a graduate degree from the Beijing Institute of Technology, founded the company in 1993.","Yuan's son, Yuan Changchang, was appointed vice chairman of Kingfa in 2024."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yang Jianliang is a founder and honorary chairman of Sailun Group, a Chinese tire manufacturer. He stepped down as chairman in July 2021.","Sailun is headquartered in the eastern port city of Qingdao.","Sailun went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2011."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yuji Otsuka is the son of the late Minoru Otsuka, who founded Otsuka Corp. in 1961, a software developer and supplier of office copy machines.","Yuji, a former banker, took over as CEO when Minoru retired in 2001.","Otsuka's forecasted revenue for 2024 is $6.6 billion."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yuri Karptsov is a cofounder of DNS Retail, Russia's largest chain of consumer electronic products.","Along with Dmitry Alexeyev, a fellow billionaire, Karptsov started with a small store in 1998 in Vladivostok, a port city east of Moscow.","The pair opened its second location in 2005 and have expanded to more than 2,700 stores and 39,000 employees.","The company also has interests in property development and information technology (IT)."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yuri Kovalchuk is friends with Russia's president Vladimir Putin; they met when Putin was deputy mayor of St. Petersburg.","They both had country houses in the Ozero dacha cooperative, and when Putin became president, many of the cooperative's members' careers improved.","Kovalchuck is now the largest shareholder of Rossiya Bank and has a large stake in Sogaz insurance company.","He controls National Media Group, an investment firm with controlling stakes in popular Russian media assets.","He was sanctioned by the U.S. and the EU in 2014, along with a group of close Putin friends.","In December 2021 Sogaz bought 45% of MF Technologies, that controls VK, one of the largest internet companies in Russia.\r\n"]
abouts: ["After US sanctions hit Kovalchuk's Rossiya Bank, Vladimir Putin moved his payroll account to the bank.","Kovalchuk's son Boris is a former CEO of InterRAO, a large state-owned energy company in Russia. Now he is a chairman of the Accounts Chamber of Russia."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yuri Milner is a Russian-born, Israeli tech investor who was an early backer of Facebook and Twitter through his venture fund, DST Global.","Milner sold those stakes and later invested in Spotify and Airbnb.","Milner also bet big on Chinese tech companies, including online retailers Alibaba and JD.Com, and mobile phone maker Xiaomi.","In August 2022, Milner renounced his Russian citizenship."]
abouts: ["A former physicist, Milner is a cofounder of the Breakthrough Prize, which rewards top scientists with lucrative prizes and a glitzy awards ceremony.","In 2015, Milner launched \"Breakthrough Listen,\" a $100 million project to search for alien life."]
title: Partner

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yuri Shefler established the SPI Group, which produced and sold alcohol under 380 brands in 170 countries.","Shefler divided his alcohol business into two companies in 2021: Stoli Group (maker of Stolichnaya vodka) and Amber Beverage Group, which manufactures other spirits.","Amber Beverage Group owns Latvijas balzams, the largest producer of alcoholic beverages in the Baltics, and Amber Production Tequila (KAH Tequila, Rooster Rojo Tequila and Cenote).","He bought Stolichnaya, his best-known brand, from state-owned VVO Soyuzplodoimport for $285,000 in 1997. Russia's Supreme Court deemed the deal illegal in 2021, banning Stoli sales inside Russia.","In 2024, a Russian court declared Shefler an extremist and confiscated his Russian assets for state use. "]
abouts: ["Stolichnaya vodka was banned for sale in the Netherlands, Luxembourg and Belgium in 2014. "]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yusaku Maezawa founded Japan's largest online fashion mall, Zozotown, in 1998. Its parent company, Zozo, is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.","In 2019, Maezawa announced that he was resigning as CEO and selling most of his stake to Yahoo Japan in a deal worth more than $2.3 billion.","Maezawa got his start selling CDs and records of his favorite bands by mail from his home.","He collects modern art and plans to build a museum to display it in Chiba, east of Tokyo.","In 2021, Maezawa flew on a Russian Soyuz rocket to the International Space Station for a 12-day trip. Maezawa's trip to the moon on Elon Musk's SpaceX, scheduled for 2023, was cancelled in 2024 due to delays in the rocket's development."]
abouts: ["In 2017, he paid over $110 million for Jean-Michel Basquiat's 1982 painting \"Untitled,\" a new record for the artist.","Maezawa, who had advertised in January 2020 for a 'life partner' to accompany him on his moon trip, later sought eight people to go with him."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yusuf Hamied is the non-executive chairman of Mumbai-based generics maker Cipla.","Cipla was founded in 1935 by his father Khwaja Abdul Hamied, a disciple of Mahatma Gandhi.","After the patriarch passed away in 1972, Cambridge-educated Hamied and his brother Mustafa inherited the business.","Hamied took on big pharmaceutical companies, offering low-cost generic drugs for diseases such as AIDS, earning the label of drug pirate. \r\n","At the annual shareholders' meeting in 2023, Hamied called reports of a potential stake sale in Cipla by the family to a private equity firm as \"speculative.\""]
abouts: ["His niece Samina Hamied was Cipla's executive vice-chairman until March 2024.","Renowned music conductor Zubin Mehta is Hamied's childhood pal.","Cambridge University has named a building after him, making him the first Indian to get that honor."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yves-Loic Martin is the former chief technology officer of Eurofins Scientific, a  laboratory testing company listed on the French stock exchange.","Martin owns about 10% of the company, which went public in 1997.\r\n","He joined Eurofins in 1992 and became chief technology officer in 1998. He stepped down in 2015 but remains a board member.","Eurofins has 400 labs in 41 countries and is prominent in food and pharmaceutical products testing.","Martin's billionaire brother, Gilles, founded the lab in 1987 and remains CEO."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yvonne Bauer runs Bauer Media Group, which has been in her family for five generations since its founding as a small printing company in 1875. Today, its business lines include print publishing, audio and online media.","Europe's largest magazine company, it focuses on women's content and counts over 600 titles worldwide, including InTouch and Grazia.","Yvonne Bauer is the second-youngest child of Heinz Heinrich Bauer. She received 85% of the company, while her three sisters each received 5%.","In 2020, Bauer expanded its reach in the German newspaper industry with the acquisition of Mitteldeutsche Zeitung in Halle for an undisclosed sum.","Prior to joining her family's company in 2005, Bauer apprenticed at publishing House Hoffmann und Campe."]
abouts: ["In the digital sphere, Bauer Group runs over 400 websites and apps, including The Debrief and Lecker.de.","In 2014, she married Enno Koch, a German television journalist and producer; the couple has twins born in 2015."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Yvonne Lo cofounded clothing manufacturer Crystal International Group with her husband Kenneth in 1970.","They have built a modest sweater factory into one of Asia's largest garment manufacturers, with 80,000 employees at 20 sites around the world.","Crystal's customers include Fast Retailing, Gap, Abercrombie & Fitch, Nike, Adidas and Puma.","Yvonne is vice chairman of Crystal. Kenneth is chairman while their son Andrew is CEO.","Kenneth is the eldest son of the late textile magnate Law Ting-pong."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zach McLeroy founded the chicken chain Zaxby's with Tony Townley, his best friend since the seventh grade.","Townley and McLeroy each put up $8,000 to open the first Zaxby's restaurant in Statesboro, Georgia in 1990.","In 2020, McLeroy sold 20% of his stake to Goldman Sachs for an estimated $400 million; he still owns 30% of the business.","Townley sold his entire stake in the business to Goldman Sachs at the same time.","McLeroy served as CEO of Zaxby's until 2022; he remains chairman of the board of directors."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zachary Stern's grandfather, Marvin Sands, founded a humble wine business in 1945 at age 21.","That small operation has mushroomed into a publicly-traded behemoth now called Constellation Brands, which generates nearly $10 billion in annual revenue.","The company is known for its relentless streak of acquisitions. Subsidiaries include Robert Mondavi wine and Svedka Vodka.","Constellation also holds the rights to Grupo Modelo's U.S. beer business, including its Modelo and Corona labels.","Stern's uncles, Robert and Richard Sands, are former executives and current board members. His sister, Abigail Bennett, is also a billionaire.","The family received $1.5 billion (pre-tax) of cash to convert its enhanced voting shares to ordinary shares in 2022."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["An Iraqi native, Zadik Bino moved to Israel and worked his way up the chain at First International Bank of Israel, known as FIBI.","Bino went on to serve as CEO of FIBI from 1978 to 1986 before buying the company two decades later; he still owns 28.5% of the bank.","He purchased a 60% stake in Israeli company Paz Oil in 1999 for $48 million.","He has since liquidated his position in Paz Oil in transactions worth an estimated $800 million."]
abouts: ["He purchased FIBI Holdings from Brazil's Safra brothers for $90 million in cash in 2003.","The Jerusalem Post once described the \"Bino formula\" as \"know what you want, move fast and pay cash.\""]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zahan Mistry is the son of the late Cyrus Mistry, the former chairman of Tata Sons, the holding company of the Tata conglomerate.","He inherited part of his family's 18.4% stake in Tata Sons after his father died in a car crash in 2022.","His uncle Shapoor Mistry  is chairman of the family's Mumbai construction giant, Shapoorji Pallonji Group.","To reduce debt, the group plans to raise an estimated $850 million by listing privately held construction and engineering firm Afcons Infrastructure."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["In the early 1990s Zakhar Smuskhin and his business partner Boris Zingarevich were active in barter trading with Russian pulp and paper mills.","Later in the 1990s, during the privatization phase in Russia, they bought their first plant, the Kotlas pulp and paper mill.","The partners' Ilim Group formed a joint venture in 2007 with multinational firm International Paper; the venture operates in Russia as Ilim Group.","As part of the deal, International Paper purchased 50% of Ilim for approximately $650 million.","In 2023 International Paper sold its 50% interest in Ilim Group to the Russian partners.","Smushkin also owns some 3,500 acres of land near Saint Petersburg."]
abouts: ["Russia's prime minister and former president, Dmitry Medvedev, worked as general counsel of Ilim Holding in the mid 1990s.","Smuskhin collects Russian paintings, particularly works by Mikhail Vrubel."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zan Shengda chairs investment company Nantong Zongyi Investment. \r\n","Zan investments over the years have ranged include financial services, spirits, dairy and software.\r\n","Zan holds an EMBA degree from Tsinghua University."]

name: Billionaires
bios:
["Zarakh Iliev and his longtime partner God Nisanov are building trade centers, hotels and residential property in Moscow.","The pair, who moved to Moscow from Azerbaijan, own roughly 14 million of square feet of real estate in Moscow.","The partners developed a 225-acre wholesale distribution center, Food City, in Moscow and also several shopping centers on Moscow's outskirts.","Ililev is co-owner of 5- star Moscow Royal Radisson hotel, which served as FIFA's headquarters during the World Cup 2018 in Russia.
","In September 2022 a real estate mogul Iliev was hit with U.K. sanctions in the wake of Russia's invasion of Ukraine."]
abouts: ["The son of a shoemaker, Iliev helped make shoes as a child.","Iliev and his partner God Nisanov were born and grew up in Krasnaya Sloboda village in Azerbaijan."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zbigniew Juroszek is the founder of Atal S.A., a real estate developer listed in Warsaw, Poland.","Juroszek first founded Atal in 1990 as a supplier to clothing manufacturers, before investing in real estate.","He built his first residential projects in 2003; Atal now develops properties in Katowice, Warsaw, and other major Polish cities.","He now runs his business with his son Mateusz, who is the CEO of gambling company STS.","STS, which is owned by the father and son duo, provides betting services to over 1 million customers in Europe."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zeng Chaolin chairs Shenzhen-listed Tianshan Aluminum Group, a Chinese supplier of aluminum products.","Tianshan's shares trade at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange; it's headquartered in Xinjiang.","Shimge Pump Industry Group acquired Tianshan Aluminum Group in 2020 in a backdoor listing and changed its own name to Tianshan Aluminum Group.","Brother Zeng Chaolin's brother Zeng Chaoyi is a director of the listed company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zeng Chaoyi is a director of Tianshan Aluminum Group, a Chinese supplier of aluminum products.","Tianshan's shares trade at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange; it's headquartered in Xinjiang.","Shimge Pump Industry Group acquired Tianshan Aluminum Group in 2020 in a backdoor listing and changed its name to Tianshan Aluminum Group.","Brother Zeng Chaoyi's brother Zeng Chaolin is Tianshan's chairman and also a billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zeng Fangqin is the chairman and general manager of Lingyi iTech, a maker of electronic components and a known Apple supplier.","The company, already listed in Shenzhen, raised in 2026 $1.1 billion through a separate share sale in Hong Kong.","Zeng worked for a state-owned enterprise in Shenzhen before heading to the U.S. in the 1980s. Prior to returning to China, She worked in Silicon Valley.","Lingyi also supplies sectors including autos, AI hardware, servers and humanoid robots."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zeng Kaitian became a billionaire in 2015 when Sanqi Interactive Entertainment Shanghai Technology (cofounder) was bought by Wuhu Shunrong Auto Parts.\r\n","Sanqi Interactive owns web game platforms 37.com and 6711.com.","Earlier in his career, Zeng was media director at ad agency Shanghai Leo Burnett.","Zeng holds a bachelor's degree from Lanzhou University and an EMBA degree from China Europe International Business School."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Bangxin is the cofounder and chairman of education services firm  TAL Education.","TAL went public on the New York Stock Exchange in October 2010.","Zhang holds degrees from Sichuan University and the China Europe International Business School."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Changhong chairs DZH, formerly known as Shanghai Great Wisdom, a supplier of financial data that competes with Reuters and Bloomberg in China. \r\n"]
title: Entrepreneur

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Cheng Fei is the deputy CEO of Nine Dragons Paper of China, one of Asia's largest paper and packaging companies.","Zhang's sister Cheung Yan, who chairs Nine Dragons, is also a billionaire.","Zhang's brother-in-law Liu Ming Chung, the CEO of Nine Dragons, is also one of three billionaires in the family."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Chuanwei is the chairman and CEO of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group, a wind turbine manufacturer headquartered in China's Guangdong Province.","Zhang founded Ming Yang in the city of Zhongshan in 2006.","Zhang is a vice chairman of Guangdong Federation of Industry & Commerce.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Congyuan founded Huali Industrial, a shoe manufacturer, in 2004; the company now has factories in China, Indonesia, Vietnam, Dominica and Myanmar.","Huali supplies to dozens of brands including Nike, Puma, UGG and Vans.","Zhang also cofounded Hong Kong-listed shoemaker Symphony Holdings, but sold his stake and is no longer with the company.","He shares the fortune with his wife and children."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Daocai is the chairman of Sanhua Holding Group, whose interests include refrigeration, air conditioning and automotive thermal management components as well as finance.","He founded Sanhua in 1984 and listed the refrigeration and air conditioning parts arm, Zhejiang Sanhua Intelligent Controls, on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2005.","It had a dual listing on the Hong Kong stock exchange in June 2025.","His son Zhang Yabo is the chairman of the listed arm, and his younger son Zhang Shaobo serves as its director.","The group's 57 factories across the globe supply to international brands such as BMW and Panasonic."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Fan is founder and chairman of Shenzhen Goodix Technology, a touch-screen maker.","Goodix clients include Huawei, Lenovo, OPPO, vivo, ZTE, Meizu and Xiaomi.","In 2016 Goodix went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.","Zhang is a graduate of the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Feng is the chairman of Zhejiang XCC Group, a manufacturer of bearings and automotive components.","The company has production bases in Zhejiang, Anhui, Sichuan, Dalian and Mexico, and sales offices in the United States, Poland, Germany, France, the United Kingdom and Italy.","The company went public in 2016."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Gongyun is the former chairman and controlling shareholder of Shenzhen-listed Himile Mechanical Science and Technology (Shandong), a supplier of tire molds.","Himile's customers include Yokohama, Continental, Michelin and Bridgestone.","The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2011."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Hejun is the chairman of Ningbo Deye Technology, a supplier of products ranging from energy storage systems and inverters to dehumidifiers and solar air conditioners.","Zhang founded Deye in the eastern Chinese city of Ningbo in 1990. It went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2021 and has over 9,000 employees today.","Deye's business partners include Midea, Haier, TCL and AUX. ","Zhang's son Dongye serves as company vice chairman and CEO; older son Dongbin is a director."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Hongchao is the chairman of Mixue Group, the world's second biggest seller of freshly-made drinks by annual cups sold after Starbucks.","He started a shaved ice shop in 1997 in China with a homemade machine and opened the first Mixue Bingcheng store two years later.","Nearly all-franchised, the Mixue Bingcheng chain offers bubble tea, lemonade, coffee and other drinks as well as ice cream at dirt-cheap prices across more than 50,000 stores, including nearly 5,000 overseas.","The company went public in a $444 million Hong Kong IPO in March 2025.","His younger brother Zhang Hongfu, CEO of the company and also a billionaire, joined Mixue in 2007."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Hongfu is the CEO of Mixue Group, the world's second biggest seller of freshly-made drinks by annual cups sold after Starbucks.","His elder brother Hongchao started a shaved ice shop in 1997 in China and opened the first Mixue Bingcheng store two years later. Hongfu joined in 2007.","Nearly all-franchised, the Mixue Bingcheng chain offers bubble tea, lemonade, coffee and other drinks as well as ice cream at dirt-cheap prices across more than 50,000 stores, including nearly 5,000 overseas.","The company went public in a $444 million Hong Kong IPO in March 2025.","Hongchao is the chairman of the company and also a billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Hongwei is the former chairman of United Energy Group, an independent exploration and production company.","United Energy made several acquisitions in 2018 including Kuwait Energy, which it purchased for a reported $650 million and snapping up more assets in Pakistan.","Zhang has 30 years of experience in management in China.","In 2025 his daughter Zhang Meiying stepped down as executive director at the listed company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Jian chairs AIMA Technology, a maker of electric bikes and scooters.","AIMA was founded in 1999.","AIMA listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2021."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Jianguo chairs Jovo Energy, a Chinese distributor of natural gas.","Jovo was founded in the southern Chinese city of Zhuhai in 1990.","Jovo's international partners include Petronas from Malaysia and the Skaugen Group from Norway.","Jovo went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2021."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Jianhui is the chairman and CEO of energy storage firm Beijing HyperStrong Technology.","He took the firm public in Shanghai in January 2025, raising 860 million yuan ($121 million).","Before founding HyperStrong in 2011, Zhang worked for the National Semiconductor Corporation in the U.S. and Siemens in China.","His wife, Xu Rui, is a company vice manager."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Jianzhong is the chairman and CEO of Moore Threads Technology, a semiconductor maker that is vying to be the Nvidia of China.","He took the company public in Shanghai in December 2025, raising $1.1 billion.","Before founding Beijing-based Moore Threads in 2020, Zhang once led Nvidia's China business.","Moore Threads was added in 2023 to a U.S. trade blacklist, which prevents it from accessing advanced American chipmaking technologies."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Jingzhang chairs two companies: Shanghai-listed Ningbo Haitian Precision Machinery and Hong Kong-listed Haitian International Holding.","Haitian International Holdings designs and manufactures plastic injection molding machines and related parts.","Ningbo Haitian Precision Machinery is a maker of machining centers."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Keqiang fortune arises from a stake in Poly Real Estate Group,  one of China's largest real estate developers.","He also owns a stake in Qinghai Salt Lake Industry Group, a potash producer.","Zhang holds an MBA degree from Murdoch University in Australia.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Lei is the founder and CEO of Hillhouse Capital Management, a global investment firm based in Singapore.","Zhang obtained an MBA and M.A. in international relations from Yale University.","Zhang holds a B.A. from Renmin University in Beijing, where he is vice chairman of the board of trustees; and earned an MBA and M.A. from Yale University.","During his time at Yale, he worked for the Yale Investment Office which manages the university's endowment funds."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Li is a co-founder of real estate developer Guangzhou R&F with Hong Kong billionaire Li Sze Lim; the duo set up the company in 1994.","He resigned as CEO at the end of 2023 months after reportedly admitting to paying bribes in San Francisco to obtain a building permit.","Zhang once worked in Guangzhou as the Secretary of Youth League Committee of Guangzhou 2nd Light Industry Bureau, as well as a hotel manager.","Zhang also owns a stake in Hong Kong-listed Kinetic Mines and Energy, a company he founded with son Johnson in 2006."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Liguo is the founder and chairman of Harbin Fuerjia Technology, a maker of skincare products best known for its beauty masks.","He took Fuerjia public in Shenzhen in August 2023, raising $306 million.","Zhang worked as a pharmacist in a local hospital before striking out on his own."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Ning chairs chemicals supplier Red Avenue New Materials Group, which trades on the Shanghai stock exchange.","In May 2020, the company announced it would produce a type of compostable polyester in a venture with German firm BASF.","Zhang Ning lives in Shanghai but holds Canadian citizenship.","She holds a doctorate in global financial business management from Arizona State University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Shengwei is the founder and majority owner of Shenzhen iMiracle Technology, a Shenzhen-based electronic cigarette manufacturer.","Shenzhen iMiracle Technology produces brands including Elf Bar and Lost Mary; Shengwei also owns stakes in the firms behind Air Bar and Geekvape.","Zhang sold kitchenware and clothing on eBay before turning to vaping devices."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Shilong chairs SG Micro, a supplier of integrated circuits for automotive and industrial markets.","Zhang worked as an engineer under China's Ministry of Railways and at Texas Instruments earlier in his career.","SG Micro went public and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2017. \r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Tao was the CEO of restaurant review site Dianping when it merged with Groupon-like Meituan in 2015.","Meituan went public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2018.","Zhang received an MBA from Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania in 2002, and returned to China in 2003, when he set up Dianping."]

name: Billionaires
bios:
["Zhang Tianyu chairs Fibocom Wireless, a supplier of wireless communication modules and solutions.
","Fibocom Wireless went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2017.

"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Wanzhen is a director of Chaozhou Three-Circle (Group), an electronics components maker.","He stepped down as the company's chairman in 2021 to make way for new leadership.","Chaozhou Three-Circle Group was founded in 1970 as a state-owned business; the ownership was restructured in 1992. ","The company went public on Shenzhen's ChiNext Market in 2014 and had a dual listing in Hong Kong in July 2026.","Zhang previously served as vice mayor of Chaozhou."]
abouts: ["Zhang joined the workforce at age 16 after finishing junior high school."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Wenzhong is the controlling shareholding of Wumart Holdings Inc.","Wumart is a multi-brand retailer with supermarkets and department stores, among other businesses.","He was sentenced to 18 years in prison for financial violations in 2008 and released in 2013.","Zhang's earlier convictions were overturned by China's high court in 2018, clearing his record."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Xiaojuan is a cofounder with her husband Yu Huijiao of YTO Express Group, one of China's largest express delivery firms.","YTO went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2000.","Zhang is classmate of fellow delivery billionaire, STO Chairman Chen Dejun."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Xin and her husband Pan Shiyi co-founded real estate developer Soho China.","Soho China is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and develops office towers in Shanghai and Beijing.","Prior to founding Soho China, Zhang worked on Wall Street for Goldman Sachs and Travelers Group.","In June 2021, U.S. private equity giant Blackstone said it would buy the majority of Soho China for as much as $3.05 billion; the purchase wasn't completed.","In 2022, Pan and Zhang stepped down from their leadership roles as chairman and CEO \"in order to focus on supporting the arts and philanthropic pursuits\" but remain on the board."]
title: Cofounder, CEO

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Xinghai is founder of Seres Group, a manufacturer of passenger and commercial vehicles and auto parts.","Zhang started the company in 2007 as an auto parts business.","Sokon went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in June 2016, lifting Zhang into the ranks of the world's billionaires.","His son and apparent-apparent, Zhang Zhengping, succeeded him as chairman in 2020."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang chairs Yonghui Superstores, an operator of hypermarkets and supermarkets.","His brother Zhang Xuanning is the vice chairman of Yonghui Superstores.","Yonghui Superstore listed on Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2010.\r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang chairs Yanker Shop Food, a supplier of snack food.","Yanker is headquartered in the southeastern Chinese city of Changsha.","The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2017."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Xuexin gets his wealth from Xinfa Group, which owns power stations, aluminum refineries and an aluminum smelter.","Xinfa's predecessor was a state-owned power plant founded in 1972.","His son Zhang Gang is Xinfa's chairman."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Yiming is the main cofounder of Chinese tech giant ByteDance, best known for its insanely popular app TikTok, which has more than 1 billion users worldwide. ","It also has interests in e-commerce, education, gaming and news.","Zhang stepped down as chairman of ByteDance in 2021 after resigning as CEO earlier that year, reportedly under pressure from the Chinese government. ","In 2026, the company ceded control of TikTok's U.S. business to a consortium of mostly American investors including Oracle and Silver Lake Management, which allowed the service to keep operating on U.S. soil. ","In China, the tech giant is making strides in AI. Its Doubao AI assistant counted 345 million monthly active users and became the country's most popular AI-powered app in the first quarter of 2026, according to intelligence service provider QuestMobile."]
abouts: ["He was a member of the 2013 Forbes China 30 Under 30 List.","Zhang started ByteDance in 2012 in a four-bedroom Beijing apartment."]
bio: Zhang founded ByteDance in 2012 in a four-bedroom Beijing apartment and launched news-aggregation app Toutiao months later. He appeared on the Forbes Under 30 list in 2013 at age 29. Today he and his company are best known for the insanely app TikTok. It has more than 1 billion users worldwide, but its future will be in the hands of someone other than Zhang, who stepped down as ByteDance's chairman in November as the Chinese government exerts more pressure on high-profile CEOs.

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Yin, also known as Cheung Yan, chairs Hong Kong-listed Nine Dragons Paper, one of Asia's largest packaging and paper producers.","Zhang's husband Liu Ming Chung, the CEO of Nine Dragons, is also a billionaire.","Her younger brother, Zhang Cheng Fei, is deputy CEO of Nine Dragons, and the third billionaire in the family.","Zhang Yin is vice chair of the Guangdong Federation of Industry and Commerce."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Restaurateur Zhang Yong is chairman and CEO of Sichuan hotpot chain Haidilao International Holding, which went public in 2018.","Haidilao has nearly 1,400 restaurants in Greater China. It is renowned for its spicy dishes and attentive customer service, including free manicures for waiting customers.","It spun off its overseas business Super Hi, which went public in Hong Kong in 2022 and had a dual listing on Nasdaq in 2024. Super Hi has over 100 restaurants in international markets.","Having never finished high school, the entrepreneur says he didn't even know how to prepare the typical Sichuan hotpot when he started.","Three friends, including Shu Ping who became his wife, helped with seed money, but he ran the place. He stepped down as CEO in 2022 to focus on long-term strategies, but returned to the post in 2026 to address a slump in the company's business performance."]
abouts: ["Haidilao means deep-sea fishing, or literally \"scooping the bottom of the ocean.\"","Zhang often spent the night in his first restaurant on a foldaway bed. His worst memory was breaking a $100 aquarium he had saved up for to display fresh seafood."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Yubo is a cofounder of Chinese semiconductor maker Moore Threads Technology Co.","The company went public in Shanghai in December 2025, raising $1.1 billion.","Zhang worked as a senior executive for Nvidia and Pony AI before cofounding Moore Threads in 2020.","The company's Chairman and CEO, Zhang Jianzhong, is also a billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Yuqiang is a director of Zhenshi Holding Group. He stepped down as chairman in January 2025. The group is a diversified conglomerate headquartered in Zhejiang Province.","Zhenshi's business includes fiberglass products for wind energy, special steel, new composite materials, logistics, minerals, tourism and real estate.","Zhenshi set up Zhenshi--Henshi USA Wind Power Materials Corporations in South Carolina in 2016.","His son, Zhang Jiankan is the chairman of Zhejiang Zhenshi New Materials, which went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in January 2026."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Zhidong, also known as Tony Zhang, cofounded internet giant Tencent with fellow billionaire Pony Ma in 1998.","Citing personal reasons, he stepped down as executive director and chief technology officer in 2014.","Zhang is now advisor emeritus and honorary president of Tencent Academy, which was set up in 2007 to offer employee training and career development opportunities."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhao Ding is the deputy chairman and deputy general manager of Chinese snacks retailer Busy Ming Group.","The company went public in Hong Kong in January 2026, raising $470 million.","It sells under the Busy for You and Super Ming brands, offering products such as small-packaged biscuits and nuts across a network of about 20,000 stores in China.","The group was formed in 2023, when Zhao's Super Ming merged with fellow snacks retailer Busy for You.","Busy for You's founder, Yan Zhou, is also a billionaire."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zheng Fenggang is a vice president at Contemporary Amperex Technology, a supplier of batteries to the EV industry.","Before joining CATL, Zhao worked as a senior engineer at the Nanjing Chemical Industrial Co. Research Institute.","Zhao received a master's degree in chemical physics from the University of Science and Technology of China."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhao Hongfei chairs Shenzhen-listed software firm Thunder Software Technology.","Zhao holds a master's degree from the Beijing Institute of Technology.","Zhao worked for a joint venture of Japan's NEC and the Chinese Academy of Science's Institute of Software before founding Thunder in 2008."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhao Lixin is the CEO of semiconductor supplier GalaxyCore.","GalaxyCore went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2021.","GalaxyCore's customers include Oppo, Xiaomi, Samsung and Lenovo.","GalaxyCore was founded in 2003."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhao Mantang is the largest shareholder of Shengda Resources, a silver miner.","His son Zhao Qing is the chairman of the company.","The company has silver reserves of 9,300 tonnes."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhao Tao is the chairman of Shandong Buchang Pharmaceuticals, a supplier of traditional Chinese medicine to fight cardiovascular disease.","Zhao received an MBA from Fordham University in New York City.","Buchang started trading on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in November 2016.","Zhao holds a Singapore passport."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhao Tongtong is a co-founder of H World Group, the operator of one of the largest hotel chains in China.","Ji Qi, H World's other co-founder, is also a billionaire and chairs the company.","She's also a board member of China Education & Technology Group.","Zhao holds an MBA from McGill University.and M.S. degree from Shanghai Jiao Tong University.","H World shares trade on both the Nasdaq and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhao Yan is the chairman and CEO of Shanghai-listed Bloomage Biotechnology, a biotech company best known for making hyaluronic acid, an ingredient widely used in beauty products.","Not content with just being a supplier, Zhao has established her own skincare brands that include the Biohyalux line for facial creams, gels and masks.","To expand the use of hyaluronic acid, Bloomage also sells products such as candies and bottled water infused with the compound.","Besides Bloomage, Zhao has interests in finance, property and sports as well."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zheng Jianjiang is founder and chairman of Aux Group, a conglomerate and controlling shareholder of Ningbo Sanxing Medical Electric.","Zheng cofounded Ninbo Sanxing Medical Electric in 2007 and took it public in Shanghai in 2011.","Ninbo Sanxing supplies power distribution equipment such as smart meters and transformers.","Prior to Aux, Zheng worked at a bankrupt watch parts factory in 1986 with seven other people."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zheng Shuliang served as vice chairman of China Hongqiao Group, one of the country's largest aluminum producers founded by her late husband Zhang Shiping. She resigned in May 2026, citing her age.","Zhang, who died in 2019, built Hongqiao into a multibillion-dollar business during the reform and opening-up years ushered in by then-leader Deng Xiaoping. ","The couple's son, Zhang Bo, is the chairman and CEO of Hong Kong-listed Hongqiao. ","Their daughter, Zhang Hongxia, is the chairman of textile producer Weiqiao Textile, which was taken private from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2024."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zheng Xiaodong chairs Shanghai Tofflon Science and Technology, a pharmaceutical equipment supplier.","He worked for a factory owned by Shanghai Biochemical Pharmaceutical, one of China's largest drug companies, early in his career.","Zheng founded Tofflon in Shanghai in 1993."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhang Huaijun chairs Shanghai Ziyan Food, a supplier of chicken and other food.","Ziyan went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2022."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhong Huijuan is the chairman and CEO of Chinese drugmaker Hansoh Pharmaceutical Group, which produces oncology, psychoactive, antidiabetic and other drugs.","Zhong's husband, Sun Piaoyang, is also a billionaire and leads Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals, which is dual-listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong.","Their daughter, Sun Yuan, is Hansoh's executive director.","Headquartered in the Chinese coastal city of Lianyungang, Hansoh went public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2019.","Hansoh has licensed products including weight-loss treatments to global pharmaceutical giants such as Merck in billion-dollar deals, as the firm expands internationally."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhong Peifeng is chairman of Amlogic Shanghai, a microchip supplier.","Zhong holds a master's degree from Georgia Institute of Technology."]

name: Billionaires
bios:
["Zhong Ruonong chairs Shenzhen-ilsted Zhuzhou Hongda Electronics.


","Zhuzhou Hongda Electronics makes electronic components including  capacitors, inductors and resistors.","Husband Zeng Jijiang is general manager of the listed company. 
"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhong Shanshan is the founder and chairman of Nongfu Spring, a bottled water company that listed its shares in Hong Kong in 2020.","Hangzhou-born Zhong dropped out of elementary school during China's chaotic Cultural Revolution.","He later had jobs as a construction worker, a newspaper reporter and a beverage sales agent before starting his own business.","Zhong also controls Wantai Biological, which  makes rapid diagnostic tests for infectious diseases including Covid-19.","His son Zhong Shu Zi is a non-executive director at Nongfu."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhong Sheng Jian is the chairman of Singapore-listed Yanlord Land, one of the largest non-government-owned real estate developers in China.","Zhong, a mainland native, moved to Singapore in 1988.","Yanlord's prominent China partners include Ping An Insurance, China Merchants Property Development and Poly Real Estate Group.","His son Zhong Ming is Yanlord's executive deputy chairman; younger son Zhong Iek Ka sits on the board."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Chaonan is the chairman of Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group, a provider of data center services.","Zhou worked as a teacher briefly before finding a job at a state-owned logistics hub in her home town of Hengyang in Hunan Province.","She then worked for various state-owned firms for almost two decades, and didn't launch her own business until 2000 -- when Zhou was already in her 40s.","Zhou officially set up Range in 2009. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in a backdoor listing in 2022.","Zhou's son, Li Li, is CEO and vice chairman of Range, while his wife, Zhang Xian, serves as deputy general manager.  "]
abouts: ["Her given name literally means better than man in Chinese. Zhou's father hoped she could live up to Chairman Mao's famous quote: Women hold up half the sky."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Chengjian is the founder of Shanghai Metersbonwe, one of China's largest home-grown apparel chains.","Daughter Hu Jiajia became Metersbonwe chairman in November 2016.","Zhou Chengjian began his career as a tailor."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Hongyi is the cofounder, CEO and chairman of Beijing-based Internet security software provider and search company 360 Security Technology, also known as Qihoo 360.","Zhou previously founded 3721.com, an online search company that was purchased by Yahoo.","Qihoo delisted from the New York Stock Exchange in 2016 then relisted in China in 2018.","Zhou also chairs Nasdaq-listed 360 DigiTech, a credit information service."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Jian is the founder and CEO of artificial intelligence and robotics firm UBTECH Robotics.","UBTECH Robotics investors include Tencent, one of China's largest Internet companies.","UBTECH listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in December 2023."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Jian chairs Suzhou Maxwell Technologies, a supplier of laser cutting equipment.","Maxwell went public at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2018."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Jianping is the founder of HLA Group, one of China's largest apparel manufacturers and retailers.","Zhou got into the apparel business with money he earned from running a photo studio.","Zhou's son Zhou Lichen is HLA's chairman."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Liangzhang chairs Hexing Electrical, a supplier of electrical equipment to power utilities.","Zhou worked in a state-owned business early in his career before founding Hexing.","Hexing's products are used in more than 80 countries around the world. \r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Qunfei is the chairman and general manager of Lens Technology, a touch screen maker whose customers include Apple, Samsung and Huawei.","It also supplies to electric vehicle makers such as Tesla and BYD.","A migrant factory worker as a teenager, Zhou has gone on to become one of the world's richest self-made women.","Lens Technology went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2015, 22 years after she founded the company. It had a dual listing in Hong Kong in July 2025.","Zhou first took the plunge as an entrepreneur in 1993 when she set up a watch parts company, the precursor of Lens, with relatives in an apartment in Shenzhen."]
abouts: ["Growing up she helped her family raise pigs and ducks for food and additional money.","Zhou dropped out of school at 16 and traveled south to Guangdong province to live with her uncle's family and search for better work."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Wen chairs Shanghai Pret Composites, a supplier of plastics and composites.","He worked as an engineer at SAIC Volkswagen Automotive, a Volkswagen joint venture, in China early in his career.","Shanghai Pret Composites listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2009.","Zhou holds an executive MBA degree from Fudan University.","In 2025 his son Zhenlun Zhou was appointed to vice chairman and vice general manager of the company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Xiaoping is the chairman and CEO of Changzhou Xingyu Automotive Lighting Systems.","Zhou and her late father Zhou Bajin cofounded the company in 1993.","Its customers include Volkswagen, Daimler, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, and General Motors."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Yahui is the founder and director of Beijing Kunlun Tech, a Beijing-headquartered operator of online games. He stepped down as chairman in April 2020 to focus on his African mobile payment business, Opay.","Zhou's former wife Li Qiong became a billionaire in 2016 following the couple's divorce settlement.","Zhou holds a master's degree from China's elite Tsinghua University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhou Zongwen chairs Chow Tai Seng Jewelry, which listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2017.","Zhou is a graduate of the China University of Geosciences.","Zhou opened the first Chow Tai Seng jewelry store in Beijing in 1999."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhu Baoguo was the chairman of Shenzhen-based Joincare Pharmaceutical Group Industry. He stepped down in September 2026, citing the reach of retirement age. \r\n\r\n","The mogul handed over the reins to the company's CEO Lin Nanqi, who now assumes both roles. ","Zhu has built a pharma empire with businesses in prescription drugs and traditional Chinese medicine, after his first product - an herbal tonic for women - became a nationwide bestseller after its launch in the 1990s. ","Prior to his pharmaceutical venture, Zhu was a chemical engineer with a bachelor's degree in chemistry from the Henan Normal University. ","Zhu also owns a stake in WeBank, a Chinese digital bank backed by Tencent."]
abouts: ["Zhu's wife, Liu Guangxia, is Joincare's vice chairman. ","Zhu's herbal tonics were based on a recipe he bought from a Chinese medicine practitioner in his native Henan province."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhu Gongshan chairs GCL-Poly Energy Holdings, a producer of polysilicon used to make solar panels.","Zhu is active in business groups, including the Global Green Energy Council and Asian Photovoltaic Industry Association.","Son Zhu Yufeng is a member of GCL-Poly's board of directors.","Chu also chairs GCL System Integration Technology, whose shares trade at the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.","Zhu graduated from Nanjing Electric Power College in July 1981 and obtained a diploma in electrical automation."]
