name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhu Jiangming is the founder of Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology, a Chinese electric vehicle maker.","Earlier in his career, he co-founded Dahua Technology, a supplier of surveillance equipment.","From 2008 to 2010, Zhu worked at Motorola's branch Hangzhou, China.","Zhu received a bachelor's degree in electronic engineering from China's Zhejiang University in 1990."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhu Weisong is the chairman and CEO of Shanghai-based toy maker Bloks Group. ","The company raised HK$1.7 billion ($215 million) in a frenzied Hong Kong IPO in January 2025. The retail portion in the offering was 6,000 times oversubscribed. ","Bloks sells Lego-like building blocks and figurines including those based on Japan's Ultraman superhero characters.","Zhu previously cofounded Shanghai-listed games developer Yoozoo Information Technology. He left in 2016 to build Bloks."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhu Xingming cofounded and chairs Shenzhen Inovance Technology, which makes industrial automation control products.","Inovance went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2010; with his daughter Zhu owns about 10% of the company's stock.","Zhu holds a graduate degree from Yanshan University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhu Yan inherited the fortune held by her late husband Zuo Hui, the KE Holdings founder, after his death in 2021.","KE Holdings, which trades in both New York and Hong Kong, is one of the world's largest real estate brokerage chains.","Zuo Hui, a pioneering real estate tycoon, died at age 50 of an undisclosed illness.","Zuo formed KE Holdings in 2018 to encompass several companies: Lianjia, Beike and a property financial services firm he'd launched in 2010."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhu Yi is the chairman of Biokin Pharmaceutical, a developer of drugs including anesthesia injections, cancer drugs as well as traditional Chinese medicine treatments.","The company went public in Shanghai in 2023, raising $136 million; it has been seeking a Hong Kong IPO since 2024.","Biokin's U.S. subsidiary SystImmune signed in 2023 an $8.4 billion deal with Bristol Myers Squibb to jointly develop and commercialize a potential cancer treatment worldwide.","Zhu taught immunology and microbiology at West China University of Medical Sciences before striking out on his own."]
abouts: ["Zhu has a master's in biology from Fudan University and a doctorate in management from Sichuan University."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhu Yiming is the chairman of Shanghai-listed memory chip giant CXMT, which raised in July 2026 $8.6 billion in one of the largest listings in Asia ever. ","The company, also known as Changxin Memory Technologies, is the world's fourth largest producer of DRAM chips by market share, after Samsung, SK Hynix and Micro, according to Counterpoint Research.","Zhu is also the chairman of Shenzhen-listed GigaDevice Semiconductor, a supplier of flash memory chips.","With support from the Hefei municipal government, he cofounded CXMT in 2016 amid China's drive to control AI and semiconductor supply chains. ","Before returning to China in 2005, the U.S.-trained mogul worked for iPolicy Networks and Monolithic System Technologies in Silicon Valley. "]
abouts: ["He is a permanent resident of Singapore."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhu Zhaojiang chairs Shenzhen Transsion, a supplier of mobile phones global emerging markets.","Transsion is headquartered in Shenzhen.","Zhu founded Transsion Technology--the predecessor of the listed company -- in 2006."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhuang Kuilong is the former chairman of Xinfengming Group, a manufacturer of polyester and filament products.","Zhuang was reportedly a farmer before a joining a collective fiber factory.","He cofounded the predecessor to Xinfengming in 2000 with 11 others founders, including his wife Qu Fengqi.","Xinfengming listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2017.","His son Zhuang Yaozhong is the company's president and chairman. \r\n"]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zhuo Jun took over a substantial stake of Shenzhen Kinwong Electronic in 2013 when her husband, Shen Jitang, passed away.","Founded in 1993, the Shanghai-listed company is one of China's largest printed circuit board makers. It announced its plan for a dual listing in Hong Kong in 2025.","Zhuo sits on the board of Kinwong; her younger brother Zhuo Yong serves as vice chairman.","She was a clerk at Heung Yee Kuk, a statutory advisory body representing interests in the New Territories, Hong Kong, for 4 years after high school.","Kinwong is building a printed circuit board manufacturing base in Thailand, its first overseas site, slated to come onstream in 2026."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Ziv Aviram is the cofounder of autonomous vehicle technology firm Mobileye.","He launched the company in 1999 with fellow billionaire Amnon Shashua, a computer science professor at Hebrew University.","The pair took Mobileye public in 2014, then sold it to Intel in 2017 at a $15.3 billion valuation.","Aviram and Shashua also co-CEOs of Or-Cam, which makes portable, artificial vision devices for visually impaired people. They founded the company in 2010."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zong Fuli, also known as Kelly, is the daughter of beverage giant Hangzhou Wahaha Group's late founder Zong Qinghou.","Her wealth is based on a company stake inherited in 2024, after the elder Zong passed away earlier in the year. ","Once Wahaha's chairman and CEO, Kelly stepped down in 2025, handing the reins over to long-time lieutenant Xu Simin.","She already stepped down once in 2024, before being reinstated months later after resolving an unspecified shareholder dispute at the time.","In 2025, she was sued in Hong Kong over $2.1 billion worth of trust assets by three plaintiffs who claim to be her half siblings."]
abouts: ["Started in Hangzhou in 1987, the company's name Wahaha mimics the sound of a laughing child."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zou Zhinong is the chairman of Suzhou TFC Optical Communication, a supplier of telecommunication equipment.","He cofounded TFC, the company's predecessor, in 2005.","Suzhou TFC went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2015.","Zou started his career as a technical and computer engineer at a local company."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zsolt Felcsuti owns MPF Industry Group, a Swiss conglomerate that operates across central Europe.","He started the business in 1994 with his father, Csaba, as a machinery parts company. They began acquiring other businesses in 2003.","Csaba Felcsuti operated his first business during the Communist era, which until 1989 limited the size of all private enterprise in the country. ","MPF now sells products in about 30 countries."]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zuo Zongshen is founder and chairman of Zongshen Industrial Group, a Chinese manufacturer of motorcycles with over 20,000 employees, based in the southwestern city of Chongqing.","Zuo moved to Chongqing at age 17 and later worked at a state-owned porcelain factory in 1975.","He started the predecessor to Zongshen Industrial in 1982 as a motorcycle repair shop called \"Master Zuo.\""]

name: Billionaires
bios: ["Zygmunt Solorz (formerly Solorz-Zak) founded Polsat, one of the first national commercial broadcasters in the Eastern Europe.","It is now part of his Cyfrowy Polsat, Poland's leading pay-TV operator.","Solorz's business empire includes mobile, energy and financial products."]
abouts: ["Zygmunt Solorz made his first fortune importing used cars from Germany.","Solorz flies planes as a hobby and controls Jest Story, which charters jets in Central Europe."]
